````php
15:     public function confirm(Request $request, AiPendingAction $action, PendingActionService $service): JsonResponse
16:     {
17:         $data = $request->validate(['typed_confirmation' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'], 'selected_items' => ['nullable', 'array', 'min:1', 'max:100'], 'selected_items.*' => ['string', 'ulid', 'distinct']]);
18:         $outcome = $service->confirm($request->user('staff'), $action, $data['typed_confirmation'] ?? null, $data['selected_items'] ?? null);
19: 
20:         // generated_password is returned once to confirming admin, never persisted in messages
21:         return response()->json(['data' => ['ok' => $outcome->type === 'result', 'message' => $outcome->message, 'result' => $outcome->data, 'ui_block' => $outcome->uiBlock, 'status' => $action->fresh()->status]]);
22:     }
23: 
24:     public function cancel(Request $request, AiPendingAction $action, PendingActionService $service): JsonResponse
25:     {
26:         $service->cancel($request->user('staff'), $action);
27: 
28:         return response()->json(['data' => ['status' => $action->fresh()->status]]);
29:     }
30: 
31:     public function undo(Request $request, AiPendingAction $action, PendingActionService $service): JsonResponse
32:     {
33:         $outcome = $service->undo($request->user('staff'), $action);
34: 
35:         return response()->json(['data' => ['ok' => $outcome->type === 'result', 'message' => $outcome->message, 'status' => $action->fresh()->status]]);
36:     }
37: }
````

````php
 29:     public function updateSettings(Request $request, SettingService $settings, BranchAccess $branches): JsonResponse
 30:     {
 31:         $branches->assertCentralAccess($request->user('staff'));
 32:         $rules = (new UpdateSettingsRequest)->rules();
 33:         $allowed = array_filter($rules, fn ($key) => str_starts_with($key, 'ai_') || str_starts_with($key, 'expected.ai_') || $key === 'expected', ARRAY_FILTER_USE_KEY);
 34:         abort_if(array_diff(array_keys($request->all()), ['expected', ...array_filter(array_keys($allowed), fn ($key) => str_starts_with($key, 'ai_') && ! str_contains($key, '.'))]) !== [], 422);

 39:         try {

 43:                 // L-5: قناة التدقيق (ai) لا تُترك فارغة كما في SettingController.

 55:     public function usage(Request $request, BranchAccess $branches): JsonResponse
 56:     {
 57:         $actor = $request->user('staff');
 58:         $all = $request->boolean('all') && $actor->can('ai_agent.logs.view');
 59:         // L-4: all=1 يكشف استهلاك المؤسسة كاملة — يتطلب وصولًا مركزيًا.
 60:         if ($all) {
 61:             $branches->assertCentralAccess($actor);
 62:         }
 63:         $since = now(config('app.business_timezone', 'Africa/Cairo'))->startOfDay()->subDays(29)->setTimezone(config('app.timezone'));
 64:         $rows = AiMessage::query()->whereHas('conversation', function ($q) use ($actor, $all): void {
 65:             $q->withTrashed();
 66:             if (! $all) {
 67:                 $q->where('user_id', $actor->id);
 68:             }
 69:         })->where('created_at', '>=', $since)
 70:             // L-6: نفس يوم القاهرة اللي guard() بيحسب بيه الميزانية.
 71:             ->selectRaw('DATE((created_at AT TIME ZONE ?) AT TIME ZONE ?) as day, SUM(input_tokens) as input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) as output_tokens', [
 72:                 (string) config('app.timezone', 'UTC'), (string) config('app.business_timezone', 'Africa/Cairo'),
 73:             ])
 74:             ->groupBy('day')->orderByDesc('day')->get();
 75: 
 76:         // 6.3: إحصائيات الأدوات ونسبة التأكيد/الإلغاء ونسبة الـ 409
 77:         $actionsQuery = AiPendingAction::query()
 78:             ->where('created_at', '>=', $since)
 79:             ->when(! $all, fn ($q) => $q->where('user_id', $actor->id));
 80: 
 81:         $actionRows = (clone $actionsQuery)
 82:             ->selectRaw('tool, status, COUNT(*) as count')
 83:             ->groupBy('tool', 'status')
 84:             ->get();
 85: 
 86:         $byTool = [];
 87:         $totalProposals = 0;
 88:         $totalExecuted = 0;
 89:         $totalCancelled = 0;
 90:         $totalFailed = 0;
 91: 
 92:         foreach ($actionRows as $r) {
 93:             $t = (string) $r->tool;
 94:             $st = (string) $r->status;
 95:             $c = (int) $r->count;
 96:             $byTool[$t] ??= ['tool' => $t, 'total' => 0, 'executed' => 0, 'cancelled' => 0, 'failed' => 0, 'pending' => 0];
 97:             $byTool[$t]['total'] += $c;
 98:             $totalProposals += $c;
 99:             if (in_array($st, ['executed', 'undone'], true)) {
100:                 $byTool[$t]['executed'] += $c;
101:                 $totalExecuted += $c;
102:             } elseif ($st === 'cancelled') {
103:                 $byTool[$t]['cancelled'] += $c;
104:                 $totalCancelled += $c;
105:             } elseif ($st === 'failed') {
106:                 $byTool[$t]['failed'] += $c;
107:                 $totalFailed += $c;
108:             } else {
109:                 $byTool[$t]['pending'] += $c;
110:             }
111:         }
112: 
113:         $toolMetrics = array_values(array_map(function (array $item): array {
114:             $decided = $item['executed'] + $item['cancelled'];
115:             $cancelRate = $decided > 0 ? round(($item['cancelled'] / $decided) * 100, 1) : 0.0;
116:             $confirmRate = $decided > 0 ? round(($item['executed'] / $decided) * 100, 1) : 0.0;
117: 
118:             return $item + [
119:                 'confirm_rate' => $confirmRate,
120:                 'cancel_rate' => $cancelRate,
121:                 'needs_attention' => $decided >= 3 && $cancelRate > 40.0,
122:             ];
123:         }, $byTool));
124: 
125:         usort($toolMetrics, fn ($a, $b) => $b['total'] <=> $a['total']);
126: 
127:         $decidedTotal = $totalExecuted + $totalCancelled;
128: 
129:         return response()->json([
130:             'data' => $rows,
131:             'tool_stats' => [
132:                 'total_proposals' => $totalProposals,
133:                 'executed_count' => $totalExecuted,
134:                 'cancelled_count' => $totalCancelled,
135:                 'failed_409_count' => $totalFailed,
136:                 'confirm_rate' => $decidedTotal > 0 ? round(($totalExecuted / $decidedTotal) * 100, 1) : 0.0,
137:                 'cancel_rate' => $decidedTotal > 0 ? round(($totalCancelled / $decidedTotal) * 100, 1) : 0.0,
138:                 'conflict_409_rate' => $totalProposals > 0 ? round(($totalFailed / $totalProposals) * 100, 1) : 0.0,
139:                 'tools' => $toolMetrics,
140:             ],
141:         ]);
142:     }
143: }
````

````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Admin\Ai;
 6: 
 7: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
 8: use App\Models\AiAttachment;
 9: use App\Models\AiConversation;

11: use App\Services\Ai\AgentOrchestrator;
12: use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
13: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
14: use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
15: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
16: use Illuminate\Support\Str;
17: 
18: class AiAttachmentController extends Controller
19: {
20:     public function store(Request $request, AiConversation $conversation): JsonResponse
21:     {
22:         $user = $request->user('staff');
23:         abort_unless($conversation->user_id === $user->id, 403);
24: 
25:         // L1: لا رفع والمساعد مقفول أو المستخدم غير نشط أو فوق الميزانية.
26:         app(AgentOrchestrator::class)->guard($user);
27: 
28:         $request->validate([
29:             'files' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1', 'max:4'],
30:             'files.*' => ['required', 'image', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp', 'extensions:jpg,jpeg,png,webp', 'max:5120', new MaxImagePixels],
31:         ]);
32: 
33:         // L1: حصة مرفقات غير مستهلكة لكل مستخدم — الرفع بلا سقف كان يتيح
34:         // ملء التخزين المشترك (4 ملفات × 5MB كل دقيقة لكل مستخدم).
35:         $quota = max(1, (int) config('services.gemini.max_pending_attachments_per_user', 40));
36:         $pending = AiAttachment::query()->where('user_id', $user->id)->whereNull('consumed_at')->count();
37:         abort_if($pending >= $quota, 429, 'وصلت للحد الأقصى من الصور المرفقة غير المستخدمة؛ استخدمها أو احذف المحادثة أولًا.');
38: 
39:         /** @var list<UploadedFile> $files */
40:         $files = array_values((array) $request->file('files', []));
41:         // H3: تخزين مشترك خاص بدل القرص المحلي — كل سيرفر worker يرى
42:         // نفس الملفات في prepare/execute/prune.
43:         $disk = Storage::disk('ai_private');
44:         $created = [];
45: 
46:         foreach ($files as $file) {
47:             $ulid = (string) Str::ulid();
48:             $ext = strtolower($file->getClientOriginalExtension() ?: $file->extension() ?: 'jpg');
49:             $relativePath = "ai-attachments/{$conversation->id}/{$ulid}.{$ext}";
50:             $content = (string) $file->getContent();
51:             $sha256 = hash('sha256', $content);
52: 
53:             $disk->put($relativePath, $content);
54: 
55:             try {
56:                 $attachment = AiAttachment::create([
57:                     'id' => $ulid,
58:                     'conversation_id' => $conversation->id,
59:                     'user_id' => $user->id,
60:                     'path' => $relativePath,
61:                     'mime' => (string) $file->getMimeType(),
62:                     'size' => (int) $file->getSize(),
63:                     'sha256' => $sha256,
64:                 ]);
65:             } catch (\Throwable $e) {
66:                 // L1: فشل الإدخال بعد كتابة الملف كان يترك ملفًا يتيمًا.
67:                 $disk->delete($relativePath);
68: 
69:                 throw $e;
70:             }
71: 
72:             $created[] = [
73:                 'id' => $attachment->id,
74:                 'mime' => $attachment->mime,
75:                 'size' => $attachment->size,
76:                 'sha256' => $attachment->sha256,
77:             ];
78:         }
79: 
80:         return response()->json(['data' => $created], 201);
81:     }
82: }
````

````php
23:         if ($request->query('all') && $actor->can('ai_agent.logs.view') && $actor->can('customers.view')) { // M6
24:             // M11: عرض محادثات الآخرين بيفضح جداول موظفين وفروع — مين مقيّد بفرع مالوش وصول مركزي.

40:

42:     {

44:

46:         // المحادثة كاملة بلا حد.

48:         $conversation->setRelation('messages', $conversation->messages->sortBy('id')->values());
````

## File: backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Admin/Ai/AiMentionController.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Admin\Ai;
 6: 
 7: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;

11: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
12: 
13: class AiMentionController extends Controller
14: {
15:     public function search(Request $request, EntityResolver $resolver, ToolRegistry $registry): JsonResponse
16:     {
17:         $data = $request->validate(['q' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'], 'entity' => ['nullable', 'in:branch,user,role,customer,category,product,variant']]);
18:         $actor = $request->user('staff');
19:         $q = (string) ($data['q'] ?? '');
20:         $entity = $data['entity'] ?? null;
21:         $out = [];
22:         if ((! $entity || $entity === 'user') && $registry->canReadEntity($actor, 'user')) {
23:             $out['users'] = $resolver->users($actor, $q);
24:         }
25:         if ((! $entity || $entity === 'branch') && $registry->canReadEntity($actor, 'branch')) {
26:             $out['branches'] = $resolver->branches($actor, $q);
27:         }
28:         if ((! $entity || $entity === 'role') && $registry->canReadEntity($actor, 'role')) {
29:             $out['roles'] = $resolver->roles($q);
30:         }
31: 
32:         // العملاء بلا branch scoping عمدًا — زي REST (CustomerController مبيستخدمش BranchAccess).
33:         if ((! $entity || $entity === 'customer') && $registry->canReadEntity($actor, 'customer')) {
34:             $out['customers'] = $resolver->customers($actor, $q);
35:         }
36:         if ((! $entity || $entity === 'category') && $registry->canReadEntity($actor, 'category')) {
37:             $out['categories'] = $resolver->categories($actor, $q);
38:         }
39:         if ((! $entity || $entity === 'product') && $registry->canReadEntity($actor, 'product')) {
40:             $out['products'] = $resolver->products($actor, $q);
41:         }
42:         if ((! $entity || $entity === 'variant') && $registry->canReadEntity($actor, 'variant')) {
43:             $out['variants'] = $resolver->variants($actor, $q);
44:         }
45: 
46:         return response()->json(['data' => $out]);
47:     }
48: }
````

## File: backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Admin/Ai/AiMessageController.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Admin\Ai;
 6: 
 7: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
 8: use App\Models\AiConversation;
 9: use App\Services\Ai\AgentOrchestrator;
10: use App\Services\Ai\GeminiException;
11: use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
12: use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
13: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
14: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
15: use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
16: use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;
17: use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpExceptionInterface;
18: 
19: class AiMessageController extends Controller
20: {
21:     public function stream(Request $request, AiConversation $conversation, AgentOrchestrator $orchestrator): StreamedResponse
22:     {
23:         abort_unless($conversation->user_id === $request->user('staff')->id, 403);
24:         $data = $this->validated($request);
25:         $orchestrator->guard($request->user('staff'));
26: 
27:         return response()->stream(function () use ($request, $conversation, $orchestrator, $data): void {
28:             $emit = static function (string $event, array $payload): void {
29:                 echo 'event: '.$event."\n".'data: '.json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)."\n\n";
30:                 if (ob_get_level() > 0) {
31:                     ob_flush();
32:                 }
33:                 flush();
34:             };
35:             try {
36:                 $reply = $orchestrator->handle($request->user('staff'), $conversation, $data, fn ($status) => $emit('status', ['message' => $status]));
37:                 $emit('reply', ['text' => $reply->text, 'ui_blocks' => $reply->blocks, 'message_id' => $reply->messageId]);
38:             } catch (\Throwable $e) {
39:                 // L-9: AuthorizationException وValidationException ليستا
40:                 // HttpExceptionInterface، فكانتا تُعرضان كـ 502 مع report().
41:                 // صنّفهما لرمزيهما الصحيحين بلا تقرير.
42:                 $status = match (true) {
43:                     $e instanceof HttpExceptionInterface => $e->getStatusCode(),
44:                     $e instanceof AuthorizationException => 403,
45:                     $e instanceof ValidationException => 422,
46:                     default => 502,
47:                 };
48:                 if ($status >= 500) {
49:                     report($e);
50:                 }
51:                 $emit('error', ['message' => $status < 500 ? $e->getMessage() : 'تعذر إتمام طلب المساعد. حاول مرة تانية.', 'status' => $status]);
52:             }
53:         }, 200, ['Content-Type' => 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control' => 'no-cache, no-store', 'X-Accel-Buffering' => 'no']);
54:     }
55: 
56:     public function store(Request $request, AiConversation $conversation, AgentOrchestrator $orchestrator): JsonResponse
57:     {
58:         abort_unless($conversation->user_id === $request->user('staff')->id, 403);
59:         $data = $this->validated($request);
60:         try {
61:             $reply = $orchestrator->handle($request->user('staff'), $conversation, $data);
62:         } catch (GeminiException $e) {
63:             return response()->json(['message' => $e->getMessage()], 502);
64:         }
65: 
66:         return response()->json(['data' => ['text' => $reply->text, 'ui_blocks' => $reply->blocks, 'message_id' => $reply->messageId]]);
67:     }
68: 
69:     private function validated(Request $request): array
70:     {
71:         return $request->validate([
72:             'text' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:8000'],
73:             'selection' => ['nullable', 'array:entity,id,label'], 'selection.entity' => ['required_with:selection', 'in:branch,user,role,permission,location,customer,customer_group,category,product,variant'], 'selection.id' => ['required_with:selection', Rule::when($request->input('selection.entity') !== 'permission', ['integer', 'min:1'], ['string', 'max:255'])], 'selection.label' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
74:             'mentions' => ['nullable', 'array', 'max:25'], 'mentions.*.entity' => ['required', 'in:branch,user,role,location,customer,category,product,variant'], 'mentions.*.id' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1'],
75:             'attachments' => ['nullable', 'array', 'max:4'], 'attachments.*' => ['required', 'string', 'ulid', 'distinct'],
76:         ]);
77:     }
78: }
````

````php
  1: <?php
````

````php
 18: use Illuminate\Routing\Controllers\Middleware;
 19: 
 20: /**
 21:  * Admin controller for brand catalog management, logo uploads, and product associations.
 22:  */
 23: class BrandController extends Controller implements HasMiddleware
 24: {
 25:     public function __construct(private BrandService $service) {}
 26: 
 27:     public static function middleware(): array
 28:     {
 29:         return [
 30:             new Middleware('can:brands.view', only: ['index', 'show']),
 31:             new Middleware('can:brands.create', only: ['store']),
 32:             new Middleware('can:brands.update', only: ['update']),
 33:             new Middleware('can:brands.delete', only: ['destroy']),
 34:         ];
 35:     }
 36: 
 37:     /**
 38:      * Lists paginated brands with search, status filtering, and product counts.
 39:      *
 40:      * @param Request $request Filter query request
 41:      * @return AnonymousResourceCollection Paginated brand collection
 42:      */
 43:     public function index(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
 44:     {
 45:         $filters = $request->validate([
 46:             'search' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
 47:             'is_active' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
 48:             'per_page' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
 49:         ]);
 50: 
 51:         $perPage = min((int) ($filters['per_page'] ?? 15), 100);
 52: 
 53:         $brands = Brand::query()
 54:             ->with('media')
 55:             // Expose trashed-inclusive count so clients can distinguish active vs soft-deleted product dependencies.
 56:             ->withCount(['products', 'products as all_products_count' => fn ($q) => $q->withTrashed()])
 57:             ->when(isset($filters['search']) && $filters['search'] !== '', function ($query) use ($filters): void {
 58:                 $pattern = SearchTerm::pattern($filters['search']);
 59:                 $query->where(fn ($q) => $q->whereLike('name_ar', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)
 60:                     ->orWhereLike('name_en', $pattern, caseSensitive: false));
 61:             })
 62:             ->when(isset($filters['is_active']), fn ($query) => $query->where('is_active', filter_var($filters['is_active'], FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN)))
 63:             ->orderBy('sort_order')
 64:             ->orderBy('id')
 65:             ->paginate($perPage)
 66:             ->withQueryString();
 67: 
 68:         return BrandResource::collection($brands);
 69:     }
 70: 
 71:     /**
 72:      * Retrieves a single brand with its logo and product counts.
 73:      *
 74:      * @param Brand $brand Target brand
 75:      * @return BrandResource Brand resource
 76:      */
 77:     public function show(Brand $brand): BrandResource
 78:     {
 79:         return $this->brandResource($brand);
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     /**
 83:      * Creates a new brand with an optional logo image.
 84:      *
 85:      * @param StoreBrandRequest $request Validated creation request
 86:      * @return JsonResponse Created brand resource response
 87:      */
 88:     public function store(StoreBrandRequest $request): JsonResponse
 89:     {
 90:         $brand = $this->service->create($request->validated(), $request->file('logo'));
 91: 
 92:         return $this->brandResource($brand)->response()->setStatusCode(201);
 93:     }
 94: 
 95:     /**
 96:      * Updates brand metadata and optionally replaces its logo.
 97:      *
 98:      * @param UpdateBrandRequest $request Validated update request
 99:      * @param Brand $brand Target brand
100:      * @return BrandResource Updated brand resource
101:      */
102:     public function update(UpdateBrandRequest $request, Brand $brand): BrandResource
103:     {
104:         // Multipart file updates require POST with _method=PUT because PHP does not parse multipart on PUT.
105:         $brand = $this->service->update($brand, $request->validated(), $request->file('logo'));
106: 
107:         return $this->brandResource($brand);
108:     }
109: 
110:     /**
111:      * Deletes a brand if it has no associated products.
112:      *
113:      * @param Brand $brand Target brand
114:      * @return JsonResponse Deletion confirmation
115:      */
116:     public function destroy(Brand $brand): JsonResponse

119: 
120:         return response()->json(['message' => 'تم الحذف']);
121:     }
122: 
123:     private function brandResource(Brand $brand): BrandResource
124:     {

126: 
127:         return BrandResource::make($brand);
128:     }
129: }
````

````php
 33:             new Middleware('can:categories.update', only: ['update', 'reorder']),
 34:             new Middleware('can:categories.delete', only: ['destroy']),
 35:         ];
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     /**
 39:      * Lists categories as either a paginated list or a hierarchical tree.
 40:      *
 41:      * @param Request $request Filter query request
 42:      * @return AnonymousResourceCollection Category resources
 43:      */
 44:     public function index(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
 45:     {
 46:         $filters = $request->validate([
 47:             'tree' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
 48:             'search' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
 49:             'parent_id' => ['nullable', 'string', 'regex:/^(root|[0-9]{1,18})$/'],
 50:             'is_active' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
 51:             'per_page' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
 52:         ]);
 53: 
 54:         if ($request->boolean('tree')) {
 55:             return CategoryResource::collection($this->service->tree());
 56:         }
 57: 
 58:         $perPage = min((int) ($filters['per_page'] ?? 15), 100);
 59: 
 60:         $categories = Category::query()
 61:             ->with(['parent.media', 'media'])
 62:             // Expose trashed-inclusive count so clients can distinguish active vs soft-deleted product dependencies.
 63:             ->withCount(['products', 'products as all_products_count' => fn ($q) => $q->withTrashed()])
 64:             ->when(isset($filters['search']) && $filters['search'] !== '', function ($query) use ($filters): void {
 65:                 $pattern = SearchTerm::pattern($filters['search']);
 66:                 $query->where(fn ($q) => $q->whereLike('name_ar', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)
 67:                     ->orWhereLike('name_en', $pattern, caseSensitive: false));
 68:             })
 69:             ->when(isset($filters['parent_id']), function ($query) use ($filters): void {
 70:                 if ($filters['parent_id'] === 'root') {
 71:                     $query->whereNull('parent_id');
 72:                 } else {
 73:                     $query->where('parent_id', (int) $filters['parent_id']);
 74:                 }
 75:             })
 76:             ->when(isset($filters['is_active']), fn ($query) => $query->where('is_active', filter_var($filters['is_active'], FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN)))
 77:             ->orderBy('sort_order')
 78:             ->orderBy('id')
 79:             ->paginate($perPage)
 80:             ->withQueryString();
 81: 
 82:         return CategoryResource::collection($categories);
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     /**
 86:      * Retrieves details of a specific category including its child subcategories.
 87:      *
 88:      * @param Category $category Target category
 89:      * @return CategoryResource Category resource
 90:      */
 91:     public function show(Category $category): CategoryResource
 92:     {
 93:         return $this->categoryResource($category, includeChildren: true);
 94:     }
 95: 
 96:     /**
 97:      * Creates a new category with an optional image.
 98:      *
 99:      * @param StoreCategoryRequest $request Validated creation request
100:      * @return JsonResponse Created category response
101:      */
102:     public function store(StoreCategoryRequest $request): JsonResponse
103:     {
104:         $category = $this->service->create($request->validated(), $request->file('image'));
105: 
106:         return $this->categoryResource($category)->response()->setStatusCode(201);
107:     }
108: 
109:     /**
110:      * Updates category attributes, parent nesting, or image.
111:      *
112:      * @param UpdateCategoryRequest $request Validated update request
113:      * @param Category $category Target category
114:      * @return CategoryResource Updated category resource
115:      */
116:     public function update(UpdateCategoryRequest $request, Category $category): CategoryResource
117:     {
118:         // Multipart file updates require POST with _method=PUT because PHP does not parse multipart on PUT.
119:         $category = $this->service->update($category, $request->validated(), $request->file('image'));
120: 
121:         return $this->categoryResource($category);
122:     }
123: 
124:     /**
125:      * Deletes a category if it has no associated products or subcategories.
126:      *
127:      * @param Category $category Target category
128:      * @return JsonResponse Deletion confirmation
129:      */
130:     public function destroy(Category $category): JsonResponse
131:     {
132:         $this->service->delete($category);
133: 
134:         return response()->json(['message' => 'تم الحذف']);
135:     }
136: 
137:     /**
138:      * Reorders category display priority.
139:      *
140:      * @param ReorderCategoriesRequest $request Request with ordered items
141:      * @return JsonResponse Reorder confirmation
142:      */
143:     public function reorder(ReorderCategoriesRequest $request): JsonResponse
144:     {
145:         $this->service->reorder($request->validated()['items']);
146: 
147:         return response()->json(['message' => 'تم الترتيب']);
148:     }
149: 
150:     private function categoryResource(Category $category, bool $includeChildren = false): CategoryResource
151:     {
152:         $relations = $includeChildren ? ['parent.media', 'children.media', 'media'] : ['parent.media', 'media'];
153:         $category->loadMissing($relations)->loadCount(['products', 'products as all_products_count' => fn ($q) => $q->withTrashed()]);
154: 
155:         return CategoryResource::make($category);
156:     }
157: }
````

````php
 18: use App\Services\SearchTerm;
 19: use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
 20: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 21: use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\AnonymousResourceCollection;
 22: use Illuminate\Routing\Controllers\HasMiddleware;
 23: use Illuminate\Routing\Controllers\Middleware;
 24: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
 25: 
 26: class ProductController extends Controller implements HasMiddleware
 27: {
 28:     public function __construct(private ProductService $service) {}
 29: 
 30:     public static function middleware(): array
 31:     {
 32:         return [
 33:             new Middleware('can:products.view', only: ['index', 'show']),
 34:             new Middleware('can:products.create', only: ['store']),
 35:             new Middleware('can:products.update', only: ['update']),
 36:             new Middleware('can:products.delete', only: ['destroy']),
 37:         ];
 38:     }
 39: 
 40:     public function index(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
 41:     {
 42:         // فلاتر القائمة بتتفحص الأول: أي قيمة غلط تبقى 422 بدل 500 من Postgres
 43:         $filters = $request->validate([
 44:             'search' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
 45:             'category_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', Rule::exists('categories', 'id')->whereNull('deleted_at')],
 46:             'brand_id' => ['prohibited'],
 47:             'status' => ['nullable', Rule::enum(ProductStatus::class)],
 48:             'sales_channel' => ['nullable', Rule::enum(SalesChannel::class)],
 49:             'is_featured' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
 50:             'include_children' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
 51:             'sort' => ['nullable', Rule::in(['latest', 'oldest', 'name'])],
 52:             'per_page' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
 53:         ]);
 54: 
 55:         $perPage = min((int) ($filters['per_page'] ?? 15), 100);
 56: 
 57:         $q = Product::query()
 58:             ->with(['category.media', 'media' => fn ($media) => $media->where('collection_name', 'images')->orderBy('order_column')->orderBy('id')->limit(1)])
 59:             ->withCount('variants')
 60:             ->withMin(['variants as min_retail_price' => fn ($v) => $v->where('is_active', true)], 'retail_price')
 61:             ->withMax(['variants as max_retail_price' => fn ($v) => $v->where('is_active', true)], 'retail_price');
 62: 
 63:         if (isset($filters['search']) && $filters['search'] !== '') {
 64:             $s = $filters['search'];
 65:             $pattern = SearchTerm::pattern($s);
 66:             // F15: SKUs/barcodes/codes are stored uppercased — match
 67:             // case-insensitively so a lowercase search still finds them.
 68:             // LOWER() comparisons stay index-backed via the lower(sku) /
 69:             // lower(barcode) functional unique indexes.
 70:             $u = strtoupper($s);
 71:             $q->where(fn ($w) => $w->whereLike('name_ar', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)
 72:                 ->orWhereLike('name_en', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)
 73:                 ->orWhere('code', $u)
 74:                 ->orWhereIn('products.id', ProductVariant::query()->select('product_id')
 75:                     ->where(fn ($v) => $v->whereRaw('LOWER(sku) = LOWER(?)', [$s])->orWhereRaw('LOWER(barcode) = LOWER(?)', [$s]))));
 76:         }
 77:         if (! empty($filters['category_id'])) {
 78:             $cat = Category::findOrFail($filters['category_id']);
 79:             $ids = ! empty($filters['include_children']) ? [$cat->id, ...$cat->descendantIds()] : [$cat->id];
 80:             $q->whereIn('category_id', $ids);
 81:         }
 82:         $q->when($filters['status'] ?? null, fn ($x, $v) => $x->where('status', $v))
 83:             ->when($filters['sales_channel'] ?? null, fn ($x, $v) => $x->where('sales_channel', $v))
 84:             ->when(isset($filters['is_featured']), fn ($x) => $x->where('is_featured', filter_var($filters['is_featured'], FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN)));
 85: 
 86:         // ترتيب ثابت: id مفتاح كاسر للتعادل عشان الصفحات متتكررش ولا تختفي منها عناصر
 87:         match ($filters['sort'] ?? 'latest') {
 88:             'oldest' => $q->oldest()->orderBy('id'),
 89:             'name' => $q->orderBy('name_en')->orderBy('id'),
 90:             default => $q->latest()->orderByDesc('id'),
 91:         };
 92: 
 93:         $paginator = $q->paginate($perPage)->withQueryString();
 94: 
 95:         return ProductResource::collection($paginator);
 96:     }
 97: 
 98:     public function show(Product $product): ProductResource
 99:     {
100:         return $this->productResource($product);
101:     }
102: 
103:     public function store(StoreProductRequest $request): JsonResponse
104:     {
105:         $data = $this->filterCostPrices($request->validated(), $request);
106:         $product = $this->service->create($data, $request->user());
107: 
108:         return $this->productResource($product)->response()->setStatusCode(201);
109:     }
110: 
111:     public function update(UpdateProductRequest $request, Product $product): ProductResource
112:     {
113:         $product = $this->service->update($product, $request->validated(), $request->user());
114: 
115:         return $this->productResource($product);
116:     }
117: 
118:     public function destroy(Request $request, Product $product): JsonResponse
119:     {
120:         $this->service->delete($product, $request->user());
121: 
122:         return response()->json(['message' => 'تم الحذف']);
123:     }
124: 
125:     private function productResource(Product $product): ProductResource
126:     {
127:         $product->loadMissing(['category.media', 'variants.media', 'media']);
128: 
129:         return ProductResource::make($product);
130:     }
131: 
132:     /**
133:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
134:      * @return array<string, mixed>
135:      */
136:     private function filterCostPrices(array $data, Request $request): array
137:     {
138:         if (! CostAccess::canView($request->user())) {
139:             foreach ($data['variants'] ?? [] as $index => $variant) {
140:                 unset($data['variants'][$index]['cost_price']);
141:             }
142:         }
143: 
144:         return $data;
145:     }
146: }
````

## File: backend/app/Http/Requests/Admin/Category/ReorderCategoriesRequest.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin\Category;
 6: 
 7: use App\Http\Requests\Admin\Concerns\LimitsArrayInput;
 8: use App\Models\Category;
 9: use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule;
10: use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
11: use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;
12: 
13: class ReorderCategoriesRequest extends FormRequest
14: {
15:     use LimitsArrayInput;
16: 
17:     protected function arrayLimits(): array
18:     {
19:         return ['items' => 500];
20:     }
21: 
22:     public function authorize(): bool
23:     {
24:         return $this->user() !== null;
25:     }
26: 
27:     /**
28:      * @return array<string, array<mixed>|string|ValidationRule>
29:      */
30:     public function rules(): array
31:     {
32:         return [
33:             'items' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1', 'max:500'],
34:             'items.*.id' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1', 'distinct'],
35:             'items.*.parent_id' => ['present', 'nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
36:             'items.*.sort_order' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:2147483647'],
37:         ];
38:     }
39: 
40:     public function after(): array
41:     {
42:         return [function (Validator $validator): void {
43:             if ($validator->errors()->isNotEmpty()) {
44:                 return;
45:             }
46:             $items = $this->input('items');
47:             $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_merge(array_column($items, 'id'), array_column($items, 'parent_id')), fn ($id) => $id !== null)));
48:             $available = array_fill_keys(Category::query()->whereIn('id', $ids)->pluck('id')->all(), true);
49:             foreach ($items as $index => $item) {
50:                 foreach (['id', 'parent_id'] as $field) {
51:                     if ($item[$field] !== null && ! isset($available[$item[$field]])) {
52:                         $validator->errors()->add("items.{$index}.{$field}", 'القسم المحدد غير موجود أو محذوف');
53:                     }
54:                 }
55:             }
56:         }];
57:     }
58: }
````

````php

10: /**
11:  * تحقق وجود المتغيرات باستعلام واحد مجمّع (whereIn) بدل Rule::exists لكل عنصر —
12:  * جرد/تحويل من 500 صنف كان ينفذ 500 استعلام قبل بدء العمل أصلًا (M11).
13:  * النشاط (is_active) لا يُفحص هنا: عمليات الإخراج مسموحة على المعطّل (M5)،
14:  * والإدخال يُحظر في الخدمة نفسها.
15:  */
16: trait BulkVariantExists
17: {
18:     protected function addBulkVariantExistsCheck(Validator $validator, bool $activeOnly = false): void
19:     {
20:         $validator->after(function (Validator $v) use ($activeOnly): void {
21:             if ($v->errors()->isNotEmpty()) {
22:                 return;
23:             }
24:             $items = $this->input('items', []);
25:             if (! is_array($items) || $items === []) {
26:                 return;
27:             }
28: 
29:             $ids = collect($items)
30:                 ->pluck('product_variant_id')
31:                 ->filter(fn ($id) => is_numeric($id))
32:                 ->map(fn ($id) => (int) $id)
33:                 ->unique()
34:                 ->values();
35: 
36:             if ($ids->isEmpty()) {
37:                 return;
38:             }
39: 
40:             // withTrashed: متغير محذوف ناعمًا وله رصيد لا يجب أن يُحبس رصيده —
41:             // عمليات الإخراج (تسوية/جرد/تحويل) تظل ممكنة عليه لتصفيته (M-9)،
42:             // والإدخال عليه محظور في InventoryService لأنه يعامل كمعطّل.
43:             $query = ProductVariant::query()->whereIn('id', $ids);
44:             if ($activeOnly) {
45:                 $query->where('is_active', true)->whereHas('product');
46:             } else {
47:                 $query->withTrashed();
48:             }
49:             $found = $query->pluck('id')->map(fn ($id) => (int) $id)->all();
50:             $missing = $ids->diff($found);
51: 
52:             if ($missing->isEmpty()) {
53:                 return;
54:             }
55: 
56:             foreach ($items as $i => $item) {
57:                 if (isset($item['product_variant_id']) && $missing->contains((int) $item['product_variant_id'])) {
58:                     $v->errors()->add("items.{$i}.product_variant_id", 'المتغير المحدد غير موجود.');
59:                 }
60:             }
61:         });
62:     }
63: }
````

## File: backend/app/Http/Requests/Admin/Concerns/LimitsArrayInput.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin\Concerns;
 6: 
 7: use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
 8: 
 9: trait LimitsArrayInput
10: {
11:     use NormalizesCatalogInput;
12: 
13:     protected function prepareForValidation(): void
14:     {
15:         parent::prepareForValidation();
16: 
17:         // Reject before Laravel expands wildcard rules and runs per-item queries.
18:         foreach ($this->arrayLimits() as $field => $limit) {
19:             $value = $this->input($field) ?? $this->file($field);
20:             if (is_array($value) && count($value) > $limit) {
21:                 throw ValidationException::withMessages([$field => "الحد الأقصى لعدد العناصر هو {$limit}"]);
22:             }
23:         }
24:         $this->normalizeCatalogIdentifiers();
25:     }
26: 
27:     abstract protected function arrayLimits(): array;
28: }
````

## File: backend/app/Http/Requests/Admin/Concerns/NormalizesCatalogInput.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin\Concerns;
 6: 
 7: trait NormalizesCatalogInput
 8: {
 9:     protected function normalizeCatalogIdentifiers(): void
10:     {
11:         // L3: barcodes are case-insensitive-unique — normalize to uppercase like
12:         // SKUs so abc and ABC cannot coexist as separate rows.
13:         $changes = [];
14:         foreach (['slug' => 'strtolower', 'sku' => 'strtoupper', 'barcode' => 'strtoupper'] as $field => $normalize) {
15:             if (is_string($value = $this->input($field))) {
16:                 $changes[$field] = $normalize($value);
17:             }
18:         }
19:         if (is_array($variants = $this->input('variants'))) {
20:             foreach ($variants as &$variant) {
21:                 if (is_array($variant) && isset($variant['sku']) && is_string($variant['sku'])) {
22:                     $variant['sku'] = strtoupper($variant['sku']);
23:                 }
24:                 if (is_array($variant) && isset($variant['barcode']) && is_string($variant['barcode'])) {
25:                     $variant['barcode'] = strtoupper($variant['barcode']);
26:                 }
27:             }
28:             unset($variant);
29:             $changes['variants'] = $variants;
30:         }
31:         $this->merge($changes);
32:     }
33: }
````

````php
 32: 
 33:     /**
 34:      * @return array<string, array<mixed>|string|ValidationRule>
 35:      */
 36:     public static function baseRules(): array
 37:     {
 38:         return [
 39:             'category_id' => ['required', 'integer', Rule::exists('categories', 'id')->whereNull('deleted_at')],
 40:             'brand_id' => ['prohibited'],
 41:             'supplier_id' => ['prohibited'],
 42:             'name_ar' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
 43:             'name_en' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
 44:             'slug' => ['nullable', 'alpha_dash:ascii', 'max:255', new UniqueCatalogIdentifier('products', 'slug')],
 45:             'description_ar' => ['nullable', 'string'],
 46:             'description_en' => ['nullable', 'string'],
 47:             'material_ar' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:150'],
 48:             'material_en' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:150'],
 49:             'length_cm' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:999999.99'],
 50:             'width_cm' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:999999.99'],
 51:             'height_cm' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:999999.99'],
 52:             'weight_kg' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:99999.999'],
 53:             'warranty_months' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:120'],
 54:             'warranty_details' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
 55:             'country_of_origin' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
 56:             'status' => ['nullable', Rule::in(['draft'])],
 57:             'sales_channel' => ['required', Rule::enum(SalesChannel::class)],
 58:             'is_featured' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
 59:             'occasions' => ['sometimes', 'nullable', 'array', 'max:4'],
 60:             'occasions.*' => ['string', 'distinct', Rule::enum(Occasion::class)],
 61:             'badge_en' => ['sometimes', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:30'],
 62:             'badge_ar' => ['sometimes', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:30'],
 63:         ];
 64:     }
 65: 
 66:     /**
 67:      * @return array<string, array<mixed>|string|ValidationRule>
 68:      */
 69:     public function rules(): array
 70:     {
 71:         $rules = array_merge(self::baseRules(), [
 72:             // F9: idempotency key for product creation — one UUID per creation
 73:             // session, reused across retries so a lost response cannot duplicate.
 74:             'create_key' => ['nullable', 'uuid'],
 75:             // اختياري: متغيرات مع الإنشاء
 76:             'variants' => ['nullable', 'array', 'max:100'],
 77:             'variants.*' => ['array:'.implode(',', array_keys(VariantRules::base()))],
 78:         ]);
 79: 
 80:         foreach (VariantRules::base(null, 'variants.*.') as $field => $rule) {
 81:             if (in_array($field, ['sku', 'barcode'], true)) {
 82:                 $rule[] = 'distinct';
 83:             }
 84:             $rules["variants.*.$field"] = $rule;
 85:         }
 86: 
 87:         // A replay with an explicit slug/SKU now legitimately collides with
 88:         // its own saved rows. The service verifies the request fingerprint
 89:         // and returns the saved product before any write.
 90:         $key = $this->input('create_key');
 91:         if (is_string($key) && Str::isUuid($key)
 92:             && Product::withTrashed()->where('created_by', $this->user()->id)->where('create_key', $key)->exists()) {
 93:             foreach ($rules as $field => $rule) {
 94:                 if (is_array($rule)) {
 95:                     $rules[$field] = array_values(array_filter($rule, fn ($item) => ! $item instanceof UniqueCatalogIdentifier
 96:                         && ! $item instanceof Unique));
 97:                 }
 98:             }
 99:         }
100: 
101:         return $rules;
102:     }
103: }
````

## File: backend/app/Http/Requests/Admin/Variant/UpdateVariantRequest.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2:

 4: 
 5: namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin\Variant;

 7: use App\Http\Requests\Admin\Concerns\NormalizesCatalogInput;

10: use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;
11: 
12: class UpdateVariantRequest extends FormRequest
13: {
14:     use NormalizesCatalogInput;
15: 
16:     protected function prepareForValidation(): void
17:     {
18:         parent::prepareForValidation();
19:         $this->normalizeCatalogIdentifiers();
20:     }
21: 
22:     public function authorize(): bool
23:     {
24:         return $this->user() !== null;
25:     }
26: 
27:     /**
28:      * @return array<string, array<mixed>|string|ValidationRule>
29:      */
30:     public function rules(): array
31:     {
32:         $rules = VariantRules::base($this->route('variant')->id);
33: 
34:         foreach ($rules as $field => $rule) {
35:             if ($field === 'color_name_en') {
36:                 $rule = array_values(array_filter($rule, fn ($value) => ! is_string($value) || ! str_starts_with($value, 'required_with:')));
37:             }
38:             if ($field === 'sku') {
39:                 $rule = array_values(array_filter($rule, fn ($value) => $value !== 'nullable'));
40:                 array_unshift($rule, 'required');
41:             }
42:             array_unshift($rule, 'sometimes');
43:             $rules[$field] = $rule;
44:         }
45: 
46:         // M5: رقم الإصدار إلزامي — الكتابة فوق أسعار (retail/wholesale) برقم
47:         // قديم دون 409 كانت تضيّع تعديلات أسعار حقيقية.
48:         $rules['expected_version'] = ['required', 'integer', 'min:0'];
49: 
50:         return $rules;
51:     }
52: 
53:     /**
54:      * M5: فترة انتقالية — العملاء القدامى الذين لا يرسلون رقم الإصدار
55:      * يُرفضون بـ 422، مع تسجيل تحذير لقياس حجمهم قبل الإلزام الكامل.
56:      */
57:     protected function failedValidation(\Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\Validator $validator): void
58:     {
59:         if ($validator->errors()->has('expected_version')) {
60:             \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::warning('variant.update_without_expected_version', [
61:                 'user_id' => $this->user()?->id,
62:                 'variant_id' => $this->route('variant')?->id,
63:                 'has_version' => $this->filled('expected_version'),
64:             ]);
65:         }
66: 
67:         parent::failedValidation($validator);
68:     }
69: 
70:     public function after(): array
71:     {
72:         return [function (Validator $validator): void {
73:             $color = array_replace($this->route('variant')->only(['color_name_en', 'color_name_ar', 'color_hex']), $this->only(['color_name_en', 'color_name_ar', 'color_hex']));
74:             if ((filled($color['color_name_ar']) || filled($color['color_hex'])) && blank($color['color_name_en'])) {
75:                 $validator->errors()->add('color_name_en', 'اسم اللون الإنجليزي مطلوب عند وجود بيانات لون');
76:             }
77:         }];
78:     }
79: }
````

## File: backend/app/Http/Requests/Admin/Variant/VariantRules.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin\Variant;
 6: 
 7: use App\Models\ProductVariant;
 8: use App\Rules\UniqueCatalogIdentifier;
 9: use Closure;
10: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
11: 
12: // قواعد الـ validation المشتركة لمتغيرات المنتج — تُستخدم في إنشاء/تعديل المتغير وفي variants.* عند إنشاء منتج.
13: class VariantRules
14: {
15:     /**
16:      * @return array<string, array<mixed>>
17:      */
18:     public static function base(?int $ignoreId = null, string $prefix = ''): array
19:     {
20:         return [
21:             'sku' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:64', 'alpha_dash:ascii', new UniqueCatalogIdentifier('product_variants', 'sku', $ignoreId)],
22:             'barcode' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:32', 'regex:/^[0-9A-Za-z\-]+$/', Rule::unique('product_variants', 'barcode')->ignore($ignoreId),
23:                 // صيغة 2 + 12 رقم محجوزة للباركود الداخلي اللي النظام بيولّده من id المتغير (M3)
24:                 function (string $attribute, mixed $value, Closure $fail) use ($ignoreId): void {
25:                     if (is_string($value) && preg_match('/^2\d{12}$/', $value) === 1) {
26:                         $current = $ignoreId !== null
27:                             ? ProductVariant::whereKey($ignoreId)->value('barcode')
28:                             : null;
29:                         if ($value !== $current) {
30:                             $fail('صيغة الباركود دي محجوزة لباركودات النظام الداخلية');
31:                         }
32:                     }
33:                 },
34:             ],
35:             'color_name_ar' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50'],
36:             // اسم اللون الإنجليزي هو مفتاح منع التكرار، فبيبقى مطلوب لو أي بيانات لون تانية موجودة
37:             'color_name_en' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50', 'required_with:'.$prefix.'color_name_ar,'.$prefix.'color_hex'],
38:             'color_hex' => ['nullable', 'regex:/^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$/'],
39:             'size' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50'],
40:             'capacity' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50'],
41:             'cost_price' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'decimal:0,4', 'min:0', 'max:9999999'],
42:             'retail_price' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'decimal:0,2', 'min:0', 'max:9999999'],
````

````php
125:             $expected = is_array($body['expected'] ?? null) ? $body['expected'] : [];
126:             foreach (array_diff($changed, array_keys($expected)) as $key) {
127:                 $validator->errors()->add('expected.'.$key, 'القيمة الأصلية مطلوبة لهذا الإعداد.');
128:             }
129:             foreach (array_diff(array_keys($expected), $changed) as $key) {
130:                 $validator->errors()->add('expected.'.$key, 'قيمة أصلية غير مرتبطة بإعداد معدل.');
131:             }
132:             foreach ($unknownKeys as $unknownKey) {
133:                 $validator->errors()->add($unknownKey, 'إعداد غير معروف.');
134:             }
135:         });
136:     }
````

## File: backend/app/Jobs/PruneAiConversations.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Jobs;
 6: 
 7: use App\Models\AiConversation;
 8: use App\Models\AiPendingAction;
 9: use App\Services\SettingService;
10: use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
11: use Illuminate\Foundation\Queue\Queueable;
12: 
13: class PruneAiConversations implements ShouldQueue
14: {
15:     use Queueable;
16: 
17:     public function handle(SettingService $settings): void
18:     {
19:         $days = max(1, (int) $settings->get('ai_retention_days', 180));
20:         // H3/M4: المرفقات على القرص المشترك الخاص، وforceDelete يحذف صفوف
21:         // ai_attachments عبر cascade لكن ليس الملفات — نحذف مجلد المحادثة
22:         // بعد نجاح الحذف حتى لا تتسرب صور بعد فترة الاحتفاظ.
23:         $disk = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage::disk('ai_private');
24:         AiConversation::withTrashed()->whereRaw('COALESCE(last_message_at, created_at) < ?', [now()->subDays($days)])->chunkById(100, function ($conversations) use ($disk): void {
25:             foreach ($conversations as $conversation) {
26:                 $conversationId = $conversation->id;
27:                 $conversation->forceDelete();
28:                 try {
29:                     $disk->deleteDirectory("ai-attachments/{$conversationId}");
30:                 } catch (\Throwable $e) {
31:                     report($e);
32:                 }
33:             }
34:         });
35:         AiPendingAction::query()->where('status', 'pending')->where('expires_at', '<', now())->update(['status' => 'expired']);
36:         AiPendingAction::query()->where('status', 'bulk_child')->where('expires_at', '<', now())->update(['status' => 'expired']);
37:         // M10: كارت جماعي اتحجز confirmed وما اتنفذش (العملية اتقطعت) —
38:         // يتقفل برسالة مفهومة بدل ما يفضل عالق للأبد.
39:         // M-4: الأبناء غير المنفذين (pending/bulk_child) يُلغون مع الأب حتى
40:         // لا يبقوا قابلين للتأكيد الفردي بلا سجل يربطهم بالعملية الأصلية.
41:         AiPendingAction::query()->where('status', 'confirmed')->where('tool', 'bulk_actions')->where('updated_at', '<', now()->subMinutes(5))
42:             ->chunkById(100, function ($parents): void {
43:                 foreach ($parents as $parent) {
44:                     $childIds = $parent->args['action_ids'] ?? [];
45:                     if (is_array($childIds) && $childIds !== []) {
46:                         AiPendingAction::query()->whereIn('id', $childIds)->whereIn('status', ['pending', 'bulk_child'])->update(['status' => 'cancelled']);
47:                     }
48:                     $parent->forceFill(['status' => 'failed', 'result' => ['message' => 'العملية الجماعية انتهت من غير تنفيذ كامل. اطلب اقتراح جديد.']])->save();
49:                 }
50:             });
51:         // 0.3/M2: أي action فضل confirmed أكتر من 10 دقايق (تنفيذ خارج
52:         // المعاملة انقطع قبل finalize) يتحوّل لـ failed. الإعادة idempotent
53:         // بفضل client_upload_id الحتمي، فالرسالة توجّه لمراجعة الحالة
54:         // بدل إعادة عمياء.
55:         AiPendingAction::query()->where('status', 'confirmed')->where('tool', '!=', 'bulk_actions')->where('updated_at', '<', now()->subMinutes(10))
56:             ->chunkById(100, function ($actions): void {
57:                 foreach ($actions as $action) {
58:                     $action->forceFill(['status' => 'failed', 'result' => ['message' => 'الحالة غير مؤكدة؛ راجع صور المنتج']])->save();
59:                 }
60:             });
61:         // 4.1: مسح الملفات اللي ما اتستخدمتش بعد 24 ساعة
62:         if (\Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema::hasTable('ai_attachments')) {
63:             \App\Models\AiAttachment::query()->whereNull('consumed_at')->where('created_at', '<', now()->subHours(24))
64:                 ->chunkById(100, function ($attachments) use ($disk): void {
65:                     foreach ($attachments as $attachment) {
66:                         $disk->delete($attachment->path);
67:                         $attachment->delete();
68:                     }
69:                 });
70:         }
71:     }
72: }
````

## File: backend/app/Jobs/RefreshCatalogRetailPrices.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Jobs;
 6: 
 7: use App\Services\Catalog\RetailPriceSnapshot;
 8: use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldBeUniqueUntilProcessing;
 9: use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
10: use Illuminate\Foundation\Queue\Queueable;
11: 
12: /**
13:  * Queued unique job refreshing denormalized catalog minimum retail prices and stock availability snapshots.
14:  */
15: class RefreshCatalogRetailPrices implements ShouldBeUniqueUntilProcessing, ShouldQueue
16: {
17:     use Queueable;
18: 
19:     public int $uniqueFor = 300;
20: 
21:     public int $tries = 3;
22: 
23:     public int $timeout = 120;
24: 
25:     public bool $failOnTimeout = true;
26: 
27:     public function __construct(public int|array|null $productId = null)
28:     {
29:         $this->afterCommit();
30:     }
31: 
32:     /**
33:      * Resolves the cache lock key ensuring deduplication while job is queued or executing.
34:      *
35:      * @return string Unique job identifier
36:      */
37:     public function uniqueId(): string
38:     {
39:         if (is_array($this->productId)) {
40:             $ids = array_unique($this->productId);
41:             sort($ids);
42: 
43:             return 'catalog-retail:batch:'.hash('sha256', json_encode($ids));
44:         }
45: 
46:         return 'catalog-retail:'.($this->productId ?? 'all');
47:     }
48: 
49:     /**
50:      * Executes the snapshot refresh calculation.
51:      *
52:      * @param  RetailPriceSnapshot  $snapshots  Snapshot calculation service
53:      */
54:     public function handle(RetailPriceSnapshot $snapshots): void
55:     {
56:         $snapshots->refresh($this->productId);
57:     }
58: }
````

````php
  1: <?php
````

````php
  5: namespace App\Models;
  6: 
  7: use App\Enums\ProductStatus;
  8: use App\Enums\SalesChannel;
  9: use App\Models\Concerns\TracksEditVersion;
 10: use Database\Factories\CategoryFactory;
 11: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
 12: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
 13: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
 14: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
 15: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
 16: use Spatie\Image\Enums\Fit;
 17: use Spatie\MediaLibrary\HasMedia;
 18: use Spatie\MediaLibrary\InteractsWithMedia;
 19: use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
 20: 
 21: class Category extends Model implements HasMedia
 22: {
 23:     /** @use HasFactory<CategoryFactory> */
 24:     use HasFactory, InteractsWithMedia, SoftDeletes, TracksEditVersion;
 25: 
 26:     protected $fillable = ['parent_id', 'name_ar', 'name_en', 'slug', 'description_ar', 'description_en', 'sort_order', 'is_active'];
 27: 
 28:     protected $casts = ['is_active' => 'boolean', 'lock_version' => 'integer'];
 29: 
 30:     public function parent(): BelongsTo
 31:     {
 32:         return $this->belongsTo(Category::class, 'parent_id');
 33:     }
 34: 
 35:     public function children(): HasMany
 36:     {
 37:         return $this->hasMany(Category::class, 'parent_id')->orderBy('sort_order')->orderBy('id');
 38:     }
 39: 
 40:     public function products(): HasMany
 41:     {
 42:         return $this->hasMany(Product::class);
 43:     }
 44: 
 45:     /** المنتجات المنشورة فقط — أساس عدّادات أقسام المتجر. */
 46:     public function activeProducts(): HasMany
 47:     {
 48:         return $this->hasMany(Product::class)->where('status', ProductStatus::Published)
 49:             ->whereIn('sales_channel', [SalesChannel::Retail, SalesChannel::Both]);
 50:     }
 51: 
 52:     public function registerMediaCollections(): void
 53:     {
 54:         $this->addMediaCollection('image')->singleFile()->useDisk('r2_public')->storeConversionsOnDisk('r2_public')
 55:             ->acceptsMimeTypes(['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']);
 56:     }
 57: 
 58:     // L5: category tiles render small thumbs — generate them once instead of
 59:     // serving up-to-6000px originals in storefront tiles.
 60:     public function registerMediaConversions(?Media $media = null): void
 61:     {
 62:         $this->addMediaConversion('thumb')->fit(Fit::Crop, 300, 300)->format('webp')
 63:             ->performOnCollections('image');
 64:         $this->addMediaConversion('medium')->fit(Fit::Contain, 800, 800)->format('webp')
 65:             ->performOnCollections('image');
 66:     }
 67: 
 68:     // بيرجّع IDs كل الأقسام اللي تحته على أي مستوى — مجموعة visited بتمنع اللف اللانهائي لو فيه دورة في البيانات
 69:     public function descendantIds(): array
 70:     {
 71:         $ids = [];
 72:         $seen = [$this->id => true];
 73:         $queue = [$this->id];
 74:         while ($queue) {
 75:             $children = Category::whereIn('parent_id', $queue)->pluck('id')->all();
 76:             $queue = [];
 77:             foreach ($children as $childId) {
 78:                 if (! isset($seen[$childId])) {
 79:                     $seen[$childId] = true;
 80:                     $ids[] = $childId;
 81:                     $queue[] = $childId;
 82:                 }
 83:             }
 84:         }
 85: 
 86:         return $ids;
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     public function depth(): int
 90:     {
 91:         $depth = 1;
 92:         $seen = [$this->id => true];
 93:         $p = $this->parent;
 94:         while ($p) {
 95:             if (isset($seen[$p->id])) {
 96:                 throw new \RuntimeException('توجد دورة في شجرة الأقسام');
 97:             }
 98:             $seen[$p->id] = true;
 99:             $depth++;
100:             $p = $p->parent;
101:         }
102: 
103:         return $depth;
104:     }
105: }
````

## File: backend/app/Observers/CatalogRetailPriceObserver.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Observers;
  6: 
  7: use App\Jobs\RefreshCatalogRetailPrices;
  8: use App\Models\PriceListItem;
  9: use App\Models\ProductVariant;
 10: use App\Models\StockLevel;
 11: use Illuminate\Database\Connection;
 12: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
 13: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 14: 
 15: /**
 16:  * Monitors price list, variant, and stock mutations to batch-refresh catalog price snapshots across nested transactions.
 17:  */
 18: class CatalogRetailPriceObserver
 19: {
 20:     private int $batchDepth = 0;
 21: 
 22:     private array $pendingProductIds = [];
 23: 
 24:     private array $transactionSnapshots = [];
 25: 
 26:     /**
 27:      * Records pre-transaction state snapshot on connection begin.
 28:      *
 29:      * @param  Connection  $connection  Database connection instance
 30:      */
 31:     public function transactionBegan(Connection $connection): void
 32:     {
 33:         if ($this->batchDepth > 0 && $connection->getName() === config('database.default')) {
 34:             $this->transactionSnapshots[$connection->transactionLevel()] = $this->pendingProductIds;
 35:         }
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     /**
 39:      * Reverts pending IDs if transaction rolled back, or cleans up state on commit.
 40:      *
 41:      * @param  Connection  $connection  Database connection
 42:      * @param  bool  $rolledBack  Whether transaction rolled back
 43:      */
 44:     public function transactionFinished(Connection $connection, bool $rolledBack = false): void
 45:     {
 46:         if ($this->batchDepth === 0 || $connection->getName() !== config('database.default')) {
 47:             return;
 48:         }
 49:         $level = $connection->transactionLevel();
 50:         if ($rolledBack && isset($this->transactionSnapshots[$level + 1])) {
 51:             $this->pendingProductIds = $this->transactionSnapshots[$level + 1];
 52:         }
 53:         foreach (array_keys($this->transactionSnapshots) as $snapshotLevel) {
 54:             if ($snapshotLevel > $level) {
 55:                 unset($this->transactionSnapshots[$snapshotLevel]);
 56:             }
 57:         }
 58:     }
 59: 
 60:     /**
 61:      * Groups mutations in a closure to defer dispatching refresh job until outermost batch completes.
 62:      *
 63:      * @param  callable  $callback  Executable closure
 64:      * @return mixed Closure return value
 65:      */
 66:     public function batch(callable $callback): mixed
 67:     {
 68:         $previous = $this->pendingProductIds;
 69:         $this->batchDepth++;
 70:         try {
 71:             $result = $callback();
 72:         } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
 73:             $this->pendingProductIds = $previous;
 74:             throw $exception;
 75:         } finally {
 76:             $this->batchDepth--;
 77:             if ($this->batchDepth === 0) {
 78:                 $this->transactionSnapshots = [];
 79:             }
 80:         }
 81: 
 82:         if ($this->batchDepth === 0 && $this->pendingProductIds !== []) {
 83:             $ids = $this->pendingProductIds;
 84:             $this->pendingProductIds = [];
 85:             $this->dispatchRefresh($ids);
 86:         }
 87: 
 88:         return $result;
 89:     }
 90: 
 91:     public function saved(Model $model): void
 92:     {
 93:         $this->refresh($model);
 94:     }
 95: 
 96:     public function deleted(Model $model): void
 97:     {
 98:         $this->refresh($model);
 99:     }
100: 
101:     public function restored(Model $model): void
102:     {
103:         $this->refresh($model);
104:     }
105: 
106:     private function refresh(Model $model): void
107:     {
108:         $productIds = [];
109:         if ($model instanceof ProductVariant) {
110:             $productIds = [$model->product_id, $model->getRawOriginal('product_id')];
111:         } elseif ($model instanceof PriceListItem || $model instanceof StockLevel) {
112:             $variantIds = [$model->product_variant_id, $model->getRawOriginal('product_variant_id')];
113:             $loadedVariant = $model->relationLoaded('variant') ? $model->getRelation('variant') : null;
114:             if (! $model->wasChanged('product_variant_id') && $loadedVariant?->id === $model->product_variant_id && $loadedVariant->product_id !== null) {
115:                 $productIds = [$loadedVariant->product_id];
116:             } else {
117:                 $productIds = ProductVariant::withTrashed()->whereIn('id', array_filter($variantIds))->pluck('product_id')->all();
118:             }
119:         } else {
120:             $this->dispatchRefresh();
121: 
122:             return;
123:         }
124: 
125:         $clean = array_values(array_filter(array_unique(array_map('intval', $productIds))));
126:         if ($clean === []) {
127:             return;
128:         }
129: 
130:         if ($this->batchDepth > 0) {
131:             $this->pendingProductIds = array_values(array_unique(array_merge($this->pendingProductIds, $clean)));
132:         } else {
133:             $this->dispatchRefresh($clean);
134:         }
135:     }
136: 
137:     private function dispatchRefresh(int|array|null $productIds = null): void
138:     {
139:         // PendingDispatch acquires the unique lock before the job's afterCommit
140:         // setting takes effect. Defer dispatch itself so a database cache lock
141:         // collision cannot abort the transaction saving the model.
142:         DB::afterCommit(static function () use ($productIds): void {
143:             RefreshCatalogRetailPrices::dispatch($productIds);
144:         });
145:     }
146: }
````

````php
129:         // مستمعو نظام الإشعارات الموحد (المرحلة 13.1) يُكتشفون تلقائيًا من

329:             return [

336:         // حد الدخول الموحد: بالـ IP وبالمعرّف (بريد/هاتف) معًا
337:         RateLimiter::for('unified-login', function (Request $request) use ($networkIp) {
338:             // H2: طبّع المعرّف بنفس منطق CustomerAuthService::login، وإلا كانت

358:         RateLimiter::for('unified-handoff', fn (Request $request) => Limit::perMinute((int) config('auth.unified_handoff_ip_minute', 60))->by($networkIp($request)));
359:         RateLimiter::for('ai-chat', fn (Request $request) => Limit::perMinute(20)->by('ai-chat:'.($request->user('staff')?->id ?? $networkIp($request))));

361:         // M8: الـ handoff يعتمد على cache مشترك يدعم الأقفال عبر الخوادم.
362:         // file/array يكسرانه بصمت على عدة nodes — نبّه في الإنتاج مبكرًا.
363:         if ($this->app->environment('production')
364:             && ! in_array((string) config('cache.default'), ['redis', 'database', 'memcached', 'dynamodb'], true)) {
365:             throw new \LogicException('Staff handoff requires a shared lockable cache store in production. Use Redis or a shared database cache.');
366:         }

368: }
````

````php
 39:     public function kind(): ToolKind
 40:     {
 41:         return ToolKind::Write;
 42:     }
 43: 
 44:     public function risk(): string
 45:     {
 46:         return 'medium';
 47:     }
 48: 
 49:     public function permissions(): array
 50:     {
 51:         return ['products.update'];
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     public function declaration(): array
 55:     {
 56:         return [
 57:             'name' => $this->name(),
 58:             'description' => 'إضافة متغيرات جديدة لمنتج موجود عن طريق variant_matrix (colors × sizes × capacities). التركيبات الموجودة فعلًا بتتجاهل أوتوماتيك.',
 59:             'parameters' => [
 60:                 'type' => 'OBJECT',
 61:                 'required' => ['product_id', 'variant_matrix'],
 62:                 'properties' => (object) [
 63:                     'product_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 64:                     'variant_matrix' => [
 65:                         'type' => 'OBJECT',
 66:                         'properties' => (object) [
 67:                             'colors' => ['type' => 'ARRAY', 'items' => ['type' => 'STRING']],
 68:                             'sizes' => ['type' => 'ARRAY', 'items' => ['type' => 'STRING']],
 69:                             'capacities' => ['type' => 'ARRAY', 'items' => ['type' => 'STRING']],
 70:                         ],
 71:                     ],
 72:                     'default_prices' => [
 73:                         'type' => 'OBJECT',
 74:                         'properties' => (object) [
 75:                             'retail_price' => ['type' => 'NUMBER'],
 76:                             'wholesale_price' => ['type' => 'NUMBER'],
 77:                             'cost_price' => ['type' => 'NUMBER'],
 78:                         ],
 79:                     ],
 80:                 ],
 81:             ],
 82:         ];
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     public function prepare(User $actor, array $args): ToolOutcome
 86:     {
 87:         $args = CatalogArgs::normalizeDigitsInArray($args);
 88:         $product = Product::with('variants')->find((int) ($args['product_id'] ?? 0));
 89:         if (! $product) {
 90:             return ToolOutcome::denied('المنتج مش موجود.', auditable: false);
 91:         }
 92: 
 93:         $canViewCost = CostAccess::canView($actor);
 94:         $defaultPrices = is_array($args['default_prices'] ?? null) ? $args['default_prices'] : [];
 95:         if (! $canViewCost) {
 96:             unset($defaultPrices['cost_price'], $args['cost_price']);
 97:         }
 98: 
 99:         $activeSample = $product->variants->where('is_active', true)->first() ?? $product->variants->first();
100:         $retailPrice = array_key_exists('retail_price', $defaultPrices) && $defaultPrices['retail_price'] !== null
101:             ? (float) $defaultPrices['retail_price']
102:             : ($activeSample?->retail_price !== null ? (float) $activeSample->retail_price : null);
103:         $wholesalePrice = array_key_exists('wholesale_price', $defaultPrices) && $defaultPrices['wholesale_price'] !== null
104:             ? (float) $defaultPrices['wholesale_price']
105:             : ($activeSample?->wholesale_price !== null ? (float) $activeSample->wholesale_price : null);
106:         $costPrice = $canViewCost && array_key_exists('cost_price', $defaultPrices) && $defaultPrices['cost_price'] !== null
107:             ? (float) $defaultPrices['cost_price']
108:             : null;
109: 
110:         $matrix = is_array($args['variant_matrix'] ?? null) ? $args['variant_matrix'] : [];
111:         $rawColors = array_values(array_filter(array_map('trim', (array) ($matrix['colors'] ?? [])), fn ($v) => $v !== ''));
112:         $rawSizes = array_values(array_filter(array_map('trim', (array) ($matrix['sizes'] ?? [])), fn ($v) => $v !== ''));
113:         $rawCapacities = array_values(array_filter(array_map('trim', (array) ($matrix['capacities'] ?? [])), fn ($v) => $v !== ''));
114: 
115:         $resolvedColors = [];
116:         foreach ($rawColors as $colorInput) {
117:             $resolvedColors[] = CatalogArgs::resolveColor((string) $colorInput);
118:         }
119: 
120:         $colorAxis = $resolvedColors !== [] ? $resolvedColors : [null];
121:         $sizeAxis = $rawSizes !== [] ? $rawSizes : [null];
122:         $capacityAxis = $rawCapacities !== [] ? $rawCapacities : [null];
123: 
124:         $totalCombinations = count($colorAxis) * count($sizeAxis) * count($capacityAxis);
125:         if ($totalCombinations > 100) {
126:             throw ValidationException::withMessages([
127:                 'variant_matrix' => ["عدد المتغيرات الناتج ({$totalCombinations}) أكبر من الحد المسموح (100 متغير)."],
128:             ]);
129:         }
130: 
131:         $existingCombos = [];
132:         foreach ($product->variants as $v) {
133:             $key = mb_strtolower((string) ($v->color_name_en ?? '')).'|'.mb_strtolower((string) ($v->size ?? '')).'|'.mb_strtolower((string) ($v->capacity ?? ''));
134:             $existingCombos[$key] = true;
135:         }
136: 
137:         $newVariants = [];
138:         $matrixRows = [];
139:         $baseSort = (int) $product->variants->max('sort_order') + 1;
140: 
141:         foreach ($colorAxis as $colorItem) {
142:             foreach ($sizeAxis as $sizeItem) {
143:                 foreach ($capacityAxis as $capItem) {
144:                     $colorEn = $colorItem['color_name_en'] ?? null;
145:                     $comboKey = mb_strtolower((string) ($colorEn ?? '')).'|'.mb_strtolower((string) ($sizeItem ?? '')).'|'.mb_strtolower((string) ($capItem ?? ''));
146:                     $isSkipped = isset($existingCombos[$comboKey]);
147: 
148:                     $uiRow = [
149:                         'color_hex' => $colorItem['color_hex'] ?? null,
150:                         'color' => $colorItem['color_name_ar'] ?? null,
151:                         'color_en' => $colorEn,
152:                         'size' => $sizeItem,
153:                         'capacity' => $capItem,
154:                         'retail' => $retailPrice,
155:                         'wholesale' => $wholesalePrice,
156:                         'status' => $isSkipped ? 'skipped' : 'new',
157:                     ];
158:                     if ($canViewCost && $costPrice !== null) {
159:                         $uiRow['cost_price'] = $costPrice;
160:                     }
161:                     $matrixRows[] = $uiRow;
162: 
163:                     if (! $isSkipped) {
164:                         $existingCombos[$comboKey] = true;
165:                         $vData = [
166:                             'color_name_ar' => $colorItem['color_name_ar'] ?? null,
167:                             'color_name_en' => $colorEn,
168:                             'color_hex' => $colorItem['color_hex'] ?? null,
169:                             'size' => $sizeItem,
170:                             'capacity' => $capItem,
171:                             'retail_price' => $retailPrice,
172:                             'wholesale_price' => $wholesalePrice,
173:                             'is_active' => true,
174:                             'sort_order' => $baseSort++,
175:                         ];
176:                         if ($canViewCost && $costPrice !== null) {
177:                             $vData['cost_price'] = $costPrice;
178:                         }
179:                         $newVariants[] = $vData;
180:                     }
181:                 }
182:             }
183:         }
184: 
185:         if ($newVariants === []) {
186:             throw ValidationException::withMessages([
187:                 'variant_matrix' => ['كل التركيبات المطلوبة موجودة بالفعل في المنتج.'],
188:             ]);
189:         }
190: 
191:         $rules = ['variants' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1', 'max:100']];
192:         foreach (VariantRules::base(null, 'variants.*.') as $field => $rule) {
193:             $rules["variants.*.$field"] = $rule;
194:         }
195:         CatalogArgs::validate(['variants' => $newVariants], $rules);
196: 
197:         $skippedCount = count($matrixRows) - count($newVariants);
198:         $warnings = [
199:             'تنفيذ المتغيرات بيتم كحزمة واحدة (transaction واحدة): لو متغير واحد فشل، الإضافة كلها بتتلغي.',
200:         ];
201:         if ($skippedCount > 0) {
202:             $warnings[] = "تم تجاهل {$skippedCount} متغير لأنهم موجودين بالفعل.";
203:         }
204: 
205:         return $this->proposals->make(
206:             $actor,
207:             $this->name(),
208:             [
209:                 'product_id' => $product->id,
210:                 'variants' => $newVariants,
211:             ],
212:             risk: $this->risk(),
213:             title: 'إضافة '.count($newVariants)." متغير للمنتج {$product->code}",
214:             before: ['variants_count' => $product->variants->count()],
215:             after: [
216:                 'added_count' => count($newVariants),
217:                 'skipped_count' => $skippedCount,
218:             ],
219:             warnings: $warnings,
220:             expectedVersions: ['product:'.$product->id => (int) $product->lock_version],
221:             extraPreview: [
222:                 'block_type' => 'variant_matrix',
223:                 'rows' => $matrixRows,
224:             ],
225:         );
226:     }
227: 
228:     public function lockTargets(AiPendingAction $action): void
229:     {
230:         CatalogLock::tree(shared: true);
231:     }
232: 
233:     public function execute(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
234:     {
235:         $product = Product::findOrFail((int) $action->args['product_id']);
236:         $expected = $action->expected_versions['product:'.$product->id] ?? null;
237:         if ($expected !== null && (int) $product->lock_version !== (int) $expected) {
238:             throw new BusinessException('المنتج تعدّل في جلسة أخرى؛ أعد تحميل الصفحة وحاول مجددًا.', [], 409);
239:         }
240: 
241:         $variantsToCreate = (array) ($action->args['variants'] ?? []);
242:         $canViewCost = CostAccess::canView($actor);
243: 
244:         $createdIds = DB::transaction(function () use ($product, $variantsToCreate, $canViewCost): array {
245:             $ids = [];
246:             foreach ($variantsToCreate as $vData) {
247:                 if (! $canViewCost) {
248:                     unset($vData['cost_price']);
249:                 }
250:                 $created = $this->variants->create($product, $vData);
251:                 $ids[] = $created->id;
252:             }
253: 
254:             return $ids;
255:         });
256: 
257:         StaffAdministration::audit(
258:             $actor,
259:             'variant.bulk_created',
260:             'product',
261:             $product->id,
262:             ['variants'],
263:             [],
264:             ['count' => count($createdIds)],
265:             ['channel' => 'ai', 'tool' => $this->name(), 'entity' => 'product:'.$product->id, 'conversation_id' => $action->conversation_id, 'action_id' => $action->id],
266:         );
267: 
268:         return ToolOutcome::result(true, 'اتضاف '.count($createdIds)." متغير للمنتج {$product->code}.", [
269:             'product_id' => $product->id,
270:             'code' => $product->code,
271:             'added_count' => count($createdIds),
272:             'variant_ids' => $createdIds,
273:             'deep_link' => '#/products/'.$product->id,
274:         ]);
275:     }
276: }
````

````php
 56:             'name' => $this->name(),
 57:             'description' => 'ربط صور مرفوعة في المحادثة (attachments) بمنتج أو بلون/متغير محدد.',

 61:                 'properties' => (object) [

 63:                     'attachment_ids' => [
````
