````php
 45:             'description' => 'بناء خطة إصلاح للكتالوج مرتبة حسب الأثر (1: نشر المسودات الجاهزة، 2: أسعار الجملة الناقصة، 3: الأسعار الشاذة، 4: تعطيل الأقسام الفاضية) مع ترجمة كل بند لأداة مناسبة.',
 46:             'parameters' => [
 47:                 'type' => 'OBJECT',
 48:                 'properties' => (object) [
 49:                     'draft_older_than_days' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 50:                 ],
 51:             ],
 52:         ];
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     public function handle(User $actor, array $args): ToolOutcome
 56:     {
 57:         $args = CatalogArgs::normalizeDigitsInArray($args);
 58:         $reportOutcome = $this->healthReport->handle($actor, $args);
 59:         $report = $reportOutcome->data;
 60: 
 61:         $steps = [];
 62:         $bulkCandidateItems = [];
 63: 
 64:         // Priority 1: Ready drafts (Quick wins)
 65:         $readyDrafts = (array) ($report['ready_drafts']['examples'] ?? []);
 66:         $readyCount = (int) ($report['ready_drafts']['count'] ?? 0);
 67:         if ($readyCount > 0) {
 68:             $firstReady = $readyDrafts[0] ?? null;
 69:             $steps[] = [
 70:                 'priority' => 1,
 71:                 'category' => 'ready_drafts',
 72:                 'title' => "نشر المسودات الجاهزة ({$readyCount}) — مكسب فوري",
 73:                 'tool' => 'set_product_status',
 74:                 'bulk_eligible' => false,
 75:                 'suggested_calls' => array_map(fn ($p) => [
 76:                     'tool' => 'set_product_status',
 77:                     'args' => ['product_id' => $p['id'], 'status' => 'published'],
 78:                 ], $readyDrafts),
 79:                 'prompt' => $firstReady ? "انشر المنتج {$firstReady['code']}" : 'وريني المسودات الجاهزة للنشر',
 80:             ];
 81:         }
 82: 
 83:         // Priority 2: Missing wholesale/retail prices
 84:         $missingPrices = (array) ($report['missing_prices']['examples'] ?? []);
 85:         $missingPricesCount = (int) ($report['missing_prices']['count'] ?? 0);
 86:         if ($missingPricesCount > 0) {
 87:             $steps[] = [
 88:                 'priority' => 2,
 89:                 'category' => 'missing_prices',
 90:                 'title' => "استكمال الأسعار الناقصة في المتغيرات النشطة ({$missingPricesCount})",
 91:                 'tool' => 'update_variant',
 92:                 'bulk_eligible' => true,
 93:                 'examples' => $missingPrices,
 94:                 'prompt' => 'وريني المتغيرات اللي ناقصها أسعار عشان نسعرها',
 95:             ];
 96:         }
 97: 
 98:         // Priority 3: Price anomalies
 99:         $anomalies = (array) ($report['price_anomalies']['examples'] ?? []);
100:         $anomaliesCount = (int) ($report['price_anomalies']['count'] ?? 0);
101:         if ($anomaliesCount > 0) {
102:             $steps[] = [
103:                 'priority' => 3,
104:                 'category' => 'price_anomalies',
105:                 'title' => "إصلاح الأسعار الشاذة ({$anomaliesCount})",
106:                 'tool' => 'update_variant',
107:                 'bulk_eligible' => true,
108:                 'examples' => $anomalies,
109:                 'prompt' => 'وريني المتغيرات اللي فيها أسعار شاذة',
110:             ];
111:         }
112: 
113:         // Priority 4: Empty active categories (deactivate)
114:         $emptyCategories = array_values(array_filter(
115:             (array) ($report['empty_categories']['examples'] ?? []),
116:             fn ($c) => ! empty($c['is_active'])
117:         ));
118:         $emptyCount = (int) ($report['empty_categories']['count'] ?? 0);
119:         if ($emptyCount > 0) {
120:             foreach ($emptyCategories as $cat) {
121:                 $bulkCandidateItems[] = [
122:                     'tool' => 'set_category_status',
123:                     'args' => ['category_id' => $cat['id'], 'is_active' => false],
124:                 ];
125:             }
126:             $steps[] = [
127:                 'priority' => 4,
128:                 'category' => 'empty_categories',
129:                 'title' => "تعطيل الأقسام الفاضية ({$emptyCount})",
130:                 'tool' => 'set_category_status',
131:                 'bulk_eligible' => true,
132:                 'suggested_calls' => $bulkCandidateItems,
133:                 'prompt' => 'عطّل الأقسام الفاضية',
134:             ];
135:         }
136: 
137:         $nextActions = array_values(array_map(fn ($s) => [
138:             'label' => $s['title'],
139:             'prompt' => $s['prompt'],
140:         ], $steps));
141: 
142:         $uiChecks = array_values(array_map(fn ($s) => [
143:             'key' => $s['category'],
144:             'ok' => false,
145:             'severity' => $s['priority'] <= 2 ? 'blocker' : 'warning',
146:             'label' => "أولوية {$s['priority']}: {$s['title']}",
147:             'message' => "الأداة المقترحة: {$s['tool']}",
148:         ], $steps));
149: 
150:         return $this->presenter->present(
151:             $actor,
152:             [
153:                 'steps_count' => count($steps),
154:                 'steps' => $steps,
155:                 'bulk_actions_suggestion' => count($bulkCandidateItems) >= 2 ? [
156:                     'tool' => 'bulk_actions',
157:                     'args' => ['items' => $bulkCandidateItems],
158:                 ] : null,
159:             ],
160:             [
161:                 'type' => 'checklist',
162:                 'title' => 'خطة إصلاح الكتالوج مرتبة حسب الأثر',
163:                 'verdict' => $steps === [] ? 'ready' : 'warning',
164:                 'checks' => $uiChecks,
165:                 'next_actions' => $nextActions,
166:             ],
167:         );
168:     }
169: }
````

## File: backend/app/Services/Ai/Catalog/Tools/ReorderCategoriesTool.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Catalog\Tools;
  6: 
  7: use App\Exceptions\BusinessException;
  8: use App\Models\AiPendingAction;
  9: use App\Models\Category;
 10: use App\Models\User;
 11: use App\Services\Ai\Catalog\CatalogArgs;
 12: use App\Services\Ai\Catalog\CatalogPresenter;
 13: use App\Services\Ai\Contracts\LocksTargets;
 14: use App\Services\Ai\Contracts\UndoableTool;
 15: use App\Services\Ai\ProposalBuilder;
 16: use App\Services\Ai\ToolKind;
 17: use App\Services\Ai\ToolOutcome;
 18: use App\Services\Ai\WriteTool;
 19: use App\Services\Catalog\CatalogLock;
 20: use App\Services\Catalog\CategoryHierarchy;
 21: use App\Services\Catalog\CategoryService;
 22: use App\Services\StaffAdministration;
 23: use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
 24: 
 25: final class ReorderCategoriesTool implements LocksTargets, UndoableTool, WriteTool
 26: {
 27:     public function __construct(
 28:         private CategoryService $categories,
 29:         private ProposalBuilder $proposals,
 30:         private CatalogPresenter $presenter,
 31:     ) {}
 32: 
 33:     public function name(): string
 34:     {
 35:         return 'reorder_categories';
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     public function kind(): ToolKind
 39:     {
 40:         return ToolKind::Write;
 41:     }
 42: 
 43:     public function risk(): string
 44:     {
 45:         return 'low';
 46:     }
 47: 
 48:     public function permissions(): array
 49:     {
 50:         return ['categories.update'];
 51:     }
 52: 
 53:     public function declaration(): array
 54:     {
 55:         return [
 56:             'name' => $this->name(),
 57:             'description' => 'إعادة ترتيب الأقسام بتحديد قائمة عناصر فيها id و sort_order و parent_id (اختياري، لو ما اتبعتش بياخد الأب الحالي).',
 58:             'parameters' => [
 59:                 'type' => 'OBJECT',
 60:                 'required' => ['items'],
 61:                 'properties' => (object) [
 62:                     'items' => [
 63:                         'type' => 'ARRAY',
 64:                         'items' => [
 65:                             'type' => 'OBJECT',
 66:                             'required' => ['id', 'sort_order'],
 67:                             'properties' => (object) [
 68:                                 'id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 69:                                 'parent_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER', 'nullable' => true],
 70:                                 'sort_order' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 71:                             ],
 72:                         ],
 73:                     ],
 74:                 ],
 75:             ],
 76:         ];
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     public function prepare(User $actor, array $args): ToolOutcome
 80:     {
 81:         $args = CatalogArgs::normalizeDigitsInArray($args);
 82:         $rawItems = is_array($args['items'] ?? null) ? $args['items'] : [];
 83:         if ($rawItems === []) {
 84:             throw ValidationException::withMessages(['items' => ['قائمة الأقسام مطلوبة للترتيب.']]);
 85:         }
 86: 
 87:         $ids = array_map(fn ($item) => (int) ($item['id'] ?? 0), $rawItems);
 88:         $existing = Category::whereIn('id', $ids)->get()->keyBy('id');
 89:         if ($existing->count() !== count(array_unique($ids))) {
 90:             throw ValidationException::withMessages(['items' => ['أحد الأقسام المحددة غير موجود.']]);
 91:         }
 92: 
 93:         $items = [];
 94:         $inverseItems = [];
 95:         $expectedVersions = [];
 96:         $overrides = [];
 97:         $nodes = CategoryHierarchy::snapshot();
 98: 
 99:         foreach ($rawItems as $raw) {
100:             $id = (int) $raw['id'];
101:             /** @var Category $cat */
102:             $cat = $existing->get($id);
103:             $parentId = array_key_exists('parent_id', $raw)
104:                 ? ($raw['parent_id'] === null ? null : (int) $raw['parent_id'])
105:                 : $cat->parent_id;
106:             $sortOrder = max(0, (int) ($raw['sort_order'] ?? 0));
107: 
108:             $items[] = [
109:                 'id' => $id,
110:                 'parent_id' => $parentId,
111:                 'sort_order' => $sortOrder,
112:             ];
113:             $inverseItems[] = [
114:                 'id' => $id,
115:                 'parent_id' => $cat->parent_id,
116:                 'sort_order' => (int) $cat->sort_order,
117:             ];
118:             $expectedVersions['category:'.$id] = (int) $cat->lock_version;
119:             $overrides[$id] = [
120:                 'parent_id' => $parentId,
121:                 'sort_order' => $sortOrder,
122:             ];
123:             $nodes[$id]['parent_id'] = $parentId;
124:         }
125: 
126:         try {
127:             CategoryHierarchy::assertValid($nodes);
128:             CategoryHierarchy::assertPublishedPathsActive($nodes);
129:         } catch (BusinessException $e) {
130:             throw ValidationException::withMessages(['items' => [$e->getMessage()]]);
131:         }
132: 
133:         $beforeTree = $this->presenter->categoryTreeSnapshot();
134:         $afterTree = $this->presenter->categoryTreeSnapshot($overrides);
135: 
136:         return $this->proposals->make(
137:             $actor,
138:             $this->name(),
139:             ['items' => $items],
140:             risk: $this->risk(),
141:             title: 'إعادة ترتيب '.count($items).' قسم',
142:             before: $beforeTree,
143:             after: $afterTree,
144:             expectedVersions: $expectedVersions,
145:             inverse: ['items' => $inverseItems],
146:             extraPreview: [
147:                 'block_type' => 'category_tree_diff',
148:                 'moved_id' => $items[0]['id'] ?? null,
149:             ],
150:         );
151:     }
152: 
153:     public function lockTargets(AiPendingAction $action): void
154:     {
155:         CatalogLock::tree(shared: true);
156:     }
157: 
158:     public function execute(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
159:     {
160:         $items = (array) ($action->args['items'] ?? []);
161:         foreach ($items as $item) {
162:             $id = (int) $item['id'];
163:             $cat = Category::findOrFail($id);
164:             $expected = $action->expected_versions['category:'.$id] ?? null;
165:             if ($expected !== null && (int) $cat->lock_version !== (int) $expected) {
166:                 throw new BusinessException('القسم تعدّل في جلسة أخرى؛ أعد تحميل الصفحة وحاول مجددًا.', [], 409);
167:             }
168:         }
169: 
170:         $this->categories->reorder($items);
171: 
172:         StaffAdministration::audit(
173:             $actor,
174:             'category.reordered',
175:             'category',
176:             null,
177:             ['sort_order', 'parent_id'],
178:             ['count' => count($items)],
179:             ['count' => count($items)],
180:             ['channel' => 'ai', 'tool' => $this->name(), 'entity' => 'category:reorder', 'conversation_id' => $action->conversation_id, 'action_id' => $action->id],
181:         );
182: 
183:         return ToolOutcome::result(true, 'اترتبت الأقسام بنجاح.', [
184:             'count' => count($items),
185:             'deep_link' => '#/categories',
186:         ]);
187:     }
188: 
189:     public function canUndo(AiPendingAction $action): bool
190:     {
191:         return ! empty($action->inverse['items']);
192:     }
193: 
194:     public function targetState(AiPendingAction $action): string
195:     {
196:         $ids = array_column((array) ($action->args['items'] ?? []), 'id');
197:         $rows = Category::whereIn('id', $ids)->orderBy('id')
198:             ->get(['id', 'parent_id', 'sort_order', 'is_active', 'lock_version'])
199:             ->map(fn (Category $c) => [$c->id, $c->parent_id, $c->sort_order, $c->is_active, $c->lock_version])
200:             ->all();
201: 
202:         return hash('sha256', json_encode($rows, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
203:     }
204: 
205:     public function undo(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
206:     {
207:         $this->categories->reorder((array) $action->inverse['items']);
208: 
209:         return ToolOutcome::result(true, 'تم التراجع عن ترتيب الأقسام.', [
210:             'deep_link' => '#/categories',
211:         ]);
212:     }
213: }
````

## File: backend/app/Services/Ai/Catalog/Tools/ReorderProductMediaTool.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Catalog\Tools;
  6: 
  7: use App\Models\AiPendingAction;
  8: use App\Models\Product;
  9: use App\Models\ProductVariant;
 10: use App\Models\User;
 11: use App\Services\Ai\Catalog\CatalogArgs;
 12: use App\Services\Ai\Catalog\CatalogPresenter;
 13: use App\Services\Ai\Contracts\LocksTargets;
 14: use App\Services\Ai\Contracts\UndoableTool;
 15: use App\Services\Ai\ProposalBuilder;
 16: use App\Services\Ai\ToolKind;
 17: use App\Services\Ai\ToolOutcome;
 18: use App\Services\Ai\WriteTool;
 19: use App\Services\Catalog\CatalogLock;
 20: use App\Services\Catalog\ProductMediaService;
 21: use App\Services\StaffAdministration;
 22: use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
 23: use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
 24: 
 25: final class ReorderProductMediaTool implements LocksTargets, UndoableTool, WriteTool
 26: {
 27:     public function __construct(
 28:         private ProductMediaService $media,
 29:         private ProposalBuilder $proposals,
 30:         private CatalogPresenter $presenter,
 31:     ) {}
 32: 
 33:     public function name(): string
 34:     {
 35:         return 'reorder_product_media';
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     public function kind(): ToolKind
 39:     {
 40:         return ToolKind::Write;
 41:     }
 42: 
 43:     public function risk(): string
 44:     {
 45:         return 'low';
 46:     }
 47: 
 48:     public function permissions(): array
 49:     {
 50:         return ['products.update'];
 51:     }
 52: 
 53:     public function declaration(): array
 54:     {
 55:         return [
 56:             'name' => $this->name(),
 57:             'description' => 'إعادة ترتيب صور منتج أو تعيين صورة غلاف (cover_media_id يحط الصورة في الأول).',
 58:             'parameters' => [
 59:                 'type' => 'OBJECT',
 60:                 'required' => ['product_id'],
 61:                 'properties' => (object) [
 62:                     'product_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 63:                     'cover_media_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 64:                     'ids' => ['type' => 'ARRAY', 'items' => ['type' => 'INTEGER']],
 65:                 ],
 66:             ],
 67:         ];
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     public function prepare(User $actor, array $args): ToolOutcome
 71:     {
 72:         $args = CatalogArgs::normalizeDigitsInArray($args);
 73:         $product = Product::find((int) ($args['product_id'] ?? 0));
 74:         if (! $product) {
 75:             return ToolOutcome::denied('المنتج مش موجود.', auditable: false);
 76:         }
 77: 
 78:         $coverId = isset($args['cover_media_id']) && $args['cover_media_id'] !== null ? (int) $args['cover_media_id'] : null;
 79:         $rawIds = array_values(array_map('intval', (array) ($args['ids'] ?? [])));
 80: 
 81:         if ($coverId !== null) {
 82:             $coverMedia = Media::find($coverId);
 83:             if (! $coverMedia) {
 84:                 throw ValidationException::withMessages(['cover_media_id' => ['الصورة المحددة غير موجودة.']]);
 85:             }
 86:             // M9: صورة الغلاف يجب أن تتبع نفس المنتج — بلا هذا الفحص كانت
 87:             // البطاقة تُبنى من مجموعة منتج آخر ويُنفَّذ عليه الترتيب.
 88:             if (! $this->belongsToProduct($coverMedia, $product)) {
 89:                 return ToolOutcome::denied('الصورة لا تتبع هذا المنتج.', auditable: false);
 90:             }
 91:             $ownerCollection = Media::query()
 92:                 ->where('model_type', $coverMedia->model_type)
 93:                 ->where('model_id', $coverMedia->model_id)
 94:                 ->where('collection_name', $coverMedia->collection_name)
 95:                 ->orderBy('order_column')
 96:                 ->orderBy('id')
 97:                 ->pluck('id')
 98:                 ->map(fn ($id) => (int) $id)
 99:                 ->all();
100: 
101:             $oldIds = $ownerCollection;
102:             $newIds = array_values(array_unique([$coverId, ...$ownerCollection]));
103:         } elseif ($rawIds !== []) {
104:             $first = Media::find($rawIds[0]);
105:             if (! $first) {
106:                 throw ValidationException::withMessages(['ids' => ['الصورة الأولى غير موجودة.']]);
107:             }
108:             // M9: صورة البداية يجب أن تتبع نفس المنتج.
109:             if (! $this->belongsToProduct($first, $product)) {
110:                 return ToolOutcome::denied('الصورة لا تتبع هذا المنتج.', auditable: false);
111:             }
112:             $oldIds = Media::query()
113:                 ->where('model_type', $first->model_type)
114:                 ->where('model_id', $first->model_id)
115:                 ->where('collection_name', $first->collection_name)
116:                 ->orderBy('order_column')
117:                 ->orderBy('id')
118:                 ->pluck('id')
119:                 ->map(fn ($id) => (int) $id)
120:                 ->all();
121: 
122:             if (count($rawIds) !== count($oldIds) || array_diff($oldIds, $rawIds) !== [] || count(array_unique($rawIds)) !== count($rawIds)) {
123:                 throw ValidationException::withMessages(['ids' => ['قائمة الترتيب يجب أن تشمل جميع صور المجموعة بدون نقص أو تكرار.']]);
124:             }
125:             $newIds = $rawIds;
126:         } else {
127:             throw ValidationException::withMessages(['ids' => ['ابعت cover_media_id أو قائمة ids كاملة.']]);
128:         }
129: 
130:         return $this->proposals->make(
131:             $actor,
132:             $this->name(),
133:             [
134:                 'product_id' => $product->id,
135:                 'ids' => $newIds,
136:             ],
137:             risk: $this->risk(),
138:             title: $coverId !== null
139:                 ? "تعيين الصورة #{$coverId} كغلاف للمنتج {$product->code}"
140:                 : "إعادة ترتيب صور المنتج {$product->code}",
141:             before: ['ids' => $oldIds],
142:             after: ['ids' => $newIds],
143:             inverse: ['ids' => $oldIds],
144:         );
145:     }
146: 
147:     /**
148:      * M9: ملكية الوسائط — نفس فحص DeleteProductMediaTool: المنتج نفسه
149:      * أو أحد متغيراته (بما فيها المحذوفة).
150:      */
151:     private function belongsToProduct(Media $media, Product $product): bool
152:     {
153:         $variantIds = $product->variants()->withTrashed()->pluck('id')->map(fn ($id) => (int) $id)->all();
154: 
155:         return ($media->model_type === Product::class && (int) $media->model_id === (int) $product->id)
156:             || ($media->model_type === ProductVariant::class && in_array((int) $media->model_id, $variantIds, true));
157:     }
158: 
159:     public function lockTargets(AiPendingAction $action): void
160:     {
161:         CatalogLock::tree(shared: true);
162:     }
163: 
164:     public function execute(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
165:     {
166:         $product = Product::findOrFail((int) $action->args['product_id']);
167:         $ids = array_map('intval', (array) $action->args['ids']);
168:         $this->media->reorder($product, $ids);
169: 
170:         StaffAdministration::audit(
171:             $actor,
172:             'product.media_reordered',
173:             'product',
174:             $product->id,
175:             ['media_ids'],
176:             ['media_ids' => $action->inverse['ids'] ?? []],
177:             ['media_ids' => $ids],
178:             ['channel' => 'ai', 'tool' => $this->name(), 'entity' => 'product:'.$product->id, 'conversation_id' => $action->conversation_id, 'action_id' => $action->id],
179:         );
180: 
181:         return ToolOutcome::result(true, "اترتبت صور المنتج {$product->code}.", [
182:             'product_id' => $product->id,
183:             'ids' => $ids,
184:             'deep_link' => '#/products/'.$product->id,
185:         ]);
186:     }
187: 
188:     public function canUndo(AiPendingAction $action): bool
189:     {
190:         return ! empty($action->inverse['ids']);
191:     }
192: 
193:     public function targetState(AiPendingAction $action): string
194:     {
195:         $ids = array_map('intval', (array) ($action->args['ids'] ?? []));
196:         $current = Media::whereIn('id', $ids)->orderBy('order_column')->orderBy('id')->pluck('id')->map(fn ($i) => (int) $i)->all();
197: 
198:         return hash('sha256', json_encode($current, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
199:     }
200: 
201:     public function undo(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
202:     {
203:         $product = Product::findOrFail((int) $action->args['product_id']);
204:         $oldIds = array_map('intval', (array) $action->inverse['ids']);
205:         $this->media->reorder($product, $oldIds);
206: 
207:         return ToolOutcome::result(true, "تم التراجع عن ترتيب صور المنتج {$product->code}.", [
208:             'product_id' => $product->id,
209:             'deep_link' => '#/products/'.$product->id,
210:         ]);
211:     }
212: }
````

## File: backend/app/Services/Ai/Catalog/Tools/SearchProductsTool.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Catalog\Tools;
  6: 
  7: use App\Enums\ProductStatus;
  8: use App\Enums\SalesChannel;
  9: use App\Models\Category;
 10: use App\Models\Product;
 11: use App\Models\ProductVariant;
 12: use App\Models\User;
 13: use App\Services\Ai\AgentTool;
 14: use App\Services\Ai\Catalog\CatalogArgs;
 15: use App\Services\Ai\Catalog\CatalogPresenter;
 16: use App\Services\Ai\EntityResolver;
 17: use App\Services\Ai\ToolKind;
 18: use App\Services\Ai\ToolOutcome;
 19: use App\Services\SearchTerm;
 20: 
 21: final class SearchProductsTool implements AgentTool
 22: {
 23:     public function __construct(private CatalogPresenter $presenter) {}
 24: 
 25:     public function name(): string
 26:     {
 27:         return 'search_products';
 28:     }
 29: 
 30:     public function kind(): ToolKind
 31:     {
 32:         return ToolKind::Read;
 33:     }
 34: 
 35:     public function risk(): string
 36:     {
 37:         return 'low';
 38:     }
 39: 
 40:     public function permissions(): array
 41:     {
 42:         return ['products.view'];
 43:     }
 44: 
 45:     public function declaration(): array
 46:     {
 47:         return [
 48:             'name' => $this->name(),
 49:             'description' => 'بحث وفلترة المنتجات بالحالة والقسم وقناة البيع والمميز والنواقص (صور/أسعار/باركود).',
 50:             'parameters' => [
 51:                 'type' => 'OBJECT',
 52:                 'properties' => (object) [
 53:                     'query' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 54:                     'status' => ['type' => 'STRING', 'enum' => array_column(ProductStatus::cases(), 'value')],
 55:                     'category_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 56:                     'include_children' => ['type' => 'BOOLEAN'],
 57:                     'sales_channel' => ['type' => 'STRING', 'enum' => array_column(SalesChannel::cases(), 'value')],
 58:                     'is_featured' => ['type' => 'BOOLEAN'],
 59:                     'missing' => ['type' => 'STRING', 'enum' => ['images', 'prices', 'barcode']],
 60:                     'limit' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 61:                 ],
 62:             ],
 63:         ];
 64:     }
 65: 
 66:     public function handle(User $actor, array $args): ToolOutcome
 67:     {
 68:         $args = CatalogArgs::normalizeDigitsInArray($args);
 69:         $limit = min(20, max(1, (int) ($args['limit'] ?? 20)));
 70:         $rawQuery = trim((string) ($args['query'] ?? ''));
 71: 
 72:         $q = Product::query()
 73:             ->with(['category:id,name_ar,name_en'])
 74:             ->withCount('variants')
 75:             ->withMin(['variants as min_retail_price' => fn ($v) => $v->where('is_active', true)], 'retail_price')
 76:             ->withMax(['variants as max_retail_price' => fn ($v) => $v->where('is_active', true)], 'retail_price');
 77: 
 78:         if ($rawQuery !== '') {
 79:             $terms = EntityResolver::expandCatalogSearchTerms($rawQuery);
 80:             $q->where(function ($w) use ($terms, $rawQuery): void {
 81:                 $w->whereRaw('LOWER(code) = LOWER(?)', [$rawQuery])
 82:                     ->orWhereIn('products.id', ProductVariant::query()->select('product_id')
 83:                         ->where(fn ($v) => $v->whereRaw('LOWER(sku) = LOWER(?)', [$rawQuery])->orWhereRaw('LOWER(barcode) = LOWER(?)', [$rawQuery])));
 84:                 foreach ($terms as $term) {
 85:                     $pattern = SearchTerm::pattern($term);
 86:                     $w->orWhereLike('name_ar', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)
 87:                         ->orWhereLike('name_en', $pattern, caseSensitive: false);
 88:                 }
 89:             });
 90:         }
 91: 
 92:         if (! empty($args['category_id'])) {
 93:             $cat = Category::find((int) $args['category_id']);
 94:             if ($cat) {
 95:                 $includeChildren = ! array_key_exists('include_children', $args) || (bool) $args['include_children'];
 96:                 $ids = $includeChildren ? [$cat->id, ...$cat->descendantIds()] : [$cat->id];
 97:                 $q->whereIn('category_id', $ids);
 98:             } else {
 99:                 $q->where('category_id', (int) $args['category_id']);
100:             }
101:         }
102: 
103:         $q->when($args['status'] ?? null, fn ($x, $v) => $x->where('status', $v))
104:             ->when($args['sales_channel'] ?? null, fn ($x, $v) => $x->where('sales_channel', $v))
105:             ->when(array_key_exists('is_featured', $args), fn ($x) => $x->where('is_featured', (bool) $args['is_featured']));
106: 
107:         if (($args['missing'] ?? null) === 'images') {
108:             $q->whereDoesntHave('media', fn ($m) => $m->where('collection_name', 'images'))
109:                 ->whereDoesntHave('variants', fn ($v) => $v->where('is_active', true)->whereHas('media', fn ($m) => $m->where('collection_name', 'images')));
110:         } elseif (($args['missing'] ?? null) === 'prices') {
111:             $q->where(function ($outer): void {
112:                 $outer->where(fn ($r) => $r->whereIn('sales_channel', ['retail', 'both'])
113:                     ->whereHas('variants', fn ($v) => $v->where('is_active', true)->where(fn ($w) => $w->whereNull('retail_price')->orWhere('retail_price', '<=', 0))))
114:                     ->orWhere(fn ($r) => $r->whereIn('sales_channel', ['wholesale', 'both'])
115:                         ->whereHas('variants', fn ($v) => $v->where('is_active', true)->where(fn ($w) => $w->whereNull('wholesale_price')->orWhere('wholesale_price', '<=', 0))));
116:             });
117:         } elseif (($args['missing'] ?? null) === 'barcode') {
118:             $q->whereHas('variants', fn ($v) => $v->where('is_active', true)->where(fn ($w) => $w->whereNull('barcode')->orWhere('barcode', '')));
119:         }
120: 
121:         $products = $q->orderByDesc('id')->limit($limit)->get();
122: 
123:         // الوصف ما يرجعش أبدًا في البحث
124:         $items = $products->map(fn (Product $p) => [
125:             'id' => $p->id,
126:             'code' => $p->code,
127:             'name_ar' => $this->presenter->untrusted($p->name_ar, 255),
128:             'name_en' => $this->presenter->untrusted($p->name_en, 255),
129:             'status' => $p->status->value,
130:             'sales_channel' => $p->sales_channel->value,
131:             'category_id' => $p->category_id,
132:             'category_name' => $p->category ? $this->presenter->untrusted($p->category->name_ar, 150) : null,
133:             'variants_count' => (int) $p->variants_count,
134:             'min_retail_price' => $p->min_retail_price !== null ? (float) $p->min_retail_price : null,
135:             'max_retail_price' => $p->max_retail_price !== null ? (float) $p->max_retail_price : null,
136:             'is_featured' => (bool) $p->is_featured,
137:             'deep_link' => '#/products/'.$p->id,
138:         ])->values()->all();
139: 
140:         $rows = $products->map(fn (Product $p) => [
141:             $p->code,
142:             $p->name_ar,
143:             $p->category?->name_ar ?? '—',
144:             $p->status->value,
145:             (string) $p->variants_count,
146:             $p->min_retail_price !== null ? (string) ((float) $p->min_retail_price) : '—',
147:         ])->values()->all();
148: 
149:         return $this->presenter->present(
150:             $actor,
151:             ['products' => $items, 'count' => count($items)],
152:             ['type' => 'table', 'columns' => ['الكود', 'الاسم', 'القسم', 'الحالة', 'المتغيرات', 'أقل قطاعي'], 'rows' => $rows]
153:         );
154:     }
155: }
````

````php
 27:     public function __construct(

 32: 
 33:     public function name(): string

 35:         return 'set_category_status';

 37: 
 38:     public function kind(): ToolKind
 39:     {
 40:         return ToolKind::Write;
 41:     }
 42: 
 43:     public function risk(): string
 44:     {
 45:         return 'medium';
 46:     }
 47: 
 48:     public function permissions(): array
 49:     {
 50:         return ['categories.update'];
 51:     }
 52: 
 53:     public function declaration(): array
 54:     {
 55:         return [
 56:             'name' => $this->name(),
 57:             'description' => 'تفعيل أو تعطيل قسم في الكتالوج. لو القسم تحته منتجات منشورة، التعطيل هيترفض ويطلب أرشفة أو نقل المنتجات الأول.',
 58:             'parameters' => [
 59:                 'type' => 'OBJECT',
 60:                 'required' => ['category_id', 'is_active'],
 61:                 'properties' => (object) [
 62:                     'category_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 63:                     'is_active' => ['type' => 'BOOLEAN'],
 64:                 ],
 65:             ],
 66:         ];
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     public function prepare(User $actor, array $args): ToolOutcome
 70:     {
 71:         $args = CatalogArgs::normalizeDigitsInArray($args);
 72:         $category = Category::find((int) ($args['category_id'] ?? 0));
 73:         if (! $category) {
 74:             return ToolOutcome::denied('القسم مش موجود.', auditable: false);
 75:         }
 76: 
 77:         $targetActive = (bool) ($args['is_active'] ?? false);
 78:         $subtreeIds = [$category->id, ...$category->descendantIds()];
 79:         $publishedQuery = Product::query()
 80:             ->whereIn('category_id', $subtreeIds)
 81:             ->where('status', ProductStatus::Published);
 82:         $publishedCount = (clone $publishedQuery)->count();
 83: 
 84:         if (! $targetActive && $publishedCount > 0) {
 85:             $sample = (clone $publishedQuery)
 86:                 ->orderBy('id')
 87:                 ->limit(5)
 88:                 ->get(['code', 'name_ar'])
 89:                 ->map(fn (Product $p) => "{$p->name_ar} ({$p->code})")
 90:                 ->implode('، ');
 91: 
 92:             throw ValidationException::withMessages([
 93:                 'is_active' => ["لازم تأرشف أو تنقل الـ {$publishedCount} منتج دول الأول: {$sample}"],
 94:             ]);
 95:         }
 96: 
 97:         $risk = $publishedCount > 0 ? 'high' : 'medium';
 98: 
 99:         return $this->proposals->make(
100:             $actor,
101:             $this->name(),
102:             [
103:                 'category_id' => $category->id,
104:                 'is_active' => $targetActive,
105:             ],
106:             risk: $risk,
107:             title: ($targetActive ? 'تفعيل' : 'تعطيل')." القسم: {$category->name_ar}",
108:             before: ['is_active' => (bool) $category->is_active],
109:             after: ['is_active' => $targetActive],
110:             expectedVersions: ['category:'.$category->id => (int) $category->lock_version],
111:             inverse: ['is_active' => (bool) $category->is_active],
112:             typedConfirmation: $risk === 'high' ? $category->slug : null,
113:             typedConfirmationHint: $risk === 'high' ? 'اكتب slug القسم للتأكيد' : null,
114:         );
115:     }
116: 
117:     public function lockTargets(AiPendingAction $action): void
118:     {
119:         CatalogLock::tree(shared: false);
120:     }
121: 
122:     public function execute(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
123:     {
124:         $category = Category::findOrFail((int) $action->args['category_id']);
125:         $oldActive = (bool) $category->is_active;
126:         $updated = $this->categories->update($category, [
127:             'is_active' => (bool) $action->args['is_active'],
128:             'expected_version' => $action->expected_versions['category:'.$category->id] ?? null,
129:         ], null);
130: 
131:         StaffAdministration::audit(
132:             $actor,
133:             'category.status_changed',
134:             'category',
135:             $updated->id,
136:             ['is_active'],
137:             ['is_active' => $oldActive],
138:             ['is_active' => (bool) $updated->is_active],
139:             ['channel' => 'ai', 'tool' => $this->name(), 'entity' => 'category:'.$updated->id, 'conversation_id' => $action->conversation_id, 'action_id' => $action->id],
140:         );
141: 
142:         return ToolOutcome::result(
143:             true,
144:             ($updated->is_active ? 'اتفعل' : 'اتعطل')." القسم «{$updated->name_ar}».",
145:             [
146:                 'category_id' => $updated->id,
147:                 'is_active' => (bool) $updated->is_active,
148:                 'deep_link' => '#/categories?focus='.$updated->id,
149:             ]
150:         );
151:     }
152: 
153:     public function canUndo(AiPendingAction $action): bool
154:     {
155:         return is_array($action->inverse) && array_key_exists('is_active', $action->inverse);
156:     }
157: 
158:     public function targetState(AiPendingAction $action): string
159:     {
160:         $c = Category::findOrFail((int) $action->args['category_id']);
161: 
162:         return hash('sha256', json_encode([$c->parent_id, $c->sort_order, $c->is_active, $c->lock_version], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
163:     }
164: 
165:     public function undo(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
166:     {
167:         $category = Category::findOrFail((int) $action->args['category_id']);
168:         $updated = $this->categories->update($category, [
169:             'is_active' => (bool) $action->inverse['is_active'],
170:         ], null);
171: 
172:         return ToolOutcome::result(true, "تم التراجع عن تغيير حالة القسم «{$updated->name_ar}».", [
173:             'category_id' => $updated->id,
174:             'deep_link' => '#/categories?focus='.$updated->id,
175:         ]);
````

````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Catalog\Tools;
  6: 
  7: use App\Enums\ProductStatus;
  8: use App\Exceptions\BusinessException;
  9: use App\Models\AiPendingAction;

 11: use App\Models\User;
 12: use App\Services\Ai\Catalog\CatalogArgs;
 13: use App\Services\Ai\Catalog\CatalogPresenter;
 14: use App\Services\Ai\Contracts\LocksTargets;
 15: use App\Services\Ai\Contracts\UndoableTool;
 16: use App\Services\Ai\ProposalBuilder;
 17: use App\Services\Ai\ToolKind;
 18: use App\Services\Ai\ToolOutcome;
 19: use App\Services\Ai\WriteTool;
 20: use App\Services\Catalog\CatalogLock;
 21: use App\Services\Catalog\ProductPublishabilityChecker;
 22: use App\Services\Catalog\ProductService;
 23: use App\Services\StaffAdministration;
 24: 
 25: final class SetProductStatusTool implements LocksTargets, UndoableTool, WriteTool
 26: {
 27:     public function __construct(
 28:         private ProductService $products,
 29:         private ProductPublishabilityChecker $checker,
 30:         private ProposalBuilder $proposals,
 31:         private CatalogPresenter $presenter,
 32:     ) {}
 33: 
 34:     public function name(): string
 35:     {
 36:         return 'set_product_status';
 37:     }
 38: 
 39:     public function kind(): ToolKind
 40:     {
 41:         return ToolKind::Write;
 42:     }
 43: 
 44:     public function risk(): string
 45:     {
 46:         return 'high';
 47:     }
 48: 
 49:     public function permissions(): array
 50:     {
 51:         return ['products.update'];
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     public function declaration(): array
 55:     {
 56:         return [
 57:             'name' => $this->name(),
 58:             'description' => 'تغيير حالة منتج (draft / published / archived). لو التحويل لـ published وفيه نواقص، هيرجع قائمة النواقص بدل اقتراح النشر.',
 59:             'parameters' => [
 60:                 'type' => 'OBJECT',
 61:                 'required' => ['product_id', 'status'],
 62:                 'properties' => (object) [
 63:                     'product_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 64:                     'status' => ['type' => 'STRING', 'enum' => array_column(ProductStatus::cases(), 'value')],
 65:                 ],
 66:             ],
 67:         ];
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     public function prepare(User $actor, array $args): ToolOutcome
 71:     {
 72:         $args = CatalogArgs::normalizeDigitsInArray($args);
 73:         $product = Product::with(['category', 'variants', 'media'])->find((int) ($args['product_id'] ?? 0));
 74:         if (! $product) {
 75:             return ToolOutcome::denied('المنتج مش موجود.', auditable: false);
 76:         }
 77: 
 78:         $targetStatus = ProductStatus::tryFrom((string) ($args['status'] ?? ''));
 79:         if (! $targetStatus) {
 80:             return ToolOutcome::denied('الحالة المطلوبة غير صحيحة.', auditable: false);
 81:         }
 82: 
 83:         $currentStatus = $product->status;
 84:         $publishInvolved = $currentStatus === ProductStatus::Published || $targetStatus === ProductStatus::Published;
 85: 
 86:         if ($publishInvolved && ! $actor->can('products.publish')) {
 87:             return ToolOutcome::denied('ليس لديك صلاحية نشر أو إلغاء نشر المنتجات (products.publish).', auditable: true);
 88:         }
 89: 
 90:         if ($targetStatus === ProductStatus::Published) {
 91:             $checks = $this->checker->evaluate($product);
 92:             $failed = array_values(array_filter($checks, fn ($c) => ! $c['ok']));
 93:             if ($failed !== []) {
 94:                 $nextActions = CheckPublishabilityTool::buildNextActions($product, $checks);
 95:                 $uiChecks = array_map(fn ($c) => [
 96:                     'key' => $c['key'],
 97:                     'ok' => $c['ok'],
 98:                     'label' => $c['label'],
 99:                     'hint' => $c['hint'],
100:                     'severity' => 'blocker',
101:                     'message' => $c['label'].($c['hint'] ? ' — '.$c['hint'] : ''),
102:                 ], $checks);
103: 
104:                 return $this->presenter->present(
105:                     $actor,
106:                     [
107:                         'can_publish' => false,
108:                         'product_id' => $product->id,
109:                         'code' => $product->code,
110:                         'status' => $currentStatus->value,
111:                         'checks' => $checks,
112:                         'next_actions' => $nextActions,
113:                         'deep_link' => '#/products/'.$product->id,
114:                     ],
115:                     [
116:                         'type' => 'checklist',
117:                         'title' => "لا يمكن نشر المنتج {$product->code} قبل استيفاء الشروط",
118:                         'verdict' => 'blocked',
119:                         'checks' => $uiChecks,
120:                         'next_actions' => $nextActions,
121:                     ],
122:                     'المنتج لسه ناقصه شروط قبل النشر.',
123:                 );
124:             }
125:         }
126: 
127:         $risk = $publishInvolved ? 'high' : 'medium';
128: 
129:         return $this->proposals->make(
130:             $actor,
131:             $this->name(),
132:             [
133:                 'product_id' => $product->id,
134:                 'status' => $targetStatus->value,
135:             ],
136:             risk: $risk,
137:             title: "تغيير حالة المنتج {$product->code} إلى {$targetStatus->value}",
138:             before: ['status' => $currentStatus->value],
139:             after: ['status' => $targetStatus->value],
140:             expectedVersions: [
141:                 'product:'.$product->id => (int) $product->lock_version,
142:                 'target_version:'.$product->id => (int) $product->lock_version + 1,
143:             ],
144:             inverse: [
145:                 'status' => $currentStatus->value,
146:                 'from_status' => $currentStatus->value,
147:                 'to_status' => $targetStatus->value,
148:             ],
149:             typedConfirmation: $risk === 'high' ? $product->code : null,
150:             typedConfirmationHint: $risk === 'high' ? 'اكتب كود المنتج للتأكيد' : null,
151:         );
152:     }
153: 
154:     public function lockTargets(AiPendingAction $action): void
155:     {
156:         CatalogLock::tree(shared: true);
157:     }
158: 
159:     public function execute(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
160:     {
161:         $product = Product::findOrFail((int) $action->args['product_id']);
162:         $expected = $action->expected_versions['product:'.$product->id] ?? null;
163:         if ($expected !== null && (int) $product->lock_version !== (int) $expected) {
164:             throw new BusinessException('المنتج تعدّل في جلسة أخرى؛ أعد تحميل الصفحة وحاول مجددًا.', [], 409);
165:         }
166: 
167:         $oldStatus = $product->status->value;
168:         $targetStatus = ProductStatus::from((string) $action->args['status']);
169:         $this->products->changeStatus($product, $targetStatus, $actor);
170: 
171:         StaffAdministration::audit(
172:             $actor,
173:             'product.status_changed',
174:             'product',
175:             $product->id,
176:             ['status'],
177:             ['status' => $oldStatus],
178:             ['status' => $product->status->value],
179:             ['channel' => 'ai', 'tool' => $this->name(), 'entity' => 'product:'.$product->id, 'conversation_id' => $action->conversation_id, 'action_id' => $action->id],
180:         );
181: 
182:         return ToolOutcome::result(true, "اتغيرت حالة المنتج {$product->code} إلى {$product->status->value}.", [
183:             'product_id' => $product->id,
184:             'code' => $product->code,
185:             'status' => $product->status->value,
186:             'deep_link' => '#/products/'.$product->id,
187:         ]);
188:     }
189: 
190:     public function canUndo(AiPendingAction $action): bool
191:     {
192:         if (! is_array($action->inverse) || empty($action->inverse['status'])) {
193:             return false;
194:         }
195:         $p = Product::find((int) ($action->args['product_id'] ?? 0));
196:         if (! $p) {
197:             return false;
198:         }
199:         $expectedAfter = $action->expected_versions['target_version:'.$p->id] ?? null;
200:         if ($expectedAfter !== null && (int) $p->lock_version !== (int) $expectedAfter) {
201:             return false;
202:         }
203: 
204:         return true;
205:     }
206: 
207:     public function targetState(AiPendingAction $action): string
208:     {
209:         $p = Product::findOrFail((int) $action->args['product_id']);
210: 
211:         return hash('sha256', json_encode([$p->status->value, $p->lock_version], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
212:     }
213: 
214:     public function undo(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
215:     {
216:         $product = Product::findOrFail((int) $action->args['product_id']);
217:         $expectedAfter = $action->expected_versions['target_version:'.$product->id] ?? null;
218:         if ($expectedAfter !== null && (int) $product->lock_version !== (int) $expectedAfter) {
219:             throw new BusinessException('المنتج اتعدل بعد تغيير حالته؛ ما ينفعش التراجع التلقائي.', [], 409);
220:         }

223:         $this->products->changeStatus($product, $targetStatus, $actor);

227:             'code' => $product->code,
````

````php
223:         $keys = is_array($action->inverse) ? array_keys($action->inverse) : [];

225:         foreach ($keys as $k) {
226:             $v = $p->getAttribute($k);
227:             $attrs[$k] = $v instanceof \BackedEnum ? $v->value : $v;
228:         }
229: 
230:         return hash('sha256', json_encode([$p->lock_version, $attrs], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
231:     }
232: 
233:     public function undo(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
234:     {
235:         $product = Product::findOrFail((int) $action->args['product_id']);
236:         $updated = $this->products->update($product, (array) $action->inverse, $actor);
237: 
238:         return ToolOutcome::result(true, "تم التراجع عن تعديل المنتج {$updated->code}.", [
239:             'product_id' => $updated->id,
240:             'code' => $updated->code,
241:             'deep_link' => '#/products/'.$updated->id,
242:         ]);
243:     }
````

````php
  1: <?php
````

````php
  5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Catalog;
  6: 
  7: use App\Http\Requests\Admin\Variant\VariantRules;
  8: use App\Models\ProductVariant;
  9: use App\Services\Ai\EntityResolver;
 10: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
 11: use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
 12: 
 13: final class CatalogArgs
 14: {
 15:     /**
 16:      * @return array{color_name_ar: string, color_name_en: string, color_hex: string}
 17:      *
 18:      * @throws ValidationException
 19:      */
 20:     public static function resolveColor(string $input): array
 21:     {
 22:         $clean = trim($input);
 23:         $norm = EntityResolver::normalizeForSearch($clean);
 24:         $lower = mb_strtolower($clean);
 25:         $colors = (array) config('ai_catalog_colors', []);
 26: 
 27:         foreach ($colors as $key => $entry) {
 28:             if ($lower === mb_strtolower((string) $key) || $lower === mb_strtolower((string) ($entry['en'] ?? ''))) {
 29:                 return [
 30:                     'color_name_ar' => (string) ($entry['ar'][0] ?? $clean),
 31:                     'color_name_en' => (string) $entry['en'],
 32:                     'color_hex' => (string) $entry['hex'],
 33:                 ];
 34:             }
 35:             foreach ((array) ($entry['ar'] ?? []) as $arVariant) {
 36:                 if ($norm === EntityResolver::normalizeForSearch((string) $arVariant) || $lower === mb_strtolower((string) $arVariant)) {
 37:                     return [
 38:                         'color_name_ar' => (string) $arVariant,
 39:                         'color_name_en' => (string) $entry['en'],
 40:                         'color_hex' => (string) $entry['hex'],
 41:                     ];
 42:                 }
 43:             }
 44:         }
 45: 
 46:         // Suggestions based on levenshtein / similar_text
 47:         $suggestions = [];
 48:         foreach ($colors as $entry) {
 49:             $arMain = (string) ($entry['ar'][0] ?? '');
 50:             $enMain = (string) ($entry['en'] ?? '');
 51:             similar_text($norm, EntityResolver::normalizeForSearch($arMain), $pctAr);
 52:             similar_text($lower, mb_strtolower($enMain), $pctEn);
 53:             $score = max($pctAr, $pctEn);
 54:             $suggestions[] = ['label' => "{$arMain} ({$enMain})", 'score' => $score];
 55:         }
 56:         usort($suggestions, fn ($a, $b) => $b['score'] <=> $a['score']);
 57:         $top = array_slice(array_column($suggestions, 'label'), 0, 5);
 58: 
 59:         throw ValidationException::withMessages([
 60:             'color' => ["اللون «{$clean}» مش موجود في قاموس الألوان المعتمد. اقتراحات متاحة: ".implode('، ', $top)],
 61:         ]);
 62:     }
 63: 
 64:     /**
 65:      * @param  array<string,mixed>  $args
 66:      * @return array<string,mixed>
 67:      */
 68:     public static function normalizeDigitsInArray(array $args): array
 69:     {
 70:         foreach ($args as $key => $value) {
 71:             if (is_string($value)) {
 72:                 $converted = EntityResolver::normalizeDigits($value);
 73:                 if (in_array($key, ['retail_price', 'wholesale_price', 'cost_price', 'compare_at_price', 'weight_kg', 'length_cm', 'width_cm', 'height_cm', 'value'], true) && is_numeric($converted)) {
 74:                     $args[$key] = (float) $converted;
 75:                 } elseif (in_array($key, ['reorder_level', 'sort_order', 'warranty_months', 'category_id', 'parent_id', 'product_id', 'variant_id'], true) && is_numeric($converted)) {
 76:                     $args[$key] = (int) $converted;
 77:                 } elseif (in_array($key, ['code', 'sku', 'barcode'], true)) {
 78:                     $args[$key] = strtoupper(trim($converted));
 79:                 } elseif ($key === 'slug') {
 80:                     $args[$key] = strtolower(trim($converted));
 81:                 } else {
 82:                     $args[$key] = $value;
 83:                 }
 84:             } elseif (is_array($value)) {
 85:                 $args[$key] = self::normalizeDigitsInArray($value);
 86:             }
 87:         }
 88: 
 89:         return $args;
 90:     }
 91: 
 92:     /**
 93:      * @param  array<string,mixed>  $args
 94:      * @return array<string,mixed>
 95:      */
 96:     public static function normalizeVariant(array $args): array
 97:     {
 98:         $args = self::normalizeDigitsInArray($args);
 99:         unset($args['variant_id'], $args['product_id']);
100: 
101:         if (isset($args['color']) && is_string($args['color']) && trim($args['color']) !== '') {
102:             $resolved = self::resolveColor($args['color']);
103:             $args['color_name_ar'] = $resolved['color_name_ar'];
104:             $args['color_name_en'] = $resolved['color_name_en'];
105:             $args['color_hex'] = $resolved['color_hex'];
106:             unset($args['color']);
107:         } elseif (isset($args['color_name_ar']) && is_string($args['color_name_ar']) && empty($args['color_name_en'])) {
108:             $resolved = self::resolveColor($args['color_name_ar']);
109:             $args['color_name_ar'] = $resolved['color_name_ar'];
110:             $args['color_name_en'] = $resolved['color_name_en'];
111:             $args['color_hex'] = $args['color_hex'] ?? $resolved['color_hex'];
112:         }
113: 
114:         if (isset($args['sku']) && is_string($args['sku'])) {
115:             $args['sku'] = strtoupper(trim($args['sku']));
116:         }
117:         if (isset($args['barcode']) && is_string($args['barcode'])) {
118:             $args['barcode'] = strtoupper(trim($args['barcode']));
119:         }
120: 
121:         return $args;
122:     }
123: 
124:     /**
125:      * @param  array<string,mixed>  $data
126:      * @param  array<string,mixed>  $rules
127:      *
128:      * @throws ValidationException
129:      */
130:     public static function validate(array $data, array $rules): array
131:     {
132:         return Validator::make($data, $rules)->validate();
133:     }
134: }
````

````php
 29:     /** @return array{untrusted_text: string} */

 31:     {
 32:         $clean = mb_substr((string) preg_replace('/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/u', ' ', (string) $value), 0, $max);
 33: 
 34:         return ['untrusted_text' => $clean];
 35:     }

 37:     /**

 40:      */

 42:     {
 43:         $canViewCost = CostAccess::canView($actor);
 44:         if (! $canViewCost) {
 45:             $data = $this->stripCost($data);
 46:             if ($uiBlock !== null) {
 47:                 $uiBlock = $this->stripCost($uiBlock);
 48:             }
 49:         }
 50: 
 51:         $maxChars = max(1024, (int) $this->settings->get('ai_tool_result_max_chars', 16000));
 52:         $encoded = json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
 53:         if ($encoded !== false && strlen($encoded) > $maxChars) {
 54:             return ToolOutcome::data([
 55:                 'truncated' => true,
 56:                 'message' => 'ضيّق البحث',
 57:             ], $uiBlock, 'ضيّق البحث');
 58:         }
 59: 
 60:         return ToolOutcome::data($data, $uiBlock, $message);
 61:     }
 62:

179:                 'max_wholesale' => $wholesalePrices->isNotEmpty() ? $wholesalePrices->max() : null,
180:             ],
181:             'variants' => $product->variants->map(fn (ProductVariant $v) => $this->variant($v, $actor))->values()->all(),
182:             'readiness' => [
183:                 'ready' => ! collect($checks)->contains(fn ($c) => ! $c['ok']),
184:                 'checks' => $checks,
185:             ],
186:             'deep_link' => '#/products/'.$product->id,
187:         ];
188:     }
189: 
190:     /** @return array<string,mixed> */
191:     public function variant(ProductVariant $variant, User $actor): array
192:     {
193:         $out = [
194:             'id' => $variant->id,
195:             'product_id' => $variant->product_id,
196:             'sku' => $variant->sku,
197:             'barcode' => $variant->barcode,
198:             'color_name_ar' => $variant->color_name_ar,
199:             'color_name_en' => $variant->color_name_en,
200:             'color_hex' => $variant->color_hex,
201:             'size' => $variant->size,
202:             'capacity' => $variant->capacity,
203:             'retail_price' => $variant->retail_price !== null ? (float) $variant->retail_price : null,
204:             'wholesale_price' => $variant->wholesale_price !== null ? (float) $variant->wholesale_price : null,
205:             'compare_at_price' => $variant->compare_at_price !== null ? (float) $variant->compare_at_price : null,
206:             'reorder_level' => $variant->reorder_level !== null ? (int) $variant->reorder_level : null,
207:             'weight_kg' => $variant->weight_kg !== null ? (float) $variant->weight_kg : null,
208:             'is_active' => (bool) $variant->is_active,
209:             'deep_link' => '#/products/'.$variant->product_id,
210:         ];
211: 
212:         if (CostAccess::canView($actor)) {
213:             $out['cost_price'] = $variant->cost_price !== null ? (float) $variant->cost_price : null;
214:         }
215: 
216:         return $out;
217:     }
218: 
219:     /**
220:      * Build category path string like "حريمي › شنط إيد".
221:      */
222:     public function categoryPathString(?Category $category): string
223:     {
224:         if (! $category) {
225:             return 'جذر (قسم رئيسي)';
226:         }
227:         $parts = [];
228:         $seen = [];
229:         $curr = $category;
230:         while ($curr && ! isset($seen[$curr->id]) && count($seen) < 5) {
231:             $seen[$curr->id] = true;
232:             array_unshift($parts, $curr->name_ar);
233:             $curr = $curr->parent_id ? Category::find($curr->parent_id) : null;
234:         }
235: 
236:         return implode(' › ', $parts);
237:     }
238: 
239:     /**
240:      * Build UI category tree array for category_tree / category_tree_diff.
241:      *
242:      * @param  array<int, array<string,mixed>>  $overrides
243:      * @return list<array<string,mixed>>
244:      */
245:     public function categoryTreeSnapshot(array $overrides = []): array
246:     {
247:         $all = Category::query()
248:             ->withCount('products')
249:             ->orderBy('sort_order')
250:             ->orderBy('id')
251:             ->get();
252: 
253:         $rows = [];
254:         foreach ($all as $cat) {
255:             $row = [
256:                 'id' => (int) $cat->id,
257:                 'parent_id' => $cat->parent_id !== null ? (int) $cat->parent_id : null,
258:                 'name' => $cat->name_ar,
259:                 'slug' => $cat->slug,
260:                 'active' => (bool) $cat->is_active,
261:                 'sort_order' => (int) $cat->sort_order,
262:                 'products_count' => (int) ($cat->products_count ?? 0),
263:                 'deep_link' => '#/categories?focus='.$cat->id,
264:             ];
265:             if (isset($overrides[$cat->id])) {
266:                 $row = array_replace($row, $overrides[$cat->id]);
267:             }
268:             $rows[] = $row;
269:         }
270: 
271:         usort($rows, fn ($a, $b) => ($a['sort_order'] <=> $b['sort_order']) ?: ($a['id'] <=> $b['id']));
272: 
273:         $grouped = [];
274:         foreach ($rows as $r) {
275:             $key = $r['parent_id'] ?? 0;
276:             $grouped[$key][] = $r;
277:         }
278: 
279:         $build = function (int $parentKey) use (&$build, $grouped): array {
280:             $list = $grouped[$parentKey] ?? [];
281:             $out = [];
282:             foreach ($list as $item) {
283:                 $item['children'] = $build((int) $item['id']);
284:                 $out[] = $item;
285:             }
286: 
287:             return $out;
288:         };
289: 
290:         return $build(0);
291:     }
292: }
````

## File: backend/app/Services/Ai/Catalog/CatalogWarnings.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Catalog;
 6: 
 7: use App\Enums\ProductStatus;
 8: use App\Models\Product;
 9: use App\Models\ProductVariant;
10: use App\Services\Catalog\ProductPublishabilityChecker;
11: 
12: final class CatalogWarnings
13: {
14:     /**
15:      * @param  array<string,mixed>  $data
16:      * @return list<string>
17:      */
18:     public static function forVariantChange(ProductVariant $variant, array $data): array
19:     {
20:         $warnings = [];
21:         $product = $variant->product ?? Product::find($variant->product_id);
22:         if (! $product) {
23:             return $warnings;
24:         }
25: 
26:         if (array_key_exists('is_active', $data) && ! $data['is_active']) {
27:             $otherActive = $product->variants()->where('is_active', true)->where('id', '!=', $variant->id)->exists();
28:             if (! $otherActive) {
29:                 if ($product->status === ProductStatus::Published) {
30:                     $warnings[] = 'ده آخر متغير نشط في منتج منشور — التعطيل هيترفض إلا لو أرشفت المنتج الأول.';
31:                 } else {
32:                     $warnings[] = 'ده آخر متغير نشط في المنتج.';
33:                 }
34:             }
35:         }
36: 
37:         $effectiveRetail = array_key_exists('retail_price', $data) ? $data['retail_price'] : $variant->retail_price;
38:         $effectiveWholesale = array_key_exists('wholesale_price', $data) ? $data['wholesale_price'] : $variant->wholesale_price;
39:         $effectiveActive = array_key_exists('is_active', $data) ? (bool) $data['is_active'] : (bool) $variant->is_active;
40: 
41:         if ($effectiveRetail !== null && $effectiveWholesale !== null && (float) $effectiveWholesale >= (float) $effectiveRetail) {
42:             $warnings[] = 'تنبيه: سعر الجملة أكبر من أو يساوي سعر القطاعي.';
43:         }
44: 
45:         if ($product->status === ProductStatus::Published && $effectiveActive) {
46:             if ($product->sales_channel->allowsRetail() && (! $effectiveRetail || (float) $effectiveRetail <= 0)) {
47:                 $warnings[] = 'المنتج منشور وقناته تشمل القطاعي؛ إزالة سعر القطاعي هترفض التعديل.';
48:             }
49:             if ($product->sales_channel->allowsWholesale() && (! $effectiveWholesale || (float) $effectiveWholesale <= 0)) {
50:                 $warnings[] = 'المنتج منشور وقناته تشمل الجملة؛ إزالة سعر الجملة هترفض التعديل.';
51:             }
52:         }
53: 
54:         return $warnings;
55:     }
56: 
57:     /**
58:      * @param  array<string,mixed>  $data
59:      * @return list<string>
60:      */
61:     public static function forProductChange(Product $product, array $data, ProductPublishabilityChecker $checker): array
62:     {
63:         $warnings = [];
64:         if ($product->status !== ProductStatus::Published) {
65:             return $warnings;
66:         }
67: 
68:         $clone = $product->replicate();
69:         $clone->id = $product->id;
70:         $clone->fill($data);
71:         $clone->setRelation('variants', $product->variants);
72:         if (isset($data['category_id']) && (int) $data['category_id'] !== (int) $product->category_id) {
73:             $clone->setRelation('category', \App\Models\Category::find((int) $data['category_id']));
74:         } else {
75:             $clone->setRelation('category', $product->category);
76:         }
77: 
78:         foreach ($checker->evaluate($clone) as $check) {
79:             if (! $check['ok']) {
80:                 $warnings[] = 'المنتج منشور والتعديل ده هيكسر شرط النشر: '.$check['label'];
81:             }
82:         }
83: 
84:         return $warnings;
85:     }
86: }
````

## File: backend/app/Services/Ai/AgentOrchestrator.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services\Ai;
  6: 
  7: use App\Models\AiConversation;
  8: use App\Models\AiMessage;
  9: use App\Models\User;
 10: use App\Services\BranchAccess;
 11: use App\Services\SettingService;
 12: use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
 13: use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
 14: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
 15: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 16: 
 17: final class AgentOrchestrator
 18: {
 19:     private const MAX_STEPS = 6;
 20: 
 21:     /** M-2: أقصى عدد استدعاءات أدوات في خطوة نموذج واحدة. */
 22:     private const MAX_CALLS_PER_STEP = 8;
 23: 
 24:     /** H4/M13: حد زمني كلي لدورة الوكيل الواحدة في الثواني — أطول من كده تعرض الطلب/الـ worker للحجز. */
 25:     private const MAX_CYCLE_SECONDS = 240;
 26: 
 27:     /** M5: هامش لأطول استدعاء أداة (Gemini 20s × محاولتين + backoff). */
 28:     private const TOOL_CALL_RESERVE_SECONDS = 45;
 29: 
 30:     public function __construct(private GeminiClient $gemini, private ToolRegistry $registry, private SettingService $settings) {}
 31: 
 32:     public function guard(User $actor): void
 33:     {
 34:         abort_unless($this->settings->getBool('ai_enabled', false), 403, 'المساعد الذكي مقفول حالياً.');
 35:         $actor->refresh();
 36:         abort_unless($actor->is_active && $actor->can('ai_agent.use'), 403);
 37:         $budget = (int) $this->settings->get('ai_daily_token_budget_per_user', 200000);
 38:         if ($budget > 0) {
 39:             // M6/M7: join مباشر + نطاق timestamp بدل whereDate + whereHas
 40:             // (سايقل وفهرس على البادئة بدل مسح جدول كامل بليفة ملبّضة).
 41:             // L2: نهاية اليوم تُحسب بتوقيت العمل قبل التحويل لتوقيت
 42:             // التخزين — يوم تغيير التوقيت 23 أو 25 ساعة لا 24 ثابتة.
 43:             $dayStart = now(config('app.business_timezone', 'Africa/Cairo'))->startOfDay();
 44:             $dayEnd = $dayStart->copy()->addDay();
 45:             $storeTz = config('app.timezone');
 46:             $used = (int) AiMessage::query()
 47:                 ->join('ai_conversations as ai_conversations_budget', 'ai_conversations_budget.id', '=', 'ai_messages.conversation_id')
 48:                 ->where('ai_conversations_budget.user_id', $actor->id)
 49:                 // INFO: يوم العمل بتوقيت القاهرة، محوَّل لتوقيت التخزين.
 50:                 ->where('ai_messages.created_at', '>=', $dayStart->copy()->setTimezone($storeTz))
 51:                 ->where('ai_messages.created_at', '<', $dayEnd->copy()->setTimezone($storeTz))
 52:                 ->sum(DB::raw('ai_messages.input_tokens + ai_messages.output_tokens'));
 53:             abort_if($used >= $budget, 429, 'وصلت لحد التوكنز اليومي للمساعد.');
 54:         }
 55:     }
 56: 
 57:     public function systemPrompt(User $actor): string
 58:     {
 59:         $roles = $actor->roles()->pluck('name')->implode('، ');
 60:         try {
 61:             $restricted = app(BranchAccess::class)->restrictedBranch($actor);
 62:             $scope = $restricted !== null ? 'فرع '.$restricted.' فقط' : 'كل الفروع';
 63:         } catch (AuthorizationException) {
 64:             $scope = 'بدون وصول لبيانات الفروع';
 65:         }
 66: 
 67:         $lines = [
 68:             'أنت "مساعد الفريد" لإدارة المؤسسة: الفروع ومواقعها، والموظفين والأدوار، والإعدادات وترقيم المستندات، ومراجعة التجار.',
 69:             'المستخدم الحالي: '.$actor->name.' | الأدوار: '.$roles.' | النطاق: '.$scope,
 70:             'القواعد:',
 71:             '- رد باللهجة المصرية وخليك مختصر. أسماء الصلاحيات التقنية تفضل زي ما هي (inventory.adjust).',
 72:             '- عمرك ما تخمّن ID. لو الكيان مش واضح، استخدم find_entities، ولو طلع أكتر من نتيجة أو مفيش ولا نتيجة استخدم ask_user_to_choose.',
 73:             '- أي تعديل لازم يعدّي على أداة كتابة. ممنوع تقول "تم" إلا لما يرجعلك تأكيد من النظام.',
 74:             '- للتعديل على كيان واحد استخدم أداة التعديل المباشرة. bulk_actions للطلبات التي تشمل كيانين أو أكثر فقط.',
 75:             '- لتعديل إعدادات، اقرأ القيم الحالية أولاً بـ view_settings قبل ما تقترح تعديل.',

 78:             '- مش بتقدر: تدير Super Admin، أو الأدوار المحجوزة، أو الباسوردات، أو حساب المستخدم نفسه. لو حد طلب كده وجّهه للشاشة.',
 79:             '',
 80:             'المعلومات الهيكلية:',
 81:             '- الفرع يحتوي على مواقع تخزين (shelf/zone/bin/damaged/receiving). المواقع تُنشأ صراحة لكل فرع ولا يوجد موقع افتراضي تلقائي.',
 82:             '- أنواع الفروع: branch (فرع بيع) وwarehouse (مخزن).',
 83:             '- الموظف مرتبط بفرع واحد وله أدوار متعددة.',
 84:             '- إعدادات الشركة تشمل: الهوية، الضرائب (tax_enabled, default_tax_rate, prices_include_tax)، نافذة الإرجاع (return_window_days).',

 89:             '- الأنواع: retail بيتعمد تلقائيًا، أما wholesale وdistributor فبيبدأوا pending.',

 91:             '- قبل أي اعتماد أو رفض، استدعي review_dealer_application الأول.',

 95:         ];
 96: 
 97:         foreach ($this->registry->providers() as $provider) {
 98:             $section = $provider->systemPromptSection($actor);
 99:             if ($section !== null && $section !== '') {
100:                 $lines[] = '';
101:                 $lines[] = $section;
102:             }
103:         }
104: 
105:         return implode("\n", $lines);
106:     }
````
