````php
2803:     public function executeUndo(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action, array $via): ToolOutcome
2804:     {
2805:         $inv = $action->inverse ?? [];
2806:         $tool = $action->tool;
2807:         $args = $action->args;
2808:         try {
2809:             if (($providerTool = $this->toolInstance($tool)) instanceof \App\Services\Ai\Contracts\UndoableTool) {
2810:                 return $providerTool->undo($actor, $action);
2811:             }
2812:             $this->assertAiConstraints($actor, $action);
2813:             if ($tool === 'set_branch_status' && isset($inv['is_active'])) {
2814:                 $b = Branch::findOrFail($args['branch_id']);
2815:                 app(UpdateBranch::class)($actor, $b, ['is_active' => (bool) $inv['is_active']], $via);
2816: 
2817:                 return ToolOutcome::result(true, 'تم التراجع.');
2818:             }
2819:             if ($tool === 'update_role_permissions' && isset($inv['permissions'])) {
2820:                 $r = Role::findOrFail($args['role_id']);
2821:                 $f = app(UpdateRole::class)($actor, $r, ['permissions' => $inv['permissions']], $via);
2822: 
2823:                 return $f ? ToolOutcome::result(false, 'الدور محمي.') : ToolOutcome::result(true, 'تم التراجع.');
2824:             }
2825:             if ($tool === 'set_user_status' && isset($inv['is_active'])) {
2826:                 $u = User::findOrFail($args['user_id']);
2827:                 $f = app(UpdateStaffUser::class)($actor, $u, ['is_active' => (bool) $inv['is_active']], $via);
2828: 
2829:                 return $f ? ToolOutcome::result(false, 'مش مسموح.') : ToolOutcome::result(true, 'تم التراجع.');
2830:             }
2831:             if ($tool === 'assign_roles' && isset($inv['roles'])) {
2832:                 $u = User::findOrFail($args['user_id']);
2833:                 $f = app(UpdateStaffUser::class)($actor, $u, ['roles' => $inv['roles']], $via);
2834: 
2835:                 return $f ? ToolOutcome::result(false, 'مش مسموح.') : ToolOutcome::result(true, 'تم التراجع.');
2836:             }
2837:             if ($tool === 'set_location_status' && isset($inv['is_active'])) {
2838:                 // H3: التراجع يمر بنفس القاعدة المشتركة (مع قفل الصف داخل الـ action).
2839:                 app(SetLocationStatus::class)(
2840:                     $actor, Location::findOrFail($args['location_id']), (bool) $inv['is_active'], $via);
2841: 
2842:                 return ToolOutcome::result(true, 'تم التراجع.');
2843:             }
2844:             // ── P04-2: تراجع أدوات العملاء ───────────────────────────────
2845:             if (in_array($tool, ['update_customer_profile', 'set_customer_group', 'set_credit_limit'], true) && $inv !== []) {
2846:                 $c = Customer::findOrFail($args['customer_id']);
2847:                 app(CustomerManagementService::class)->update($c, $inv, $actor->id, $via);
2848: 
2849:                 return ToolOutcome::result(true, 'تم التراجع.');
2850:             }
2851:             if ($tool === 'review_customer_document' && isset($inv['status'])) {
2852:                 $c = Customer::findOrFail($args['customer_id']);
2853:                 $d = $c->documents()->whereKey($args['document_id'])->firstOrFail();
2854:                 app(CustomerManagementService::class)->reviewDocument($c, $d, $inv['status'], $actor->id, null, $via);
2855: 
2856:                 return ToolOutcome::result(true, 'تم التراجع.');
2857:             }
2858:             if ($tool === 'suspend_customer') {
2859:                 // التراجع عن الإيقاف = إعادة تفعيل (ترجع معتمدًا لو كان
2860:                 // معتمدًا قبل الإيقاف، وإلا قيد المراجعة)؛ الجلسات المنهية
2861:                 // لا ترجع — التحذير ده كان في كارت التأكيد نفسه.
2862:                 $c = Customer::findOrFail($args['customer_id']);
2863:                 app(CustomerManagementService::class)->reactivate($c, $actor->id, $via, $inv['previous_status'] ?? null); // M12
2864: 
2865:                 return ToolOutcome::result(true, 'تم التراجع.');
2866:             }
2867:             if ($tool === 'reactivate_customer' && array_key_exists('suspension_reason', $inv)) {
2868:                 $c = Customer::findOrFail($args['customer_id']);
2869:                 app(CustomerManagementService::class)->suspend($c, $inv['suspension_reason'] ?? 'إيقاف من المساعد (تراجع عن إعادة التفعيل)', $actor->id, $via);
2870: 
2871:                 return ToolOutcome::result(true, 'تم التراجع.');
2872:             }
2873:             if ($tool === 'update_customer_group' && $inv !== []) {
2874:                 $g = CustomerGroup::findOrFail($args['customer_group_id']);

2876: 
2877:                 return ToolOutcome::result(true, 'تم التراجع.');
2878:             }
2879: 
2880:             return ToolOutcome::result(false, 'العملية دي مفيهاش تراجع تلقائي.');
2881:         } catch (HttpExceptionInterface $e) {
2882:             if ($e->getStatusCode() === 409) {
2883:                 throw $e;
2884:             }
2885: 
2886:             return ToolOutcome::result(false, $e->getMessage() ?: 'فشل التراجع.');
2887:         } catch (QueryException $e) {
2888:             // فشل تراجع (كود مجموعة اتحجز مثلًا) — فشل مسجَّل بدل 500،
2889:             // والإجراء يفضل executed فيُعاد التراجع بعد حل التعارض.
2890:             return ToolOutcome::result(false, 'تعذّر التراجع؛ القيمة المطلوبة مستخدمة حاليًا.');
````

````php
 5: namespace App\Services\Catalog;
````

````php
 8: use App\Exceptions\BusinessException;

10: use App\Models\Product;
11: 
12: class CategoryHierarchy
13: {
14:     public static function snapshot(): array
15:     {
16:         return Category::query()->get(['id', 'parent_id', 'is_active'])->keyBy('id')->toArray();
17:     }
18: 
19:     public static function assertValid(array $nodes): void
20:     {
21:         foreach (array_keys($nodes) as $id) {
22:             $seen = [];
23:             while ($id !== null) {
24:                 if (isset($seen[$id])) {
25:                     throw new BusinessException('توجد دورة في شجرة الأقسام');
26:                 }
27:                 if (! isset($nodes[$id])) {
28:                     throw new BusinessException('القسم الأب غير موجود');
29:                 }
30:                 $seen[$id] = true;
31:                 if (count($seen) > 3) {
32:                     throw new BusinessException('أقصى عمق للأقسام 3 مستويات');
33:                 }
34:                 $id = $nodes[$id]['parent_id'];
35:             }
36:         }
37:     }
38: 
39:     public static function assertPublishedPathsActive(array $nodes): void
40:     {
41:         $categoryIds = Product::query()->where('status', ProductStatus::Published)->distinct()->pluck('category_id');
42:         foreach ($categoryIds as $id) {
43:             while ($id !== null) {
44:                 if (! isset($nodes[$id]) || ! $nodes[$id]['is_active']) {
45:                     throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن تعطيل أو نقل قسم يحتوي على منتجات منشورة إلى سلسلة أقسام غير نشطة');
46:                 }
47:                 $id = $nodes[$id]['parent_id'];
48:             }
49:         }
50:     }
51: 
52:     public static function activePath(?Category $category): bool
53:     {
54:         $seen = [];
55:         while ($category) {
56:             if (! $category->is_active || isset($seen[$category->id]) || count($seen) >= 3) {
57:                 return false;
58:             }
59:             $seen[$category->id] = true;
60:             if ($category->parent_id === null) {
61:                 return true;
62:             }
63:             $category = Category::find($category->parent_id);
64:         }
65: 
66:         return false;
67:     }
68: }
````

````php
 27:                     unset($data['image']);
 28:                     $data = array_filter($data, fn ($value) => $value !== null);
 29: 
 30:                     if (empty($data['slug'])) {
 31:                         $data['slug'] = SlugService::make(Category::class, $data['name_en']);
 32:                     }
 33: 
 34:                     if (! empty($data['parent_id'])) {
 35:                         $parent = Category::whereKey($data['parent_id'])->sharedLock()->firstOrFail();
 36:                         if ($parent->depth() >= 3) {
 37:                             throw new BusinessException('أقصى عمق للأقسام 3 مستويات');
 38:                         }
 39:                     }
 40: 
 41:                     return Category::create($data);
 42:                 });

 45:                 // tree lock, in its own short transaction — network I/O must

 54:                     $data['slug'] = SlugService::make(Category::class, $data['name_en']);
 55: 
 56:                     continue;
 57:                 }
 58:                 throw new BusinessException('المعرف (slug) مستخدم بالفعل؛ اختر قيمة أخرى.', [], 409);
 59:             }
 60:         }
 61:     }
 62: 
 63:     public function update(Category $category, array $data, ?UploadedFile $image): Category
 64:     {
 65:         $expectedVersion = $data['expected_version'] ?? null;
 66:         unset($data['expected_version']);
 67:         $removeImage = (bool) ($data['remove_image'] ?? false);
 68:         unset($data['image'], $data['remove_image']);
 69:         if (isset($data['parent_id'])) {
 70:             $data['parent_id'] = (int) $data['parent_id'];
 71:         }
 72: 
 73:         foreach (['sort_order', 'is_active'] as $field) {
 74:             if (array_key_exists($field, $data) && $data[$field] === null) {
 75:                 unset($data[$field]);
 76:             }
 77:         }
 78:         $apply = function (bool $exclusive) use ($category, $data, $expectedVersion): ?Category {
 79:             return DB::transaction(function () use ($category, $data, $exclusive, $expectedVersion) {
 80:                 CatalogLock::tree(shared: ! $exclusive);
 81:                 $category = Category::whereKey($category->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
 82:                 if ($expectedVersion !== null && (int) $expectedVersion !== (int) $category->lock_version) {
 83:                     throw new BusinessException('القسم تعدّل في جلسة أخرى؛ أعد تحميل الصفحة وحاول مجددًا.', [], 409);
 84:                 }
 85:                 $parentChanged = array_key_exists('parent_id', $data) && $data['parent_id'] !== $category->parent_id;
 86:                 $activeChanged = isset($data['is_active']) && (bool) $data['is_active'] !== $category->is_active;

 96:                 if (array_key_exists('slug', $data) && empty($data['slug'])) {
 97:                     $data['slug'] = SlugService::make(Category::class, $data['name_en'] ?? $category->name_en, $category->id);
 98:                 }
 99: 
100:                 foreach (['sort_order', 'is_active'] as $field) {
101:                     if (array_key_exists($field, $data) && $data[$field] === null) {
102:                         unset($data[$field]);
103:                     }
104:                 }
105: 
106:                 $category->update($data);
107: 
108:                 return $category;
109:             });
110:         };
111: 
112:         // F8: a concurrent update can win the slug between validation and the
113:         // write — surface it as 409, not 500.
114:         try {

118:         }

121:         if ($image) {

127:         return $updated;
128:     }
129: 
130:     /**
131:      * F2: attach the image in its own short transaction with no tree lock.
132:      * The image is optional, so a failed upload keeps the saved row and
133:      * reports a clear message instead of rolling back the data.
134:      */
135:     private function attachImage(Category $category, UploadedFile $image): void
136:     {
137:         try {
138:             DB::transaction(fn () => $category->addMedia($image)->toMediaCollection('image'));
139:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
140:             report($e);
141:             throw new BusinessException('تم حفظ القسم لكن فشل رفع الصورة؛ أعد رفعها من صفحة التعديل.', ['category_id' => [$category->id]], 422, 'category_image_failed');
142:         }
143:     }

145:     public function delete(Category $category): void
146:     {
147:         DB::transaction(function () use ($category): void {
148:             $this->lockTree();
149:             $locked = Category::whereKey($category->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
150: 
151:             if ($locked->children()->exists()) {
152:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن حذف قسم يحتوي على أقسام فرعية');
153:             }
154: 
155:             if ($locked->products()->exists()) {
156:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن حذف قسم مرتبط بمنتجات');
157:             }
158: 
159:             $locked->delete();
160:         });
161:     }
162: 
163:     public function reorder(array $items): void
164:     {
165:         // Retry with an exclusive tree lock only if the fresh snapshot contains a move.
166:         // Never upgrade a shared advisory lock while retaining it.
167:         $apply = function (bool $exclusive) use ($items): bool {
168:             return DB::transaction(function () use ($items, $exclusive): bool {
169:                 CatalogLock::tree(shared: ! $exclusive);
170:                 $categories = Category::query()->get()->keyBy('id');
171:                 $nodes = $categories->toArray();
172:                 $moved = false;
173:                 foreach ($items as $item) {
174:                     if (! array_key_exists('parent_id', $item)) {
175:                         throw new BusinessException('يجب إرسال parent_id لكل عنصر في الترتيب');
176:                     }
177:                     $category = $categories->get($item['id']);
178:                     if (! $category) {
179:                         throw new BusinessException('القسم غير موجود', ['items' => ['أحد الأقسام لم يعد متاحًا']]);
180:                     }
181:                     $parentId = $item['parent_id'] === null ? null : (int) $item['parent_id'];
182:                     $moved = $moved || $parentId !== $category->parent_id;
183:                     $nodes[$category->id]['parent_id'] = $parentId;
184:                 }
185:                 if ($moved && ! $exclusive) {
186:                     return false;
187:                 }
188:                 if ($moved) {
189:                     CategoryHierarchy::assertValid($nodes);
190:                     CategoryHierarchy::assertPublishedPathsActive($nodes);
191:                 }
192:                 // M11: apply row updates in id order so concurrent order-only
193:                 // requests acquire row locks in the same order (no deadlock).
194:                 $ordered = collect($items)->sortBy('id')->values()->all();
195:                 foreach ($ordered as $item) {
196:                     $categories->get($item['id'])->update(['parent_id' => $nodes[$item['id']]['parent_id'], 'sort_order' => $item['sort_order']]);
197:                 }
198: 
199:                 return true;
200:             });
201:         };
202:         if (! $apply(false)) {
203:             $apply(true);
204:         }
205:     }
206: 
207:     public function tree(bool $onlyActive = false): Collection
208:     {
209:         $all = Category::query()->with('media')->withCount(['products', 'products as all_products_count' => fn ($q) => $q->withTrashed()])
210:             ->when($onlyActive, fn ($q) => $q->where('is_active', true))
211:             ->orderBy('sort_order')->orderBy('id')->get();
212:         $grouped = $all->groupBy('parent_id');
213:         $build = function ($parentId) use (&$build, $grouped) {
214:             return ($grouped[$parentId ?? ''] ?? collect())->map(function ($cat) use ($build) {
215:                 $cat->setRelation('children', $build($cat->id));
216: 
217:                 return $cat;
218:             })->values();
219:         };
220: 
221:         return $build(null);
222:     }
223: 
224:     public function assertValidParent(Category $category, ?int $parentId): void
225:     {
226:         $nodes = CategoryHierarchy::snapshot();
227:         $nodes[$category->id]['parent_id'] = $parentId;
228:         CategoryHierarchy::assertValid($nodes);
229:         CategoryHierarchy::assertPublishedPathsActive($nodes);
230:     }
231: 
232:     private function lockTree(): void
233:     {
234:         CatalogLock::tree();
235:     }
236: }
````

## File: backend/app/Services/Catalog/ProductMediaService.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services\Catalog;
  6: 
  7: use App\Enums\ProductStatus;
  8: use App\Exceptions\BusinessException;
  9: use App\Models\Product;
 10: use App\Models\ProductVariant;
 11: use Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\LockTimeoutException;
 12: use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
 13: use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
 14: use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
 15: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
 16: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 17: use Illuminate\Support\Str;
 18: use Spatie\MediaLibrary\Conversions\FileManipulator;
 19: use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
 20: 
 21: class ProductMediaService
 22: {
 23:     public function index(Product $product): Collection
 24:     {
 25:         $variantIds = $product->variants()->withTrashed()->pluck('id');
 26:         $media = Media::query()
 27:             ->whereIn('collection_name', ['images', 'video'])
 28:             ->where(fn ($q) => $q->where(['model_type' => Product::class, 'model_id' => $product->id])
 29:                 ->orWhere(fn ($w) => $w->where('model_type', ProductVariant::class)->whereIn('model_id', $variantIds)))
 30:             ->orderBy('order_column')->orderBy('id')->get();
 31: 
 32:         return $media;
 33:     }
 34: 
 35:     public function upload(Product $product, array $data, array $files = [], ?UploadedFile $file = null): Collection
 36:     {
 37:         // Images serialize with reorder through a shared cache lock. Network
 38:         // uploads happen before the short database transaction that links them.
 39:         $product = Product::whereKey($product->id)->firstOrFail();
 40:         $owner = ! empty($data['variant_id']) ? $product->variants()->findOrFail($data['variant_id']) : $product;
 41:         if ($data['collection'] === 'video') {
 42:             if ($owner instanceof ProductVariant) {
 43:                 throw new BusinessException('الفيديو للمنتج فقط');
 44:             }
 45: 
 46:             // Upload first; serialize only the short replacement so concurrent
 47:             // uploads cannot delete each other's new single-file video.
 48:             $media = $product->addMedia($file)->toMediaCollection('video_staging', 'r2_public');
 49:             try {
 50:                 DB::transaction(function () use ($product, $media): void {
 51:                     $fresh = Product::whereKey($product->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
 52:                     $fresh->media()->where('collection_name', 'video')->get()->each->delete();
 53:                     $media->update(['collection_name' => 'video']);
 54:                 });
 55:             } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
 56:                 $media->delete();
 57:                 throw $exception;
 58:             }
 59: 
 60:             return collect([$media]);
 61:         }
 62: 
 63:         // M4: one transaction per image; a retried client_upload_id
 64:         // replays the stored row instead of uploading a duplicate.
 65:         $clientIds = array_values((array) ($data['client_upload_ids'] ?? []));
 66: 
 67:         return collect(array_values($files))->map(fn ($image, $index) => $this->storeOne($owner, $image, $clientIds[$index] ?? null));
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     private function storeOne(Product|ProductVariant $owner, UploadedFile $image, ?string $clientUploadId): Media
 71:     {
 72:         $productId = $owner instanceof Product ? $owner->id : $owner->product_id;
 73: 
 74:         return $this->withMediaLock($productId, fn () => $this->storeOneUnlocked($owner, $image, $clientUploadId));
 75:     }
 76: 
 77:     private function withMediaLock(int $productId, \Closure $operation): mixed
 78:     {
 79:         try {
 80:             return Cache::lock('catalog-media:'.$productId, 300)->block(5, $operation);
 81:         } catch (LockTimeoutException) {
 82:             throw new BusinessException('جاري رفع أو ترتيب وسائط المنتج؛ أعد المحاولة بعد لحظات.', [], 409);
 83:         }
 84:     }
 85: 
 86:     private function storeOneUnlocked(Product|ProductVariant $owner, UploadedFile $image, ?string $clientUploadId): Media
 87:     {
 88:         if (is_string($clientUploadId) && $clientUploadId !== '') {
 89:             $existing = Media::query()
 90:                 ->where('model_type', $owner->getMorphClass())
 91:                 ->where('model_id', $owner->getKey())
 92:                 ->where('custom_properties->client_upload_id', $clientUploadId)
 93:                 ->first();
 94:             if ($existing) {
 95:                 if ($existing->collection_name === 'images_staging' && $existing->created_at->lt(now()->subMinutes(15))) {
 96:                     $existing->delete();
 97:                     $existing = null;
 98:                 }
 99:             }
100:             if ($existing) {
101:                 if ($existing->collection_name !== 'images') {
102:                     throw new BusinessException('لم يكتمل رفع الصورة بعد؛ أعد المحاولة بعد لحظات.', [], 409);
103:                 }
104: 
105:                 return $existing;
106:             }
107:         }
108: 
109:         // F3: بلا معاملة وبلا قفل مالك — الرفع (I/O شبكي على R2) والتحويلات
110:         // المُدرجة على الطابور كانت يحبسان صف المنتج/المتغير ثوانٍ لكل ملف.
111:         // الفهرس الفريد الجزئي على client_upload_id هو الحارس من التكرار،
112:         // وإعادة المحاولة بنفس المعرّف تعيد صف الفائز عبر الالتقاط أدناه.
113:         $stagingId = (string) Str::uuid();
114:         try {
115:             $properties = ['staging_upload_id' => $stagingId];
116:             if (is_string($clientUploadId) && $clientUploadId !== '') {
117:                 $properties['client_upload_id'] = $clientUploadId;
118:             }
119:             $adder = $owner->addMedia($image)->withCustomProperties($properties);
120:             $media = $adder->toMediaCollection('images_staging');
121:             try {
122:                 DB::transaction(function () use ($owner, $media): void {
123:                     $productId = $owner instanceof Product ? $owner->id : $owner->product_id;
124:                     Product::whereKey($productId)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
125:                     if ($owner instanceof ProductVariant) {
126:                         ProductVariant::whereKey($owner->id)->where('product_id', $productId)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
127:                     }
128:                     $media->update(['collection_name' => 'images']);
129:                     DB::afterCommit(function () use ($media): void {
130:                         try {
131:                             app(FileManipulator::class)->createDerivedFiles($media);
132:                         } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
133:                             report($exception);
134:                         }
135:                     });
136:                 });
137:             } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
138:                 $media->delete();
139:                 throw $exception;
140:             }
141: 
142:             return $media->refresh();
143:         } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException $exception) {
144:             // Concurrent retry with the same client_upload_id: replay the winner.
145:             $existing = Media::query()
146:                 ->where('model_type', $owner->getMorphClass())
147:                 ->where('model_id', $owner->getKey())
148:                 ->where('custom_properties->client_upload_id', $clientUploadId)
149:                 ->first();
150:             if ($clientUploadId && $existing && $existing->collection_name === 'images') {
151:                 return $existing;
152:             }
153:             if ($clientUploadId && $existing) {
154:                 throw new BusinessException('لم يكتمل رفع الصورة بعد؛ أعد المحاولة بعد لحظات.', [], 409);
155:             }
156:             throw $exception;
157:         } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
158:             Media::query()->where('model_type', $owner->getMorphClass())->where('model_id', $owner->id)
159:                 ->where('collection_name', 'images_staging')->where('custom_properties->staging_upload_id', $stagingId)
160:                 ->get()->each->delete();
161:             throw $exception;
162:         }
163:     }
164: 
165:     public function reorder(Product $product, array $ids): void
166:     {
167:         $this->withMediaLock($product->id, fn () => DB::transaction(function () use ($product, $ids): void {
168:             $product = Product::whereKey($product->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
169:             $this->assertMediaBelongs($product, $ids);
170:             // L6: a partial id list duplicates order_column across the
171:             // product/variant scope — require the complete owner-collection
172:             // list before renumbering.
173:             $this->assertCompleteOrderList($ids);
174:             Media::setNewOrder($ids);
175:         }));
176:     }
177: 
178:     public function delete(Product $product, Media $media): void
179:     {
180:         // F9 مغطى في TransactionalMediaObserver: حذف الملفات مؤجل لـ
181:         // afterCommit (فشل المعاملة يُبقي الملفات)، وملفات الرفع المُجهضة
182:         // تُنظَّف عند الـ rollback، مع أمر media:prune-orphans الدوري.
183:         DB::transaction(function () use ($product, $media): void {
184:             $product = Product::whereKey($product->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
185:             $media = Media::whereKey($media->id)->firstOrFail();
186:             $this->assertMediaBelongs($product, [$media->id]);
187:             // L6: validate before deleting, not after with a rollback — the
188:             // file-removal observer must never run for a rejected delete.
189:             if ($product->status === ProductStatus::Published && $media->collection_name === 'images'
190:                 && ! $this->hasOtherImages($product, $media->id)) {
191:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن حذف آخر صورة لمنتج منشور');
192:             }
193:             $media->delete();
194:         });
195:     }
196: 
197:     private function assertMediaBelongs(Product $product, array $ids): void
198:     {
199:         $variantIds = $product->variants()->withTrashed()->pluck('id')->all();
200:         $count = Media::whereIn('id', $ids)->where(fn ($q) => $q
201:             ->where(fn ($w) => $w->where('model_type', Product::class)->where('model_id', $product->id))
202:             ->orWhere(fn ($w) => $w->where('model_type', ProductVariant::class)->whereIn('model_id', $variantIds))
203:         )->count();
204:         if ($count !== count(array_unique($ids))) {
205:             abort(404, 'ملف غير تابع لهذا المنتج');
206:         }
207:     }
208: 
209:     /** L6: another usable image must remain besides the one being deleted. */
210:     private function hasOtherImages(Product $product, int $exceptMediaId): bool
211:     {
212:         $variantIds = $product->variants()->where('is_active', true)->pluck('id')->all();
213: 
214:         return Media::query()
215:             ->where('collection_name', 'images')
216:             ->whereKeyNot($exceptMediaId)
217:             ->where(fn ($q) => $q
218:                 ->where(fn ($w) => $w->where('model_type', Product::class)->where('model_id', $product->id))
219:                 ->orWhere(fn ($w) => $w->where('model_type', ProductVariant::class)->whereIn('model_id', $variantIds)))
220:             ->exists();
221:     }
222: 
223:     /** Reorder exactly one owner's complete media collection. */
224:     private function assertCompleteOrderList(array $ids): void
225:     {
226:         $first = Media::query()->whereIn('id', $ids)->first();
227:         if ($first === null || count($ids) !== count(array_unique($ids))) {
228:             throw new BusinessException('قائمة الترتيب يجب أن تشمل مجموعة وسائط كاملة لمالك واحد.');
229:         }
230:         $total = Media::query()
231:             ->where('model_type', $first->model_type)
232:             ->where('model_id', $first->model_id)
233:             ->where('collection_name', $first->collection_name)
234:             ->count();
235:         $selected = Media::query()->whereIn('id', $ids)
236:             ->where('model_type', $first->model_type)->where('model_id', $first->model_id)
237:             ->where('collection_name', $first->collection_name)->count();
238:         if (count($ids) !== $total || $selected !== $total) {
239:             throw new BusinessException('قائمة الترتيب يجب أن تشمل مجموعة وسائط كاملة لمالك واحد.');
240:         }
241:     }
242: }
````

````php
215:             // concurrent receipts serialize here instead of slipping underneath it.
216:             $lockedIds = ProductVariant::where('product_id', $product->id)->orderBy('id')->lockForUpdate()->pluck('id');
217:             // حذف المنتج يحذف متغيراته ناعمًا: أي رصيد على أي منها يُحبس (M-9)
218:             if (StockLevel::query()->whereIn('product_variant_id', $lockedIds)->hasNonZeroBalance()->exists()) {
219:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن حذف منتج له متغيرات برصيد مخزون؛ صفِّ الأرصدة أولًا.');
220:             }
221:             $product->variants()->delete();  // soft
222:             $product->delete();              // soft
223:         });
224:         // TODO مرحلة الطلبات: منع الحذف لو المنتج عليه طلبات، وبدل كده يتعمل archived
225:     }
226: 
227:     /**
228:      * F14: permanent removal also removes the media rows AND their R2 files —
229:      * soft-delete intentionally keeps them (old links/caches keep working),
230:      * but a force-delete must not leave publicly reachable files behind.
231:      */
232:     public function forceDelete(Product $product): void
233:     {
234:         DB::transaction(function () use ($product): void {
235:             $product = Product::withTrashed()->whereKey($product->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
236:             $variants = $product->variants()->withTrashed()->reorder('id')->lockForUpdate()->get();
237:             if (StockLevel::query()->whereIn('product_variant_id', $variants->pluck('id'))->hasNonZeroBalance()->exists()) {
238:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن الحذف النهائي لمنتج له متغيرات برصيد مخزون؛ صفِّ الأرصدة أولًا.');
239:             }
240:             foreach ($variants as $variant) {
241:                 $variant->clearMediaCollection('images');
242:                 $variant->forceDelete();
243:             }
244:             $product->clearMediaCollection('images');
245:             $product->clearMediaCollection('video');
246:             $product->forceDelete();
247:         });
248:     }
249: }
````

````php
  1: <?php
````

````php
  5: namespace App\Services\Catalog;
  6: 
  7: use App\Enums\ProductStatus;

 16: class VariantService
 17: {
 18:     public function __construct(private ProductPublishabilityChecker $publishability) {}
 19: 
 20:     public function create(Product $product, array $data): ProductVariant
 21:     {
 22:         $data = array_filter($data, fn ($value) => $value !== null);
 23: 
 24:         // M1: auto-SKU races retry once; explicit conflicts surface as 409.
 25:         $autoSku = empty($data['sku']);
 26:         for ($attempt = 0; ; $attempt++) {
 27:             try {
 28:                 return DB::transaction(function () use ($product, $data) {
 29:                     $product = Product::whereKey($product->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail(); // منع تكرار الترقيم
 30:                     $this->assertUniqueCombination($product, $data);
 31: 
 32:                     if (empty($data['sku'])) {
 33:                         $seq = $product->variants()->withTrashed()->count() + 1;
 34:                         do {
 35:                             $sku = $product->code.'-'.str_pad((string) $seq, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
 36:                             $seq++;
 37:                         } while (ProductVariant::withTrashed()->where('sku', $sku)->exists());
 38:                         $data['sku'] = $sku;
 39:                     }
 40: 
 41:                     $variant = $product->variants()->create($data);
 42: 
 43:                     if (empty($variant->barcode)) {
 44:                         $variant->update(['barcode' => BarcodeGenerator::fromId($variant->id)]);
 45:                     }
 46: 
 47:                     // متغير جديد على منتج منشور لازم ميكسرش قواعد النشر، وإلا التعديل كله يتلغي
 48:                     if ($product->status === ProductStatus::Published) {
 49:                         $this->publishability->assertPublishable($product);
 50:                     }
 51: 
 52:                     return $variant;
 53:                 });
 54:             } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException $e) {
 55:                 if ($autoSku && $attempt === 0) {
 56:                     continue;
 57:                 }
 58:                 throw new BusinessException('الـ SKU أو الباركود مستخدم بالفعل؛ اختر قيمة أخرى.', [], 409);
 59:             }
 60:         }
 61:     }
 62: 
 63:     public function update(ProductVariant $variant, array $data): ProductVariant
 64:     {
 65:         $expectedVersion = $data['expected_version'] ?? null;
 66:         unset($data['expected_version']);
 67:         foreach (['cost_price', 'reorder_level', 'sort_order', 'is_active'] as $field) {
 68:             if (array_key_exists($field, $data) && $data[$field] === null) {
 69:                 unset($data[$field]);
 70:             }
 71:         }
 72: 
 73:         // F8: a concurrent update can win the SKU/barcode between validation
 74:         // and the write — surface it as 409, not 500.
 75:         try {
 76:             return DB::transaction(function () use ($variant, $data, $expectedVersion) {
 77:                 $product = Product::whereKey($variant->product_id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
 78:                 $variant = $product->variants()->whereKey($variant->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
 79:                 if ($expectedVersion !== null && (int) $expectedVersion !== (int) $variant->lock_version) {
 80:                     throw new BusinessException('المتغير تعدّل في جلسة أخرى؛ أعد تحميل الصفحة وحاول مجددًا.', [], 409);
 81:                 }
 82:                 $this->assertUniqueCombination($product, array_merge($variant->only(['color_name_en', 'size', 'capacity']), $data), $variant->id);
 83: 
 84:                 if (array_key_exists('is_active', $data) && ! $data['is_active']) {
 85:                     $this->assertNotLastActiveOfPublished($variant);
 86:                 }
 87:                 if (array_key_exists('barcode', $data) && blank($data['barcode'])) {
 88:                     $data['barcode'] = BarcodeGenerator::fromId($variant->id);
 89:                 }
 90:                 $variant->update($data);
 91: 
 92:                 // أي تعديل على متغير منتج منشور بيعيد فحص قواعد النشر جوه نفس الـ transaction
 93:                 if ($product->status === ProductStatus::Published) {
 94:                     $this->publishability->assertPublishable($product);
 95:                 }
 96: 
 97:                 return $variant->fresh(['media', 'product']);
 98:             });
 99:         } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException $e) {
100:             throw new BusinessException('الـ SKU أو الباركود مستخدم بالفعل؛ اختر قيمة أخرى.', [], 409);
101:         }
102:     }
103: 
104:     public function delete(ProductVariant $variant): void
105:     {
106:         DB::transaction(function () use ($variant): void {
107:             $product = Product::whereKey($variant->product_id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
108:             // H3: lock the variant rows (id-ordered) before the balance check so a
109:             // concurrent receipt serializes here; in READ COMMITTED the check then
110:             // sees its committed movement instead of a phantom zero.
111:             ProductVariant::whereKey($variant->id)->orderBy('id')->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
112:             $variant = $product->variants()->whereKey($variant->id)->firstOrFail();
113:             $this->assertNotLastActiveOfPublished($variant);
114:             // متغير له رصيد في أي وعاء لا يُحذف: الحذف الناعم كان يحبس الرصيد
115:             // لأن فحوص وجود المتغير تستبعد المحذوف (M-9). صفِّ الرصيد أولًا.
116:             if (StockLevel::query()->where('product_variant_id', $variant->id)->hasNonZeroBalance()->exists()) {
117:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن حذف متغير له رصيد مخزون؛ صفِّ رصيده أولًا أو عطّله بدلًا من حذفه.');
118:             }
119:             $variant->delete();
120: 
121:             if ($product->status === ProductStatus::Published) {
122:                 $this->publishability->assertPublishable($product);
123:             }
124:         });
125:     }
126: 
127:     private function assertUniqueCombination(Product $product, array $d, ?int $ignoreId = null): void
128:     {
129:         // المقارنة من غير حساسية لحالة الحروف: Black وblack نفس اللون
130:         $matchField = fn ($q, string $column, ?string $value) => $value === null
131:             ? $q->whereNull($column)
132:             : $q->whereRaw("lower({$column}) = ?", [mb_strtolower($value)]);
133: 
134:         $exists = $product->variants()
135:             ->when($ignoreId, fn ($q) => $q->where('id', '!=', $ignoreId))
136:             ->where(fn ($q) => $matchField($q, 'color_name_en', $d['color_name_en'] ?? null))
137:             ->where(fn ($q) => $matchField($q, 'size', $d['size'] ?? null))
138:             ->where(fn ($q) => $matchField($q, 'capacity', $d['capacity'] ?? null))
139:             ->exists();
140:         if ($exists) {
141:             throw new BusinessException('يوجد متغير بنفس اللون والمقاس والسعة لهذا المنتج');
142:         }
143:     }
144: 
145:     private function assertNotLastActiveOfPublished(ProductVariant $variant): void
146:     {
147:         $product = $variant->product;
148:         if ($product->status === ProductStatus::Published
149:             && $product->variants()->where('is_active', true)->where('id', '!=', $variant->id)->doesntExist()) {
150:             throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن حذف/تعطيل آخر متغير نشط في منتج منشور');
151:         }
152:     }
153: }
````

## File: backend/app/Services/BarcodeGenerator.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Services;
 6: 
 7: /**
 8:  * Internal EAN-13 barcode generator.
 9:  *
10:  * Uses the GS1 prefix '2' reserved for internal in-store item numbering
11:  * and computes the standard modulo 10 checksum digit.
12:  */
13: class BarcodeGenerator
14: {
15:     /**
16:      * Generate a valid 13-digit EAN-13 barcode string from an entity ID.
17:      *
18:      * @param  int  $id
19:      * @return string
20:      */
21:     public static function fromId(int $id): string
22:     {
23:         $base = '2'.str_pad((string) $id, 11, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
24:         $sum = 0;
25:         for ($i = 0; $i < 12; $i++) {
26:             $d = (int) $base[$i];
27:             $sum += ($i % 2 === 0) ? $d : $d * 3;
28:         }
29: 
30:         return $base.((10 - ($sum % 10)) % 10);
31:     }
32: }
````

````php
141:     public function getAllGrouped(): array

147:             ->orderBy('key')
148:             ->get()
149:             ->mapWithKeys(fn (Setting $setting): array => [

171:     private function staticSettings(): array

173:         $read = function (): array {

177:                 ->orderBy('key')
178:                 ->get()
179:                 ->groupBy('group')
180:                 ->map(fn ($settings): array => $settings
181:                     ->mapWithKeys(fn (Setting $setting): array => [
182:                         $setting->key => $this->castValue($setting->value, $setting->type),
183:                     ])
184:                     ->all())
185:                 ->all();
186:         };
187: 
188:         $inTransaction = DB::transactionLevel() > 0;
189:         if ($inTransaction && $this->transactionSnapshot !== null) {
190:             return $this->transactionSnapshot;
191:         }
192:         if ($inTransaction && $this->uncommittedSettings) {
193:             return $this->transactionSnapshot = $read();
194:         }
195:         $version = Cache::get(self::CACHE_VERSION_KEY);
196:         if (! is_string($version)) {

228:             $type = array_search($key, self::SEQUENCE_TYPES, true);
229:             if (is_string($type)) {
230:                 return $this->nextDocumentNumber($type);

232:             $setting = Setting::query()->where('key', $key)->first();
233: 
234:             return $setting ? $this->castValue($setting->value, $setting->type) : $default;
235:         }
236:         foreach ($this->staticSettings() as $settings) {
237:             if (array_key_exists($key, $settings)) {
238:                 return $settings[$key];
239:             }
240:         }
241: 
242:         if ($default === null && array_key_exists($key, self::DEFAULTS)) {
243:             return self::DEFAULTS[$key];
244:         }
245: 
246:         return $default;

269:     private function assertNumberingDoesNotCollide(array $settings, array $after): void
270:     {

273:             $target = self::NUMBERING_TARGETS[$type] ?? null;
274:             if ($target === null || array_intersect($keys, array_keys($settings)) === []) {
275:                 continue;
276:             }
277: 
278:             $prefix = array_key_exists($definition['prefix'], $after)
279:                 ? (string) $after[$definition['prefix']]
280:                 : (string) $this->get($definition['prefix'], '');
281:             $padding = array_key_exists($definition['padding'], $after)
282:                 ? max(0, (int) $after[$definition['padding']])
283:                 : max(0, (int) $this->get($definition['padding'], 0));
284:             $next = array_key_exists($definition['next'], $after)
285:                 ? (int) $after[$definition['next']]
286:                 : ($type === 'movement' ? $this->nextMovementNumber() : $this->nextDocumentNumber($type));
287: 
288:             // Collision scan covers the next number AND any future number:
289:             // any existing document sharing this prefix whose numeric suffix
290:             // is >= the proposed counter would collide now or later.
291:             $escaped = addcslashes($prefix, '\\%_');
292:             $existing = DB::table($target[0])->where($target[1], 'like', $escaped.'%')->pluck($target[1]);
293:             $max = null;
294:             foreach ($existing as $number) {
295:                 // The remainder after the prefix must be purely numeric:
296:                 // that numeric suffix is what future counters would reproduce.
297:                 $tail = trim(substr((string) $number, strlen($prefix)));
298:                 if ($tail === '' || ! ctype_digit($tail)) {
299:                     continue;
300:                 }
301:                 $max = max($max ?? 0, (int) $tail);
302:             }
303: 
304:             if ($max !== null && $max >= $next) {
305:                 throw ValidationException::withMessages([
306:                     $definition['next'] => 'الرقم '.$prefix.str_pad((string) $next, $padding, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT).' مستخدم بالفعل في '.$target[0].'. غيّر البداية أو البادئة أو الطول.',
307:                 ]);
308:             }
309:         }
310:     }

312:     /**
313:      * Update a flat key/value map atomically and invalidate the cached settings after commit.
314:      *
315:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $settings
316:      *
317:      * @throws JsonException
318:      */
319:     public function updateBatch(array $settings, ?array $expected = null, array $via = []): void
320:     {
321:         $this->warnings = [];
322:         DB::transaction(function () use ($settings, $expected, $via): void {
323:             $this->uncommittedSettings = true;
324:             $this->resetReadSnapshot();
325:             $movementSequenceTarget = null;
326:             /** @var array<string, int> $documentSequenceTargets */
327:             $documentSequenceTargets = [];
328:             $lockedSettings = Setting::query()
329:                 ->whereIn('key', array_keys($settings))
330:                 ->orderBy('key')
331:                 ->lockForUpdate()
332:                 ->get()
333:                 ->keyBy('key');
334: 
335:             $missingKeys = array_diff(array_keys($settings), $lockedSettings->keys()->all());
336: 
337:             if ($missingKeys !== []) {
338:                 throw new InvalidArgumentException('Settings are not initialized: '.implode(', ', $missingKeys));
339:             }
340: 
341:             $before = [];
342:             $after = [];
343:             foreach ($settings as $key => $value) {
344:                 /** @var Setting $setting */
345:                 $setting = $lockedSettings->get($key);
346:                 $current = $this->castValue($setting->value, $setting->type);
347:                 if (in_array($key, self::NUMBERING_COUNTER_KEYS, true)) {
348:                     $current = $this->get($key);
349:                 }
350:                 // M7/M8: العدادات الحية (قيم الـ sequences) بتزيد من نفسها مع
351:                 // كل فاتورة/عملية بتتنفذ — تسجيل التوقيع على القيمة الحلية
352:                 // بيورّط 409 دايمًا على الأنظمة المزدحمة. للعدادات القاعدة هي
353:                 // "الجديد ≥ الحالي" بس (فوق)، وexpected يحكم البادئة والطول
354:                 // والأنواع غير العدادية (فاتورة ضريبية مثلًا تفضل بالمساواة).
355:                 $isCounter = in_array($key, self::NUMBERING_COUNTER_KEYS, true);
356:                 if (! $isCounter && $expected !== null && (! array_key_exists($key, $expected)
357:                     || $this->comparisonValue($current, $setting->type) !== $this->comparisonValue($expected[$key], $setting->type))) {
358:                     abort(409, 'تم تغيير إعداد أو عداد منذ فتح الصفحة؛ أعد تحميل الإعدادات قبل الحفظ.');
359:                 }
360:                 $before[$key] = $current;
361: 
362:                 if (in_array($key, self::NUMBERING_COUNTER_KEYS, true)) {
363:                     $requested = $this->counterValue($value);
364:                     if ($requested > 999999999) {
365:                         throw ValidationException::withMessages([$key => 'الحد الأقصى للعداد هو 999999999.']);
366:                     }
367:                     $value = max($this->counterValue($setting->value), $requested);
368:                     if ($key === 'movement_next_number') {
369:                         $value = max($value, $this->nextMovementNumber());
370:                         $movementSequenceTarget = $value;
371:                     }
372:                     $sequenceType = array_search($key, self::SEQUENCE_TYPES, true);
373:                     if (is_string($sequenceType)) {
374:                         $value = max($value, $this->nextDocumentNumber($sequenceType));
375:                         $documentSequenceTargets[$sequenceType] = $value;
376:                     }
377:                     if ($requested < $value) {
378:                         throw ValidationException::withMessages([$key => 'لا يمكن خفض عداد الترقيم عن قيمته الحالية.']);
379:                     }
380:                 }
381: 
382:                 $setting->value = $value === null && str_ends_with($key, '_prefix')
383:                     ? ''
384:                     : $this->serializeValue($value, $setting->type);
385:                 $setting->save();
386:                 $after[$key] = $this->castValue($setting->value, $setting->type);
387:             }
388: 
389:             $this->assertNumberingDoesNotCollide($settings, $after);
390:             // M-4: تغيير البادئة أو الطول قد يعيد إصدار رقم صدر من قبل
391:             // (مثال: INV- بطول 6 أصدر INV-001000، ثم بادئة INV-00 وطول 4
392:             // يعيدان الرقم 1000 بصيغة INV-001000). التحقق الحالي يمنع
393:             // تخفيض العداد فقط. بعد تطبيق القيم الجديدة وقبل التدقيق،
394:             // نشيك أن الرقم التالي المُنسَّق غير موجود أصلًا في جدول
395:             // المستند؛ والـ unique index على عمود الرقم هو خط الدفاع
396:             // الأخير وقت التشغيل (موجود على كل أعمدة الأرقام).
397:             $this->assertNoNumberingCollision(array_keys($settings));
398: 
399:             StaffAdministration::audit(request()->user('staff'), 'settings.updated', 'settings', null, array_keys($settings),
400:                 ['settings' => $this->auditableSettings($before)], ['settings' => $this->auditableSettings($after)], $via);
401:             DB::afterCommit(fn () => $this->clearCache());
402: 
403:             // M-2: المزامنة داخل الـ transaction — الـ setval غير transactional،
404:             // ففشل لاحق (rollback) ينتج فجوة فقط، والفجوات مقبولة لهذه الأنواع.
405:             // البديل السابق (afterCommit + warning) كان يترك العداد قديمًا
406:             // فيكرر أرقام مستندات.
407:             if ($movementSequenceTarget !== null) {
408:                 DB::selectOne('SELECT inventory_movement_number(?) AS number', [$movementSequenceTarget]);
409:             }
410:             foreach ($documentSequenceTargets as $type => $minimum) {
411:                 DB::selectOne('SELECT document_next_number(?, ?) AS number', [$type, $minimum]);
412:             }
413:         }, attempts: 3);
414:     }
415: 
416:     /**
417:      * Atomically return and increment the next document number for the requested type.
418:      *
419:      * @throws JsonException
420:      */
421:     public function generateNextNumber(string $type): string
422:     {
423:         if ($type === 'movement') {
424:             [$prefix, $padding] = $this->numberingConfig('movement', 'movement_prefix', 'movement_padding');
425:             $number = DB::selectOne('SELECT inventory_movement_number() AS number')->number;
426: 
427:             return $prefix.str_pad((string) $number, $padding, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
428:         }
429:         if (isset(self::SEQUENCE_TYPES[$type])) {
430:             $definitions = $this->numberingDefinitions();
431:             $definition = $definitions[$type];
432:             [$prefix, $padding] = $this->numberingConfig($type, $definition['prefix'], $definition['padding']);
433:             $number = DB::selectOne('SELECT document_next_number(?) AS number', [$type])->number;
434: 
435:             return $prefix.str_pad((string) $number, $padding, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
436:         }
437:         $definitions = $this->numberingDefinitions();
438: 
439:         if (! isset($definitions[$type])) {
440:             throw new InvalidArgumentException("Unsupported numbering type [{$type}].");
441:         }
442: 
443:         $definition = $definitions[$type];
444:         [$prefix, $padding] = $this->numberingConfig($type, $definition['prefix'], $definition['padding']);
445: 
446:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($definition, $prefix, $padding): string {
447:             // Counter row is locked and read fresh; prefix and padding are cached in request memory
448:             $nextSetting = Setting::query()
449:                 ->where('key', $definition['next'])
450:                 ->lockForUpdate()
451:                 ->first();
452: 
453:             if ($nextSetting === null) {
454:                 throw new InvalidArgumentException("Required numbering setting [{$definition['next']}] is missing.");
455:             }
456: 
457:             $nextValue = $this->counterValue($nextSetting->value);
458: 
459:             $formatted = $prefix.str_pad((string) $nextValue, $padding, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
460:             $nextSetting->value = (string) ($nextValue + 1);
461:             $nextSetting->save();
462: 
463:             return $formatted;
464:         }, attempts: 3);
465:     }
466: 
467:     /**
468:      * Cache numbering prefix and padding per request to reduce query overhead.
469:      *
470:      * @return array{0: string, 1: int}
471:      */
472:     private function numberingConfig(string $type, string $prefixKey, string $paddingKey): array
473:     {
474:         return $this->numberingConfig[$type] ??= (function () use ($prefixKey, $paddingKey): array {
475:             $settings = Setting::query()->whereIn('key', [$prefixKey, $paddingKey])->pluck('value', 'key');
476: 
477:             foreach ([$prefixKey, $paddingKey] as $key) {
478:                 if (! $settings->has($key)) {
479:                     throw new InvalidArgumentException("Required numbering setting [{$key}] is missing.");
480:                 }
481:             }
482: 
483:             return [(string) $settings[$prefixKey], max(0, (int) $settings[$paddingKey])];
484:         })();
485:     }
486: 
487:     public function clearCache(): void
488:     {
489:         Cache::forever(self::CACHE_VERSION_KEY, (string) Str::uuid());
490:         Cache::forget(self::CACHE_KEY); // Retire the cache key used before versioning.
491:         $this->numberingConfig = [];
492:         $this->requestCache = null;
493:         $this->resetReadSnapshot();
494:     }
495: 
496:     private function comparisonValue(mixed $value, string $type): ?string
497:     {
498:         if ($type === 'float' && $value !== null && is_numeric($value)) {
499:             return (string) BigDecimal::of((string) $value)->strippedOfTrailingZeros();
500:         }
501: 
502:         return $type === 'string' ? (string) ($value ?? '') : $this->serializeValue($value, $type);
503:     }
504: 
505:     private function auditableSettings(array $settings): array
506:     {
507:         // Only the public administrative settings schema is safe to audit as values.
508:         $allowed = array_keys((new UpdateSettingsRequest)->rules());
509: 
510:         return array_intersect_key($settings, array_flip($allowed));
511:     }

513:     /**
514:      * M-4: نوع المستند → [جدول، عمود الرقم] لفحص تصادم الترقيم.
515:      * invoice وpos_invoice بلا جدول مستندات خاص (فواتير الجملة طلبات،
516:      * وفواتير POS بلا عمود رقم مستقل) فيُتجاوزان من الفحص.
517:      *
518:      * @var array<string, array{0: string, 1: string}>
519:      */
520:     private const DOCUMENT_NUMBER_TARGETS = [
521:         'order' => ['orders', 'order_number'],
522:         'purchase_order' => ['purchase_orders', 'po_number'],
523:         'quotation' => ['quotations', 'quotation_number'],
524:         'transfer' => ['stock_transfers', 'transfer_number'],
525:         'stocktake' => ['stocktakes', 'stocktake_number'],
526:         'return' => ['return_requests', 'return_number'],
527:         'purchase_request' => ['purchase_requests', 'request_number'],
528:         'delivery' => ['supplier_deliveries', 'delivery_number'],
529:         'supplier_invoice' => ['supplier_invoices', 'invoice_number'],
530:         'supplier_payment' => ['supplier_payments', 'payment_number'],
531:         'shift' => ['pos_shifts', 'shift_number'],
532:         'expense' => ['expenses', 'expense_number'],
533:         'treasury_transfer' => ['treasury_transfers', 'transfer_number'],
534:         'payment_notice' => ['wholesale_payment_notices', 'notice_number'],
535:         'movement' => ['stock_movements', 'reference_number'],
536:     ];
537: 
538:     /**
539:      * M-4: لكل نوع مستند اتعدّلت بادئته أو طوله أو عداده، تأكد أن الرقم
540:      * التالي المُنسَّق بالصيغة الجديدة غير موجود أصلًا في جدول المستند.
541:      * استعلام exists واحد لكل نوع اتعدّل.
542:      *
543:      * @param  list<string>  $changedKeys
544:      */
545:     private function assertNoNumberingCollision(array $changedKeys): void
546:     {
547:         foreach (self::DOCUMENT_NUMBER_TARGETS as $type => [$table, $column]) {
548:             // مفاتيح الترقيم بنمط ثابت {type}_prefix/_next_number/_padding
549:             // (بما فيه movement، غير الموجود في numberingDefinitions()).
550:             $keys = [$type.'_prefix', $type.'_next_number', $type.'_padding'];
551:             if (array_intersect($keys, $changedKeys) === []) {
552:                 continue;
553:             }
554:             // قراءة طازجة داخل الـ transaction: المفاتيح المتعدّلة اتحفظت
555:             // بالفعل في الحلقة أعلاه، وغيرها بقيمها الحالية.
556:             $rows = Setting::query()->whereIn('key', $keys)->get()->keyBy('key');
557:             if ($rows->count() !== count($keys)) {
558:                 continue;
559:             }
560:             $prefix = (string) $this->castValue($rows[$keys[0]]->value, $rows[$keys[0]]->type);
561:             $next = (int) $this->castValue($rows[$keys[1]]->value, $rows[$keys[1]]->type);
562:             $padding = (int) $this->castValue($rows[$keys[2]]->value, $rows[$keys[2]]->type);
563:             $candidate = $prefix.str_pad((string) $next, $padding, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
564:             if (DB::table($table)->where($column, $candidate)->exists()) {
565:                 throw ValidationException::withMessages([$keys[0] => "الرقم التالي المُنسَّق ({$candidate}) صدر من قبل لنوع {$type}؛ غيّر البادئة أو الطول أو ارفع العداد."]);
566:             }
567:         }
568:     }
569: 
570:     /**
571:      * @return array<string, array{prefix: string, next: string, padding: string}>
572:      */
573:     private function numberingDefinitions(): array
574:     {
575:         return [
576:             'invoice' => ['prefix' => 'invoice_prefix', 'next' => 'invoice_next_number', 'padding' => 'invoice_padding'],
577:             'order' => ['prefix' => 'order_prefix', 'next' => 'order_next_number', 'padding' => 'order_padding'],
578:             'purchase_order' => ['prefix' => 'purchase_order_prefix', 'next' => 'purchase_order_next_number', 'padding' => 'purchase_order_padding'],
579:             'quotation' => ['prefix' => 'quotation_prefix', 'next' => 'quotation_next_number', 'padding' => 'quotation_padding'],
580:             'transfer' => ['prefix' => 'transfer_prefix', 'next' => 'transfer_next_number', 'padding' => 'transfer_padding'],
581:             'stocktake' => ['prefix' => 'stocktake_prefix', 'next' => 'stocktake_next_number', 'padding' => 'stocktake_padding'],
582:             'return' => ['prefix' => 'return_prefix', 'next' => 'return_next_number', 'padding' => 'return_padding'],
583:             'purchase_request' => ['prefix' => 'purchase_request_prefix', 'next' => 'purchase_request_next_number', 'padding' => 'purchase_request_padding'],
584:             'delivery' => ['prefix' => 'delivery_prefix', 'next' => 'delivery_next_number', 'padding' => 'delivery_padding'],
585:             'supplier_invoice' => ['prefix' => 'supplier_invoice_prefix', 'next' => 'supplier_invoice_next_number', 'padding' => 'supplier_invoice_padding'],
586:             'supplier_payment' => ['prefix' => 'supplier_payment_prefix',    'next' => 'supplier_payment_next_number',    'padding' => 'supplier_payment_padding'],
587:             'movement' => ['prefix' => 'movement_prefix', 'next' => 'movement_next_number', 'padding' => 'movement_padding'],
588:             'shift' => ['prefix' => 'shift_prefix',               'next' => 'shift_next_number',               'padding' => 'shift_padding'],
589:             'pos_invoice' => ['prefix' => 'pos_invoice_prefix',      'next' => 'pos_invoice_next_number',      'padding' => 'pos_invoice_padding'],
590:             'expense' => ['prefix' => 'expense_prefix',             'next' => 'expense_next_number',             'padding' => 'expense_padding'],
591:             'treasury_transfer' => ['prefix' => 'treasury_transfer_prefix',   'next' => 'treasury_transfer_next_number',   'padding' => 'treasury_transfer_padding'],
592:             'payment_notice' => ['prefix' => 'payment_notice_prefix',      'next' => 'payment_notice_next_number',      'padding' => 'payment_notice_padding'],
593:         ];
594:     }
595: 
596:     private function nextMovementNumber(): int
597:     {
598:         $sequence = DB::selectOne('SELECT last_value, is_called FROM stock_movement_number_seq');
599: 
600:         return (int) $sequence->last_value + ($sequence->is_called ? 1 : 0);
601:     }
602: 
603:     private function nextDocumentNumber(string $type): int
604:     {
605:         if (! isset(self::SEQUENCE_TYPES[$type])) {
606:             throw new InvalidArgumentException("Unsupported numbering type [{$type}].");
607:         }
608:         $sequence = DB::selectOne("SELECT last_value, is_called FROM document_{$type}_number_seq");
609: 
610:         return (int) $sequence->last_value + ($sequence->is_called ? 1 : 0);
611:     }
612: 
613:     private function counterValue(mixed $value): int
614:     {
615:         $number = (is_int($value) || is_string($value))
616:             ? filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1, 'max_range' => PHP_INT_MAX - 1]])
617:             : false;
618:         if ($number === false) {
619:             throw new BusinessException('قيمة عداد الترقيم يجب أن تكون عددًا صحيحًا موجبًا ضمن النطاق المسموح');
620:         }
621: 
622:         return $number;
623:     }
624: 
625:     private function castValue(?string $value, string $type): mixed
626:     {
627:         if ($value === null) {
628:             return null;
629:         }
630: 
631:         if ($type === 'json') {
632:             try {
633:                 return json_decode($value, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
634:             } catch (JsonException) {
635:                 return null;
636:             }
637:         }
638: 
639:         return match ($type) {
640:             'boolean' => filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN),
641:             'integer' => (int) $value,
642:             'float' => (float) $value,
643:             default => $value,
644:         };
645:     }
646: 
647:     /** @throws JsonException */
648:     private function serializeValue(mixed $value, string $type): ?string
649:     {
650:         if ($value === null) {
651:             return null;
652:         }
653: 
654:         if ($type === 'json') {
655:             return json_encode($value, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
656:         }
657: 
658:         if ($type === 'boolean') {
659:             return filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN) ? '1' : '0';
660:         }
661: 
662:         return (string) $value;
663:     }
664: }
````

````php
 83:     {

 85:             // L-5: البريد مقنّع (أول حرفين + النطاق) — تغيير بريد موظف
 86:             // هو الطريق الطبيعي للاستيلاء على حساب عبر استعادة كلمة
 87:             // المرور، فلا بد أن يظهر في before/after، لكن بلا قيمة كاملة.
 88:             'email' => self::maskEmail($user->email),
 89:             'branch_id' => $user->branch_id, 'is_active' => (bool) $user->is_active];
 90:     }
 91: 
 92:     /**
 93:      * Capture snapshot of role definition and its assigned permissions.
 94:      *
 95:      * @return array{name: string, permissions: list<string>}
 96:      */
 97:     /** @return array{name: string, is_active: bool} */
 98:     public static function mayGrantPermissions(?User $actor, array $permissions): bool
 99:     {
100:         if (! $actor instanceof User) {
101:             return false;
102:         }
103:         $actor->unsetRelation('roles')->unsetRelation('permissions');
104: 
105:         return $actor->hasRole(StaffRole::SuperAdmin->value, 'staff') || $actor->hasAllPermissions(array_values(array_unique($permissions)));
106:     }
107: 
108:     /** @param list<string> $roles */
109:     public static function mayManageUser(mixed $actor, ?User $target = null, array $roles = []): bool
110:     {
111:         if (! $actor instanceof User) {
112:             return false;
113:         }
114:         $actor->unsetRelation('roles')->unsetRelation('permissions');
115:         if ($target?->is_system) {
116:             return false;
117:         }
118:         if ($actor->hasRole(StaffRole::SuperAdmin->value, 'staff')) {
119:             return true;
120:         }
121:         if (in_array(StaffRole::SuperAdmin->value, $roles, true) || $target?->hasRole(StaffRole::SuperAdmin->value, 'staff')) {
122:             return false;
123:         }
124:         $permissions = Role::query()->where('guard_name', 'staff')->whereIn('name', $roles)->with('permissions')->get()
125:             ->flatMap(fn (Role $role) => $role->permissions->pluck('name'));
126:         if ($target !== null) {
127:             $permissions = $permissions->merge($target->getAllPermissions()->pluck('name'));
128:         }
129: 
130:         return $actor->hasAllPermissions($permissions->unique()->all());
131:     }
132: 
133:     public static function branchState(Branch $branch): array
134:     {
135:         return ['name' => $branch->name, 'is_active' => (bool) $branch->is_active];
136:     }
137: 
138:     public static function roleState(Role $role): array
139:     {
140:         return ['name' => $role->name, 'permissions' => $role->permissions()->orderBy('name')->pluck('name')->all()];
141:     }
142: 
143:     /**
144:      * Shared-lock roles in deterministic ID order to ensure they exist and prevent deletion during assignment.
145:      *
146:      * @param  list<string>  $names
147:      */
148:     public static function lockRoles(array $names): void
149:     {
150:         $roles = Role::query()->where('guard_name', 'staff')->whereIn('name', $names)
151:             ->orderBy('id')->sharedLock()->get();
152:         if ($roles->count() !== count(array_unique($names))) {
153:             throw ValidationException::withMessages(['roles' => 'قائمة الأدوار تغيرت؛ أعد التحميل ثم حاول مرة أخرى.']);
154:         }
155:     }
156: 
157:     /**
158:      * Re-verify active status and permission grant against database state.
159:      *
160:      * @param  list<string>  $permissions
161:      */
162:     public static function authorize(User $actor, array $permissions): void
163:     {
164:         $actor->refresh();
165:         abort_unless($actor->is_active && ! $actor->is_system && $actor->canAny($permissions), 403);
166:     }
167: 
168:     /**
169:      * Check if another active, non-system SuperAdmin user exists.
170:      * Used to prevent orphaning the system by deactivating or demoting the last admin.
171:      */
172:     public static function hasOtherActiveSuperAdmin(User $target): bool
173:     {
174:         return User::query()->whereKeyNot($target->id)->where('is_active', true)->where('is_system', false)
175:             ->whereHas('roles', fn ($query) => $query->where('name', StaffRole::SuperAdmin->value)->where('guard_name', 'staff'))
176:             ->exists();
177:     }
178: 
179:     /**
180:      * Record an administrative audit entry with sanitized before/after metadata.
181:      *
182:      * @param  list<string>  $fields
183:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $before
184:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $after
185:      */
186:     public static function maskEmail(mixed $email): ?string
187:     {
188:         if (! is_string($email) || trim($email) === '') {
189:             return null;
190:         }
191:         [$local, $domain] = array_pad(explode('@', $email, 2), 2, '');
192: 
193:         return mb_substr($local, 0, 2).'***'.($domain !== '' ? '@'.$domain : '');
194:     }
195: 
196:     public static function audit(?User $actor, string $action, string $targetType, int|string|null $targetId, array $fields, array $before = [], array $after = [], array $via = []): void
197:     {
198:         $allowed = array_flip(['roles', 'permissions', 'name', 'branch_id', 'is_active', 'settings', 'code', 'type', 'is_active_branch', 'email', 'discount_percentage', 'description', 'name_ar', 'name_en', 'slug', 'parent_id', 'sort_order', 'category_id', 'status', 'sales_channel', 'is_featured', 'sku', 'barcode', 'color_name_ar', 'color_name_en', 'color_hex', 'size', 'capacity', 'retail_price', 'wholesale_price', 'count', 'media_ids', 'updated_count']);
199:         $before = array_intersect_key($before, $allowed);
200:         $after = array_intersect_key($after, $allowed);
201:         if (array_key_exists('email', $before)) {
202:             $before['email'] = self::maskEmail($before['email']);
203:         }
204:         if (array_key_exists('email', $after)) {
205:             $after['email'] = self::maskEmail($after['email']);
206:         }
207:         DB::table('staff_audit_logs')->insert([
208:             'actor_id' => $actor?->id,
209:             'action' => $action,
210:             'target_type' => $targetType,
211:             'target_id' => $targetId,
212:             // Sensitive fields (passwords, tokens) are stripped; only allowed state keys are stored
213:             'metadata' => json_encode(['fields' => array_values(array_diff($fields, ['password', 'current_password', 'expected_version', 'cost_price'])),
214:                 'before' => $before, 'after' => $after,
215:                 'via' => array_intersect_key($via, array_flip(['channel', 'tool', 'entity', 'conversation_id', 'action_id'])),
216:                 'ip' => request()->ip(), 'method' => request()->method()], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),
217:             'created_at' => now(),
218:         ]);
219:     }
220: }
````

````php
39:             Schema::table('categories', function (Blueprint $table): void {
40:                 $table->dropColumn('lock_version');
41:             });
42:         }
43:     }
44: };
````

````php
 33:     /** @return array<string, Category> */

 35:     {
 36:         $tree = [
 37:             ['name_ar' => 'شنط يد', 'name_en' => 'Handbags', 'slug' => 'handbags'],
 38:             ['name_ar' => 'محافظ', 'name_en' => 'Wallets', 'slug' => 'wallets'],
 39:             ['name_ar' => 'شنط سفر', 'name_en' => 'Luggage', 'slug' => 'luggage', 'children' => [
 40:                 ['name_ar' => 'كابينة', 'name_en' => 'Cabin', 'slug' => 'cabin'],

 42:                 ['name_ar' => 'كبيرة', 'name_en' => 'Large', 'slug' => 'large'],
 43:             ]],
 44:             ['name_ar' => 'شنط ظهر', 'name_en' => 'Backpacks', 'slug' => 'backpacks'],
 45:         ];
 46: 
 47:         $categories = [];
 48:         foreach ($tree as $i => $node) {
 49:             $parent = Category::firstOrCreate(
 50:                 ['slug' => $node['slug']],
 51:                 ['name_ar' => $node['name_ar'], 'name_en' => $node['name_en'], 'sort_order' => $i, 'is_active' => true],
 52:             );
 53:             $categories[$node['slug']] = $parent;
 54:             foreach ($node['children'] ?? [] as $j => $child) {
 55:                 $categories[$child['slug']] = Category::firstOrCreate(
 56:                     ['slug' => $child['slug']],
 57:                     ['parent_id' => $parent->id, 'name_ar' => $child['name_ar'], 'name_en' => $child['name_en'], 'sort_order' => $j, 'is_active' => true],
 58:                 );
 59:             }
 60:         }
 61: 
 62:         return $categories;
 63:     }

 65:     /** @return array<string, Brand> */
 66:     private function seedBrands(): array

 74:         ] as $i => $brand) {

 77:                 ['name_ar' => $brand['name_ar'], 'name_en' => $brand['name_en'], 'is_active' => true],
 78:             );
 79:         }
 80: 
 81:         return $brands;
 82:     }
````
