184: export default function AssistantBlock({ block, busy, status, execute, onPick, onAction, onPrompt }: Props) {
185:   const [dlError, setDlError] = useState('');
186:   const [typed, setTyped] = useState('');
187:   const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
188:   const [now, setNow] = useState(Date.now());
189:   const [open, setOpen] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
190:   const [showAllPrices, setShowAllPrices] = useState(false);
191:   const items = (block.items ?? []) as { key: string; label: string; change: string; before?: unknown; after?: unknown; ok?: boolean; message?: string }[];
192:   const [selected, setSelected] = useState(() => items.map(item => item.key));
193:   // أول قيمة للمهلة المتبقية — بنستخدمها كـ "إجمالي" لحلقة العدّاد.
194:   const ttlTotal = useRef<number | null>(null);
195:   const undoTotal = useRef<number | null>(null);
196: 
197:   useEffect(() => {
198:     if (!block.expires_at && !block.undo_available_until) return;
199:     const timer = window.setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000);
200:     return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
201:   }, [block.expires_at, block.undo_available_until]);
202: 
203:   const options = useMemo(() => (block.options ?? []) as { id: string | number; label: string; meta?: string; disabled?: string }[], [block.options]);
204: 
205:   /* ---------------- Category tree (B.1) ---------------- */
206:   if (block.type === 'category_tree') {
207:     const nodes = (block.nodes ?? []) as CategoryTreeNode[];
208:     return (
209:       <section className="as-block" aria-label="شجرة الأقسام">
210:         <header className="as-block-head">
211:           <span className="as-block-ic"><Icon name="folder" /></span>
212:           <div className="as-block-title">
213:             <h3>{String(block.title ?? 'شجرة الأقسام')}</h3>
214:             <span>{nodes.length} قسم رئيسي</span>
215:           </div>
216:         </header>
217:         <div className="as-block-body">
218:           {nodes.length ? <CategoryTreeView nodes={nodes} /> : <p className="as-none">لا توجد أقسام</p>}
219:         </div>
220:       </section>
221:     );
222:   }
223: 
224:   /* ---------------- Product card (B.3) ---------------- */
225:   if (block.type === 'product_card') {
226:     const st = String(block.status ?? 'draft');
227:     const readiness = (block.readiness ?? []) as { key: string; ok: boolean; label: string; hint?: string }[];
228:     const variantsList = (block.variants ?? []) as { id: number; sku: string; color_ar?: string; color_hex?: string; size?: string; retail_price?: number; wholesale_price?: number; status?: string }[];
229:     const priceRange = asRecord(block.price_range);
230:     const link = normalizeDeepLink(block.deep_link ?? (block.product_id ? `#/products/${String(block.product_id)}/edit` : undefined));
231:     const thumb = typeof block.thumbnail_url === 'string' && block.thumbnail_url ? block.thumbnail_url : undefined;
232:     return (
233:       <section className="as-block" aria-label="كارت المنتج">
234:         <header className="as-block-head">
235:           {thumb ? (
236:             <img src={thumb} alt={String(block.name_ar ?? '')} style={{ width: 42, height: 42, objectFit: 'cover', borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid var(--as-border)' }} />
237:           ) : (
238:             <span className="as-block-ic"><Icon name="box" /></span>
239:           )}
240:           <div className="as-block-title">
241:             <h3>{String(block.name_ar ?? block.name ?? '')}</h3>
242:             <span>
243:               <code dir="ltr">{String(block.code ?? '')}</code>
244:               {block.category_path ? ` · ${String(block.category_path)}` : ''}
245:             </span>
246:           </div>
247:           <span className={`as-badge as-badge--${statusBadgeTone[st] ?? ''}`}>{customerStatusLabels[st] ?? st}</span>
248:         </header>
249:         <div className="as-block-body">
250:           {priceRange && (
251:             <dl className="as-diff">
252:               <div className="as-diff-row">
253:                 <dt>نطاق القطاعي</dt>
254:                 <dd className="as-num">{priceRange.retail_min != null ? `${money(priceRange.retail_min)} – ${money(priceRange.retail_max)} ج.م` : 'غير محدد'}</dd>
255:               </div>
256:               <div className="as-diff-row">
257:                 <dt>نطاق الجملة</dt>
258:                 <dd className="as-num">{priceRange.wholesale_min != null ? `${money(priceRange.wholesale_min)} – ${money(priceRange.wholesale_max)} ج.م` : 'غير محدد'}</dd>
259:               </div>
260:             </dl>
261:           )}
262:           {variantsList.length > 0 && (
263:             <div className="as-table-wrap" style={{ marginTop: '.5rem' }}>
264:               <table className="as-table">
265:                 <thead>
266:                   <tr><th>SKU</th><th>اللون / المقاس</th><th className="as-num">قطاعي</th><th className="as-num">جملة</th><th>الحالة</th></tr>
267:                 </thead>
268:                 <tbody>
269:                   {variantsList.slice(0, 8).map(v => (
270:                     <tr key={v.id}>
271:                       <td><code dir="ltr">{v.sku}</code></td>
272:                       <td>
273:                         <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '.35rem' }}>
274:                           {v.color_hex && <i style={{ width: 12, height: 12, borderRadius: '50%', background: v.color_hex, display: 'inline-block', border: '1px solid var(--as-border)' }} />}
275:                           {[v.color_ar, v.size].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '—'}
276:                         </span>
277:                       </td>
278:                       <td className="as-num">{v.retail_price != null ? money(v.retail_price) : '—'}</td>
279:                       <td className="as-num">{v.wholesale_price != null ? money(v.wholesale_price) : '—'}</td>
280:                       <td><span className={`as-badge as-badge--${statusBadgeTone[String(v.status ?? '')] ?? ''}`}>{customerStatusLabels[String(v.status ?? '')] ?? v.status}</span></td>
281:                     </tr>
282:                   ))}
283:                 </tbody>
284:               </table>
285:             </div>
286:           )}
287:           {readiness.length > 0 && (
288:             <ul className="as-result-list" style={{ marginTop: '.5rem' }}>
289:               {readiness.map(r => (
290:                 <li key={r.key} data-ok={r.ok}>
291:                   <Icon name={r.ok ? 'check' : 'alert'} size={15} />
292:                   <span>{r.label}{!r.ok && r.hint ? ` — ${r.hint}` : ''}</span>
293:                 </li>
294:               ))}
295:             </ul>
296:           )}
297:         </div>
298:         {link && (
299:           <footer className="as-block-foot">
300:             <a className="as-btn as-btn--sm" href={link} style={{ textDecoration: 'none' }}>
301:               <Icon name="external" size={15} />افتح في المنتجات
302:             </a>
303:           </footer>
304:         )}
305:       </section>
306:     );
307:   }
308: 
309:   /* ---------------- Media gallery (B.6) ---------------- */
310:   if (block.type === 'media_gallery') {
311:     const galleryItems = (block.items ?? []) as { id: number; thumb_url?: string; url?: string; order?: number; sort_order?: number; variant_label?: string | null; is_cover?: boolean }[];
312:     return (
313:       <section className="as-block" aria-label="صور المنتج">
314:         <header className="as-block-head">
315:           <span className="as-block-ic"><Icon name="image" /></span>
316:           <div className="as-block-title">
317:             <h3>{String(block.title ?? 'معرض صور المنتج')}</h3>
318:             <span>{galleryItems.length} صورة</span>
319:           </div>
320:         </header>
321:         <div className="as-block-body">
322:           {galleryItems.length ? (
323:             <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(110px, 1fr))', gap: '.65rem' }}>
324:               {galleryItems.map((img, idx) => {
325:                 const isCover = img.is_cover ?? idx === 0;
326:                 const src = img.thumb_url ?? img.url ?? '';
327:                 return (
328:                   <div key={img.id} style={{ border: isCover ? '2px solid var(--as-accent, #3b82f6)' : '1px solid var(--as-border)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '.35rem', display: 'grid', gap: '.3rem', position: 'relative' }}>
329:                     {src ? (
330:                       <img src={src} alt={`صورة #${img.id}`} style={{ width: '100%', height: 84, objectFit: 'cover', borderRadius: 6 }} />
331:                     ) : (
332:                       <div style={{ height: 84, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', background: 'var(--as-surface-2)', borderRadius: 6 }}><Icon name="image" size={22} /></div>
333:                     )}
334:                     <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: '.75rem' }}>
335:                       <code dir="ltr">#{img.id}</code>
336:                       {isCover ? <span className="as-badge as-badge--success">غلاف</span> : <span className="as-num">ترتيب {(img.order ?? img.sort_order ?? idx) + 1}</span>}
337:                     </div>
338:                     {img.variant_label && <span style={{ fontSize: '.72rem', color: 'var(--as-muted)' }}>{img.variant_label}</span>}
339:                   </div>
340:                 );
341:               })}
342:             </div>
343:           ) : (
344:             <p className="as-none">لا توجد صور مرفوعة لهذا المنتج.</p>
345:           )}
346:         </div>
347:       </section>
348:     );
349:   }
350: 
351:   /* ---------------- Checklist (فحص طلب تاجر / جاهزية منتج) ---------------- */
352:   if (block.type === 'checklist') {
353:     const rawChecks = (block.checks ?? []) as { key: string; ok: boolean; severity?: string; message?: string; label?: string; hint?: string }[];
354:     const checks = rawChecks
355:       .map((c, i) => ({
356:         key: c.key,
357:         ok: c.ok,
358:         severity: c.severity ?? (c.ok ? 'info' : 'blocker'),
359:         message: c.message ?? (c.hint && !c.ok ? `${c.label ?? c.key} — ${c.hint}` : (c.label ?? c.key)),
360:         i,
361:       }))
362:       .sort((a, b) => (Number(a.ok) - Number(b.ok)) || ((severityRank[a.severity] ?? 3) - (severityRank[b.severity] ?? 3)) || a.i - b.i);
363:     const verdict = String(block.verdict ?? (checks.every(c => c.ok) ? 'ready' : 'blocked'));
364:     const meta = verdictMeta[verdict] ?? verdictMeta.blocked;
365:     const suggestion = asRecord(block.suggestion);
366:     const nextActions = (block.next_actions ?? []) as { label: string; prompt: string }[];
367:     const title = String(block.title ?? 'فحص طلب التاجر');
368:     return (
369:       <section className="as-block" aria-label={title} data-verdict={verdict}>
370:         <header className="as-block-head">
371:           <span className="as-block-ic"><Icon name={verdict === 'ready' ? 'check' : verdict === 'blocked' ? 'alert' : 'shield'} /></span>
372:           <div className="as-block-title"><h3>{title}</h3><span>{checks.filter(c => !c.ok).length} ملاحظة من {checks.length} فحص</span></div>
373:           <span className={`as-badge as-badge--${meta.tone}`}>{meta.label}</span>
374:         </header>
375:         <div className="as-block-body">
376:           <ul className="as-result-list">
377:             {checks.map(c => (
378:               <li key={c.key} data-ok={c.ok}>
379:                 <Icon name={c.ok ? 'check' : c.severity === 'blocker' ? 'x' : 'alert'} size={15} />
380:                 <span>{c.message} {!c.ok && <span className={`as-badge as-badge--${c.severity === 'blocker' ? 'danger' : c.severity === 'warning' ? 'warning' : 'info'}`}>{severityLabel[c.severity] ?? c.severity}</span>}</span>
381:               </li>
382:             ))}
383:           </ul>
384:           {suggestion && typeof suggestion.source === 'string' && <div className="as-alert as-alert--info" role="note"><Icon name="info" size={16} /><div className="as-alert-body"><span>{suggestion.source}</span></div></div>}
385:         </div>
386:         {onPrompt && (nextActions.length > 0 || (verdict === 'ready' && block.customer_id != null)) && (
387:           <footer className="as-block-foot" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '.4rem' }}>
388:             {verdict === 'ready' && block.customer_id != null && (
389:               <button type="button" className="as-btn as-btn--primary" disabled={busy || !execute} onClick={() => onPrompt(`جهّز اعتماد التاجر رقم ${String(block.customer_id)}`)}><Icon name="check" size={16} />جهّز الاعتماد</button>
390:             )}
391:             {nextActions.map((act, idx) => (
392:               <button key={idx} type="button" className="as-btn as-btn--sm" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onPrompt(act.prompt)}>
393:                 {act.label}
394:               </button>
395:             ))}
396:           </footer>
397:         )}
398:       </section>
399:     );
400:   }
401: 
402:   /* ---------------- Customer card ---------------- */
403:   if (block.type === 'customer_card') {
404:     const limit = Number(block.credit_limit ?? 0);
405:     const used = Number(block.used_credit ?? 0);
406:     const pct = limit > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((used / limit) * 100)) : 0;
407:     const high = limit > 0 && used / limit > 0.9;
408:     const docs = asRecord(block.documents_counts) ?? {};
409:     const st = String(block.status ?? '');
410:     const link = typeof block.deep_link === 'string' && /^\/(dealers|pricing)(\?|$)/.test(block.deep_link) ? block.deep_link : undefined;
411:     return (
412:       <section className="as-block" aria-label="كارت العميل">
413:         <header className="as-block-head">
414:           <span className="as-block-ic"><Icon name="store" /></span>
415:           <div className="as-block-title"><h3>{String(block.name ?? '')}</h3><span>{String(block.company_name ?? 'بدون شركة')} · {customerTypeLabels[String(block.customer_type ?? block.type)] ?? String(block.customer_type ?? block.type ?? '')}</span></div>
416:           <span className={`as-badge as-badge--${statusBadgeTone[st] ?? ''}`}>{customerStatusLabels[st] ?? st}</span>
417:         </header>
418:         <div className="as-block-body">
419:           <dl className="as-diff"><div className="as-diff-row"><dt>المجموعة</dt><dd>{String(block.group ?? 'بدون')}</dd></div><div className="as-diff-row"><dt>المستندات</dt><dd>{String(docs.total ?? 0)} (موثّق {String(docs.verified ?? 0)} · معلّق {String(docs.pending ?? 0)} · مرفوض {String(docs.rejected ?? 0)})</dd></div></dl>
420:           <div role="group" aria-label="استخدام حد الائتمان">
421:             <div className="as-num" style={{ fontSize: '.82rem', marginBottom: '.25rem' }}>الائتمان: {money(used)} من {money(limit)} {limit > 0 ? `(${pct}%)` : ''}</div>
422:             <div className="as-progress" role="progressbar" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={pct}><span style={{ width: `${pct}%`, background: high ? 'var(--as-danger)' : undefined }} /></div>
423:             {high && <span className="as-badge as-badge--danger" style={{ marginTop: '.3rem' }}><Icon name="alert" size={12} />فوق 90% من الحد</span>}
424:           </div>
425:         </div>
426:         {link && <footer className="as-block-foot"><a className="as-btn as-btn--sm" href={`#${link}`} style={{ textDecoration: 'none' }}><Icon name="external" size={15} />افتح في شاشة التجار</a></footer>}
427:       </section>
428:     );
429:   }
430: 
431:   /* ---------------- Welcome card (ملخص طابور التجار والكتالوج — بدون Gemini) ---------------- */
432:   if (block.type === 'welcome_card') {
433:     const rows = (block.rows ?? []) as { label: string; value: number }[];
434:     const quickActions = (block.quick_actions ?? []) as { label: string; prompt: string }[];
435:     return (
436:       <section className="as-block" aria-label="ملخص اليوم">
437:         <header className="as-block-head">
438:           <span className="as-block-ic"><Icon name="store" /></span>
439:           <div className="as-block-title"><h3>{String(block.title ?? 'ملخص طابور التجار')}</h3><span>جاهز من غير أي تكلفة توكنز</span></div>
440:         </header>
441:         <div className="as-block-body">
442:           <dl className="as-diff">{rows.map(r => <div className="as-diff-row" key={r.label}><dt>{r.label}</dt><dd className="as-num">{r.value}</dd></div>)}</dl>
443:         </div>
444:         {onPrompt && (
445:           <footer className="as-block-foot" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '.4rem' }}>
446:             {quickActions.length > 0 ? (
447:               quickActions.map((qa, i) => (
448:                 <button key={i} type="button" className="as-btn as-btn--sm" onClick={() => onPrompt(qa.prompt)}>{qa.label}</button>
449:               ))
450:             ) : (
451:               <>
452:                 <button type="button" className="as-btn as-btn--sm" onClick={() => onPrompt('طلبات التجار المتأخرة')}>المتأخرين</button>
453:                 <button type="button" className="as-btn as-btn--sm" onClick={() => onPrompt('مين جاهز للاعتماد؟')}>الجاهزين للاعتماد</button>
454:               </>
455:             )}
456:           </footer>
457:         )}
458:       </section>
459:     );
460:   }
461: 
462:   /* ---------------- Entity picker ---------------- */
463:   if (block.type === 'entity_picker') {
464:     const entity = String(block.entity ?? '');
465:     const q = query.trim();
466:     const visible = options.filter(o => `${o.label} ${o.meta ?? ''}`.includes(q));
467:     return (
468:       <section className="as-block" aria-label="اختيار كيان">
469:         <header className="as-block-head">
470:           <span className="as-block-ic"><Icon name={entityIcon[entity] ?? 'layers'} /></span>
471:           <div className="as-block-title">
472:             <h3>{String(block.purpose ?? 'اختار من القائمة')}</h3>
473:             <span>{options.length} {entityLabel[entity] ? `${entityLabel[entity]} متاح` : 'اختيار متاح'} · اختار واحد للمتابعة</span>
474:           </div>
475:         </header>
476:         <div className="as-block-body">
477:           {options.length > 5 && (
478:             <div className="as-searchfield">
479:               <Icon name="search" size={16} />
480:               <input className="as-input" type="search" aria-label="بحث في الاختيارات" placeholder="بحث في القائمة…" value={query} onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)} />
481:             </div>
482:           )}
483:           {visible.length > 0 ? (
484:             <ul className="as-picker-list">
485:               {visible.map(o => (
486:                 <li key={o.id}>
487:                   <button type="button" className="as-picker-opt" disabled={busy || !!o.disabled} title={o.disabled} onClick={() => onPick(entity, o.id, o.label)}>
488:                     <span className="as-opt-ic"><Icon name={o.disabled ? 'lock' : entityIcon[entity] ?? 'layers'} size={16} /></span>
489:                     <span className="as-opt-txt">
490:                       <span className="as-opt-label">{o.label}</span>
491:                       {(o.disabled ?? o.meta) && <span className="as-opt-meta">{o.disabled ?? o.meta}</span>}
492:                     </span>
493:                     {!o.disabled && <Icon name="chevronStart" size={16} className="as-chev" />}
494:                   </button>
495:                 </li>
496:               ))}
497:             </ul>
498:           ) : (
499:             <div className="as-pop-empty">
500:               <Icon name="search" size={22} />
501:               <strong>مفيش نتائج مطابقة</strong>
502:               <span>جرّب كلمة تانية{q ? ` غير «${q}»` : ''}.</span>
503:               {q && <button type="button" className="as-btn as-btn--sm" onClick={() => setQuery('')}>مسح البحث</button>}
504:             </div>
505:           )}
506:         </div>
507:       </section>
508:     );
509:   }
510: 
511:   /* ---------------- Confirm / permission diff / bulk / catalog confirm blocks ---------------- */
512:   if (
513:     block.type === 'confirm_action' ||
514:     block.type === 'permission_diff' ||
515:     block.type === 'bulk_plan' ||
516:     block.type === 'category_tree_diff' ||
517:     block.type === 'variant_matrix' ||
518:     block.type === 'price_diff'
519:   ) {
520:     const expires = Date.parse(String(block.expires_at));
521:     const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((expires - now) / 1000));
522:     if (ttlTotal.current === null && seconds > 0) ttlTotal.current = seconds;
523:     const expired = !Number.isFinite(expires) || seconds === 0;
524:     const pending = !status || status === 'pending';
525:     const required = typeof block.typed_confirmation === 'string' ? block.typed_confirmation : '';
526:     const displayRequired = typeof block.typed_confirmation_hint === 'string' && block.typed_confirmation_hint ? block.typed_confirmation_hint : required;
527:     const disabled = busy || !execute || !pending || expired;
528:     const warnings = (block.warnings ?? []) as string[];
529:     const addList = (block.add ?? []) as string[];
530:     const removeList = (block.remove ?? []) as string[];
531:     const sensitive = !!required || warnings.length > 0 || addList.some(isSensitive);
532:     const state = !pending ? status! : expired ? 'expired' : 'pending';
533:     const level = seconds <= 15 ? 'crit' : seconds <= 60 ? 'warn' : 'ok';
534:     const typedOk = !required || typed === required;
535:     const icon = block.type === 'permission_diff' ? 'key' : block.type === 'bulk_plan' ? 'layers' : block.type === 'category_tree_diff' ? 'folder' : block.type === 'variant_matrix' || block.type === 'price_diff' ? 'tag' : 'shield';
536:     const kindLabel = block.type === 'permission_diff' ? 'تعديل صلاحيات' : block.type === 'bulk_plan' ? 'عملية جماعية' : block.type === 'category_tree_diff' ? 'تعديل شجرة الأقسام' : block.type === 'variant_matrix' ? 'مصفوفة التشكيلات' : block.type === 'price_diff' ? 'تعديل أسعار جماعي' : 'تعديل يحتاج تأكيد';
537:     const allOn = selected.length === items.length;
538:     const afterRec = asRecord(block.after);
539:     const docsToVerify = (Array.isArray(afterRec?.documents_to_verify) ? afterRec!.documents_to_verify : []) as { id: number; name?: string; download_url?: string }[];
540:     const afterSuggestion = asRecord(afterRec?.suggestion);
541: 
542:     return (
543:       <section className="as-block" aria-label="مراجعة وتأكيد العملية" data-state={state} data-sensitive={pending && !expired && sensitive}>
544:         <header className="as-block-head">
545:           <span className="as-block-ic"><Icon name={state === 'executed' ? 'check' : state === 'expired' ? 'clock' : icon} /></span>
546:           <div className="as-block-title">
547:             <h3>{String(block.title ?? 'تأكيد العملية')}</h3>
548:             <span>{kindLabel}{sensitive && pending && !expired ? ' · عملية حساسة' : ''}</span>
549:           </div>
550:           {!pending && <span className={`as-badge as-badge--${statusTone[status!] ?? ''}`}>{statusLabels[status!] ?? status}</span>}
551:           {pending && expired && <span className="as-badge as-badge--warning">انتهت المهلة</span>}
552:         </header>
553: 
554:         <div className="as-block-body">
555:           {block.type === 'permission_diff' && (
556:             <>
557:               <div className="as-perm-grid">
558:                 {(['add', 'remove'] as const).map(key => {
559:                   const list = key === 'add' ? addList : removeList;
560:                   return (
561:                     <div className="as-perm-col" data-kind={key} key={key}>
562:                       <h4><Icon name={key === 'add' ? 'plus' : 'minus'} size={14} />{key === 'add' ? 'إضافة' : 'إزالة'} <span className="as-num">({list.length})</span></h4>
563:                       {list.length ? (
564:                         <ul>
565:                           {list.map(p => (
566:                             <li key={p}>
567:                               <div>{permLabel(p)} {isSensitive(p) && <span className="as-badge as-badge--warning"><Icon name="alert" size={12} />حساسة</span>}</div>
568:                               <code>{p}</code>
569:                             </li>
570:                           ))}
571:                         </ul>
572:                       ) : <p className="as-none">لا يوجد</p>}
573:                     </div>
574:                   );
575:                 })}
576:               </div>
577:               <span className="as-affected"><Icon name="user" size={15} />الموظفين المتأثرين: <b className="as-num">{String(block.affected_users ?? 0)}</b></span>
578:             </>
579:           )}
580: 
581:           {block.type === 'category_tree_diff' && (
582:             <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr))', gap: '.75rem' }}>
583:               <div style={{ border: '1px solid var(--as-border)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '.6rem' }}>
584:                 <strong style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: '.4rem', fontSize: '.82rem', color: 'var(--as-muted)' }}>قبل التعديل</strong>
585:                 {Array.isArray(block.before) ? (
586:                   <CategoryTreeView nodes={block.before as CategoryTreeNode[]} movedId={block.moved_id ? Number(block.moved_id) : undefined} />
587:                 ) : (
588:                   <DiffTable before={block.before} after={null} />
589:                 )}
590:               </div>
591:               <div style={{ border: '1px solid var(--as-border)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '.6rem' }}>
592:                 <strong style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: '.4rem', fontSize: '.82rem', color: 'var(--as-muted)' }}>بعد التعديل</strong>
593:                 {Array.isArray(block.after) ? (
594:                   <CategoryTreeView nodes={block.after as CategoryTreeNode[]} movedId={block.moved_id ? Number(block.moved_id) : undefined} />
595:                 ) : (
596:                   <DiffTable before={null} after={block.after} />
597:                 )}
598:               </div>
599:             </div>
600:           )}
601: 
602:           {block.type === 'variant_matrix' && (() => {
603:             const matrixRows = (block.rows ?? []) as { sku?: string; color?: string; color_ar?: string; color_hex?: string; size?: string; capacity?: string; retail?: number; retail_price?: number; wholesale?: number; wholesale_price?: number; status?: string; state?: string }[];
604:             return (
605:               <div className="as-table-wrap">
606:                 <table className="as-table">
607:                   <thead>
608:                     <tr><th>اللون</th><th>المقاس / السعة</th><th className="as-num">قطاعي</th><th className="as-num">جملة</th><th>الحالة</th></tr>
609:                   </thead>
610:                   <tbody>
611:                     {matrixRows.map((r, i) => {
612:                       const rowState = r.state ?? r.status ?? 'new';
613:                       const isSkipped = rowState === 'skipped' || rowState === 'duplicate';
614:                       return (
615:                         <tr key={i} style={{ opacity: isSkipped ? 0.55 : 1 }}>
616:                           <td>
617:                             <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '.4rem' }}>
618:                               {r.color_hex && <i style={{ width: 13, height: 13, borderRadius: '50%', background: r.color_hex, display: 'inline-block', border: '1px solid var(--as-border)' }} />}
619:                               <span>{r.color ?? r.color_ar ?? '—'}</span>
620:                             </span>
621:                           </td>
622:                           <td>{[r.size, r.capacity].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '—'}</td>
623:                           <td className="as-num">{money(r.retail ?? r.retail_price ?? 0)}</td>
624:                           <td className="as-num">{money(r.wholesale ?? r.wholesale_price ?? 0)}</td>
625:                           <td>
626:                             <span className={`as-badge as-badge--${isSkipped ? 'warning' : 'success'}`}>
627:                               {isSkipped ? 'موجود (هيتم تخطيه)' : 'جديد'}
628:                             </span>
629:                           </td>
630:                         </tr>
631:                       );
632:                     })}
633:                   </tbody>
634:                 </table>
635:               </div>
636:             );
637:           })()}
638: 
639:           {block.type === 'price_diff' && (() => {
640:             const summary = asRecord(block.summary);
641:             const allRows = (block.rows ?? []) as { variant_id?: number; sku: string; label?: string; product_name?: string; before_retail?: number; after_retail?: number; before_wholesale?: number; after_wholesale?: number }[];
642:             const topRows = (block.top ?? allRows.slice(0, 10)) as typeof allRows;
643:             const blockedRows = (block.blocked ?? []) as { sku: string; reason: string }[];
644:             const displayRows = showAllPrices ? allRows : topRows;
645:             return (
646:               <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: '.65rem' }}>
647:                 {summary && (
648:                   <dl className="as-diff">
649:                     {summary.count != null && <div className="as-diff-row"><dt>عدد التشكيلات المتأثرة</dt><dd className="as-num">{String(summary.count)}</dd></div>}
650:                     {summary.field != null && <div className="as-diff-row"><dt>الحقل</dt><dd>{fieldLabels[String(summary.field)] ?? String(summary.field)}</dd></div>}
651:                     {summary.min_delta != null && <div className="as-diff-row"><dt>أقل فرق</dt><dd className="as-num">{money(summary.min_delta)} ج.م</dd></div>}
652:                     {summary.max_delta != null && <div className="as-diff-row"><dt>أكبر فرق</dt><dd className="as-num">{money(summary.max_delta)} ج.م</dd></div>}
653:                   </dl>
654:                 )}
655:                 {displayRows.length > 0 && (
656:                   <div className="as-table-wrap">
657:                     <table className="as-table">
658:                       <thead>
659:                         <tr><th>SKU</th><th>التشكيلة</th><th className="as-num">قطاعي (قبل → بعد)</th><th className="as-num">جملة (قبل → بعد)</th></tr>
660:                       </thead>
661:                       <tbody>
662:                         {displayRows.map((r, i) => (
663:                           <tr key={r.variant_id ?? i}>
664:                             <td><code dir="ltr">{r.sku}</code></td>
665:                             <td>{r.label ?? r.product_name ?? '—'}</td>
666:                             <td className="as-num">{r.before_retail != null ? `${money(r.before_retail)} ← ${money(r.after_retail)}` : '—'}</td>
667:                             <td className="as-num">{r.before_wholesale != null ? `${money(r.before_wholesale)} ← ${money(r.after_wholesale)}` : '—'}</td>
668:                           </tr>
669:                         ))}
670:                       </tbody>
671:                     </table>
672:                   </div>
673:                 )}
674:                 {allRows.length > topRows.length && (
675:                   <button type="button" className="as-btn as-btn--sm" onClick={() => setShowAllPrices(s => !s)}>
676:                     {showAllPrices ? 'إخفاء باقي الصفوف' : `اعرض كل الصفوف (${allRows.length})`}
677:                   </button>
678:                 )}
679:                 {blockedRows.length > 0 && (
680:                   <div className="as-alert as-alert--danger" role="alert">
681:                     <Icon name="alert" size={16} />
682:                     <div className="as-alert-body">
683:                       <strong>صفوف مرفوضة ({blockedRows.length})</strong>
684:                       <span>{blockedRows.map(b => `${b.sku}: ${b.reason}`).join(' · ')}</span>
685:                     </div>
686:                   </div>
687:                 )}
688:               </div>
689:             );
690:           })()}
691: 
692:           {block.type === 'bulk_plan' && (
693:             <fieldset disabled={disabled}>
694:               <legend className="as-sr">العناصر المشمولة بالعملية</legend>
695:               <div className="as-bulk-bar" style={{ marginBottom: '.6rem' }}>
696:                 <label style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '.45rem', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
697:                   <input type="checkbox" className="as-check" checked={allOn} ref={el => { if (el) el.indeterminate = selected.length > 0 && !allOn; }} onChange={() => setSelected(allOn ? [] : items.map(i => i.key))} />
698:                   تحديد الكل
699:                 </label>
700:                 <span className="as-progress" aria-hidden="true"><span style={{ width: `${items.length ? (selected.length / items.length) * 100 : 0}%` }} /></span>
701:                 <span className="as-num">{selected.length} من {items.length} مختار</span>
702:               </div>
703:               <div className="as-bulk-list">
704:                 {items.map(item => {
705:                   const on = selected.includes(item.key);
706:                   return (
707:                     <div className="as-bulk-item" key={item.key} data-on={on}>
708:                       <label className="as-bulk-item-head">
709:                         <input type="checkbox" className="as-check" checked={on} onChange={e => setSelected(ids => (e.target.checked ? [...ids, item.key] : ids.filter(id => id !== item.key)))} />
710:                         <span>{item.label}{item.change && <small style={{ display: 'block', color: 'var(--as-muted)', fontWeight: 400, fontSize: '.76rem' }}>{item.change}</small>}</span>
711:                         <button type="button" className="as-iconbtn" aria-expanded={!!open[item.key]} aria-label={`عرض تفاصيل ${item.label}`} onClick={e => { e.preventDefault(); setOpen(o => ({ ...o, [item.key]: !o[item.key] })); }}>
712:                           <Icon name="chevron" size={16} />
713:                         </button>
714:                       </label>
715:                       {open[item.key] && <DiffTable before={item.before} after={item.after} />}
716:                     </div>
717:                   );
718:                 })}
719:               </div>
720:             </fieldset>
721:           )}
722: 
723:           {block.type === 'confirm_action' && Boolean(block.before || block.after) && <DiffTable before={stripSections(block.before)} after={stripSections(block.after)} />}
724: 
725:           {block.type === 'confirm_action' && docsToVerify.length > 0 && (
726:             <div className="as-diff" aria-label="المستندات اللي هتتوثق">
727:               <div className="as-diff-head"><span>المستندات اللي هتتوثق</span><span /></div>
728:               <dl>
729:                 {docsToVerify.map(d => (
730:                   <div className="as-diff-row" key={d.id}>
731:                     <dt>{d.name || `مستند #${d.id}`}</dt>
732:                     <dd>{d.download_url && <button type="button" className="as-btn as-btn--sm" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { setDlError(''); downloadDocument(d.download_url!, d.name || `document-${d.id}`).catch(() => setDlError('تعذّر تنزيل المستند.')); }}><Icon name="arrowDown" size={14} />تنزيل</button>}</dd>
733:                   </div>
734:                 ))}
735:               </dl>
736:               {dlError && <div className="as-alert as-alert--danger" role="alert"><Icon name="alert" size={16} /><div className="as-alert-body"><span>{dlError}</span></div></div>}
737:             </div>
738:           )}
739:           {block.type === 'confirm_action' && typeof afterSuggestion?.source === 'string' && (
740:             <div className="as-alert as-alert--info" role="note"><Icon name="info" size={16} /><div className="as-alert-body"><span>{afterSuggestion.source}</span></div></div>
741:           )}
742: 
743:           {warnings.map((w, i) => (
744:             <div className="as-alert as-alert--warning" role="note" key={i}>
745:               <Icon name="alert" size={16} />
746:               <div className="as-alert-body"><strong>تنبيه أمني</strong><span>{w}</span></div>
747:             </div>
748:           ))}
749: 
750:           {pending && !expired && required && (
751:             <div className="as-typed">
752:               <label htmlFor={`typed-${String(block.action_id)}`}><Icon name="lock" size={15} />للتأكيد اكتب <b dir="ltr">{displayRequired}</b> في الخانة</label>
753:               <div className="as-typed-field" data-match={typed === required}>
754:                 <input id={`typed-${String(block.action_id)}`} className="as-input" value={typed} onChange={e => setTyped(e.target.value)} disabled={disabled} dir="ltr" autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false} placeholder={displayRequired} onPaste={e => e.preventDefault()} />
755:                 {typed === required && <Icon name="check" size={16} />}
756:               </div>
757:             </div>
758:           )}
759: 
760:           {pending && expired && (
761:             <div className="as-alert as-alert--info" role="status">
762:               <Icon name="refresh" size={16} />
763:               <div className="as-alert-body"><strong>انتهت صلاحية التأكيد</strong><span>لحماية بياناتك، الاقتراح ده مبقاش قابل للتنفيذ. اطلب من المساعد اقتراح جديد.</span></div>
764:             </div>
765:           )}
766:           {pending && !expired && !execute && (
767:             <div className="as-alert as-alert--info" role="note">
768:               <Icon name="lock" size={16} />
769:               <div className="as-alert-body"><span>معندكش صلاحية تنفيذ عمليات المساعد — تقدر تراجع التفاصيل بس.</span></div>
770:             </div>
771:           )}
772:         </div>
773: 
774:         {pending && !expired && (
775:           <footer className="as-block-foot">
776:             <button
777:               type="button"
778:               className="as-btn as-btn--primary"
779:               disabled={disabled || !typedOk || (block.type === 'bulk_plan' && !selected.length)}
780:               onClick={() => onAction('confirm', String(block.action_id), required ? typed : undefined, block.type === 'bulk_plan' ? selected : undefined)}
781:             >
782:               <Icon name="check" size={16} />
783:               {block.type === 'bulk_plan' ? `تنفيذ على ${selected.length}` : 'تأكيد التنفيذ'}
784:             </button>
785:             <button type="button" className="as-btn" disabled={busy || !pending || expired} onClick={() => onAction('cancel', String(block.action_id))}>إلغاء</button>
786:             <span className="as-spacer" />
787:             <span className="as-timer as-num" data-level={level} role="timer" aria-label={`متبقي ${fmtClock(seconds)} على انتهاء المهلة`}>
788:               <Ring fraction={ttlTotal.current ? seconds / ttlTotal.current : 1} size={18} />
789:               متبقي {fmtClock(seconds)}
790:             </span>
791:           </footer>
792:         )}
793:         <span className="as-sr" role="status">{!pending ? statusLabels[status!] ?? status : expired ? 'انتهت صلاحية التأكيد؛ اطلب اقتراح جديد.' : ''}</span>
794:       </section>
795:     );
796:   }
797: 
798:   /* ---------------- Result ---------------- */
799:   if (block.type === 'result') {
800:     const link = normalizeDeepLink(block.deep_link);
801:     const undo = typeof block.undo_action_id === 'string' ? block.undo_action_id : undefined;
802:     const undoUntil = Date.parse(String(block.undo_available_until));
803:     const undoSec = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((undoUntil - now) / 1000));
804:     if (undoTotal.current === null && undoSec > 0) undoTotal.current = undoSec;
805:     const undone = status === 'undone';
806:     const undoLive = undo && !undone && undoUntil > now;
807:     const ok = !!block.ok;
808:     const okCount = items.filter(i => i.ok).length;
809:     return (
810:       <section className="as-block" role="status" data-state={undone ? 'undone' : ok ? 'executed' : 'failed'}>
811:         <header className="as-block-head">
812:           <span className="as-block-ic"><Icon name={undone ? 'undo' : ok ? 'check' : 'alert'} /></span>
813:           <div className="as-block-title">
814:             <h3>{undone ? 'تم التراجع عن العملية' : ok ? 'تم التنفيذ بنجاح' : 'تعذر التنفيذ'}</h3>
815:             <span>{String(block.message ?? '')}</span>
816:           </div>
817:           {items.length > 0 && <span className={`as-badge as-badge--${okCount === items.length ? 'success' : okCount ? 'warning' : 'danger'}`}><span className="as-num">{okCount}/{items.length}</span> نجح</span>}
818:         </header>
819:         {items.length > 0 && (
820:           <div className="as-block-body">
821:             <ul className="as-result-list">
822:               {items.map((item, index) => (
823:                 <li key={index} data-ok={!!item.ok}><Icon name={item.ok ? 'check' : 'x'} size={15} /><span>{item.message}</span></li>
824:               ))}
825:             </ul>
826:           </div>
827:         )}
828:         {(link || (undoLive && execute)) && (
829:           <>
830:             {undoLive && execute && <div className="as-undo-bar" aria-hidden="true"><span style={{ width: `${undoTotal.current ? (undoSec / undoTotal.current) * 100 : 100}%` }} /></div>}
831:             <footer className="as-block-foot">
832:               {link && <a className="as-btn as-btn--sm" href={link} style={{ textDecoration: 'none' }}><Icon name="external" size={15} />افتح في الشاشة</a>}
833:               <span className="as-spacer" />
834:               {undoLive && execute && (
835:                 <span className="as-undo">
836:                   <span className="as-num" style={{ fontSize: '.78rem', color: 'var(--as-muted)' }}>متاح {fmtClock(undoSec)}</span>
837:                   <button type="button" className="as-btn as-btn--sm" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onAction('undo', undo!)}><Icon name="undo" size={15} />تراجع</button>
838:                 </span>
839:               )}
840:             </footer>
841:           </>
842:         )}
843:       </section>
844:     );
845:   }
846: 
847:   /* ---------------- Table ---------------- */
848:   if (block.type === 'table') {
849:     const columns = (block.columns ?? []) as string[];
850:     const rows = (block.rows ?? []) as (string | number | null)[][];
851:     return (
852:       <div className="as-table-wrap">
853:         <table className="as-table">
854:           <thead><tr>{columns.map((c, i) => <th key={i} scope="col">{c}</th>)}</tr></thead>
855:           <tbody>
856:             {rows.map((r, i) => <tr key={i}>{r.map((c, j) => <td key={j} className={typeof c === 'number' ? 'as-num' : undefined}>{c ?? '—'}</td>)}</tr>)}
857:             {!rows.length && <tr><td colSpan={columns.length || 1} style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--as-muted)' }}>لا توجد بيانات</td></tr>}
858:           </tbody>
859:         </table>
860:       </div>
861:     );
862:   }
863:   return null;
864: }

 16: function apiErrorMessage(e: unknown, fallback: string): string {
 17:   const data = (e as { response?: { data?: unknown } }).response?.data;
 18:   if (typeof data === 'string') {
 19:     try {
 20:       const parsed = JSON.parse(data) as { message?: unknown };
 21:       if (typeof parsed.message === 'string' && parsed.message !== '') return parsed.message;
 22:     } catch {
 23:       if (data !== '') return data;
 24:     }
 25:   }
 26:   if (typeof data === 'object' && data !== null && typeof (data as { message?: unknown }).message === 'string') {
 27:     return (data as { message: string }).message;
 28:   }
 29:   return fallback;
 30: }

 32: function apiErrorKind(e: unknown): 'budget' | 'locked' | 'forbidden' | 'transient' {
 33:   const code = (e as { response?: { status?: number } }).response?.status;
 34:   if (code === 429) return 'budget';
 35:   if (code === 423) return 'locked';
 36:   if (code === 403) return 'forbidden';
 37:   return 'transient';
 38: }

 60: const CUSTOMER_COMMANDS = ['/تجار-معلقين', '/راجع-تاجر', '/مجموعات-العملاء'];
 61: const CATALOG_COMMANDS = ['/منتج-جديد', '/جاهزية P00042', '/صحة-الكتالوج', '/أسعار', '/قسم-جديد'];
 62: const QUICK_COMMANDS = ['/ملخص الفروع', '/موظفين بدون دور', '/صلاحيات حساسة', '/آخر التعديلات'];
 63: 
 64: const dayKey = (iso: string | null) => {
 65:   if (!iso) return 'older';
 66:   const d = new Date(iso); const t = new Date();
 67:   const start = (x: Date) => new Date(x.getFullYear(), x.getMonth(), x.getDate()).getTime();
 68:   const diff = Math.round((start(t) - start(d)) / 86400000);
 69:   return diff <= 0 ? 'today' : diff === 1 ? 'yesterday' : diff < 7 ? 'week' : 'older';
 70: };
 71: const groupTitles: Record<string, string> = { pinned: 'المثبّتة', today: 'النهارده', yesterday: 'امبارح', week: 'آخر ٧ أيام', older: 'أقدم' };
 72: const relTime = (iso: string | null) => {
 73:   if (!iso) return '';
 74:   const d = new Date(iso);
 75:   return dayKey(iso) === 'today' ? d.toLocaleTimeString('ar-EG', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' }) : d.toLocaleDateString('ar-EG', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
 76: };

 78: export default function AssistantPage({ can, theme, initialConversationId, initialPrompt }: { can: (permission: string) => boolean; theme?: 'light' | 'dark'; initialConversationId?: number; initialPrompt?: { text: string; mentions?: Mention[] } }) {
 79:   const [resolvedTheme, setResolvedTheme] = useState<'light' | 'dark'>(() => {
 80:     if (theme) return theme;
 81:     if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
 82:       const doc = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
 83:       if (doc === 'dark' || doc === 'light') return doc;
 84:     }
 85:     return 'light';
 86:   });
 87: 
 88:   useEffect(() => {
 89:     if (theme) {
 90:       setResolvedTheme(theme);
 91:       return;
 92:     }
 93:     const update = () => {
 94:       const doc = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
 95:       if (doc === 'dark' || doc === 'light') setResolvedTheme(doc);
 96:     };
 97:     const observer = new MutationObserver(update);
 98:     observer.observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-theme'] });
 99:     return () => observer.disconnect();
100:   }, [theme]);
101: 
102:   const [conversations, setConversations] = useState<Conv[]>([]);
103:   const [listLoading, setListLoading] = useState(true);
104:   const [currentId, setCurrentId] = useState<number | null>(null);
105:   const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ConvMsg[]>([]);
106:   const [actionStatus, setActionStatus] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
107:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
108:   const [streaming, setStreaming] = useState(false);
109:   const [status, setStatus] = useState('جاهز');
110:   const [steps, setSteps] = useState<string[]>([]);
111:   const [startedAt, setStartedAt] = useState(0);
112:   const [pendingText, setPendingText] = useState<{ text: string; mentions: Mention[] } | null>(null);
113:   const [error, setError] = useState<{ message: string; kind: ReturnType<typeof apiErrorKind>; retry?: () => void } | null>(null);
114:   const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
115:   const [debouncedQuery, setDebouncedQuery] = useState('');
116:   const [oncePassword, setOncePassword] = useState('');
117:   const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
118:   const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(false);
119:   const [tab, setTab] = useState<'chat' | 'admin'>('chat');
120:   const [drawer, setDrawer] = useState(false);
121:   const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
122:   const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<number | null>(null);
123:   const [seed, setSeed] = useState<{ text: string; n: number; mentions?: Mention[] }>();
124:   const [welcomeBlock, setWelcomeBlock] = useState<UiBlock | null>(null);
125:   const canCustomers = can('customers.view');
126:   const canCatalog = can('products.view') || can('categories.view');
127:   const starters = [
128:     ...STARTERS,
129:     ...(canCustomers ? CUSTOMER_STARTERS : []),
130:     ...(canCatalog ? CATALOG_STARTERS : []),
131:   ];
132:   const quickCommands = [
133:     ...QUICK_COMMANDS,
134:     ...(canCustomers ? CUSTOMER_COMMANDS : []),
135:     ...(canCatalog ? CATALOG_COMMANDS : []),
136:   ];
137: 
138:   const consumedPrompt = useRef(false);
139:   useEffect(() => {
140:     if (!initialPrompt || consumedPrompt.current) return;
141:     consumedPrompt.current = true;
142:     setSeed({ text: initialPrompt.text, mentions: initialPrompt.mentions, n: Date.now() });
143:     history.replaceState(null, '', '#/assistant');
144:   }, [initialPrompt]);
145:   const [atBottom, setAtBottom] = useState(true);
146:   const [, tick] = useState(0);
147:   const feedRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
148:   const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
149:   const execute = can('ai_agent.execute');
150:   const current = conversations.find(c => c.id === currentId);
151: 
152:   useEffect(() => { const t = setTimeout(() => setDebouncedQuery(searchQuery), 250); return () => clearTimeout(t); }, [searchQuery]);
153: 
154:   const refreshList = useCallback(async () => {
155:     setListLoading(true);
156:     try {
157:       const page = await assistantApi.listPaginated(1, debouncedQuery);
158:       setConversations(page.data);
159:     } catch {
160:       setError({ message: 'تعذر تحميل المحادثات.', kind: 'transient', retry: () => void refreshList() });
161:     } finally {
162:       setListLoading(false);
163:     }
164:   }, [debouncedQuery]);
165: 
166:   useEffect(() => { void refreshList(); }, [refreshList]);

168:   // 5.2 / 5.4: كارت الترحيب — بيتبني في السيرفر بدون Gemini، وبيظهر في المحادثة الجديدة لمن عنده customers.approve أو products.view.
169:   const canWelcome = (can('customers.approve') && can('customers.view')) || can('products.view');
170:   useEffect(() => {
171:     if (!canWelcome || messages.length > 0) return;
172:     let live = true;
173:     assistantApi.welcome().then(block => { if (live) setWelcomeBlock(block); }).catch(() => { if (live) setWelcomeBlock(null); });
174:     return () => { live = false; };
175:   }, [canWelcome, currentId, messages.length]);
176: 
177:   useEffect(() => {
178:     if (!streaming) return;
179:     const t = setInterval(() => tick(n => n + 1), 1000);
180:     return () => clearInterval(t);
181:   }, [streaming]);
182: 
183:   const scrollToBottom = useCallback(() => {
184:     const el = feedRef.current; if (!el) return;
185:     requestAnimationFrame(() => { el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; });
186:   }, []);
187:   useEffect(() => { if (atBottom) scrollToBottom(); }, [messages, steps, pendingText, streaming, atBottom, scrollToBottom]);
188: 
189:   useEffect(() => {
190:     const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
191:       const mod = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey;
192:       if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') { e.preventDefault(); setTab('chat'); setCollapsed(false); setDrawer(true); setTimeout(() => searchRef.current?.focus(), 50); }
193:       if (mod && e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'o') { e.preventDefault(); void createConversation(); }
194:       if (e.key === 'Escape') setDrawer(false);
195:     };
196:     window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
197:     return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
198:   });

200:   const openConversation = useCallback(async (id: number) => {
201:     setBusy(true);
202:     setError(null);
203:     setDrawer(false);
204:     setTab('chat');
205:     try {
206:       const conv = await assistantApi.show(id);
207:       setCurrentId(conv.id);
208:       setMessages(conv.messages ?? []);
209:       const pending: Record<string, string> = {};
210:       for (const action of conv.pending_actions ?? []) pending[String(action.id)] = action.status;
211:       setActionStatus(pending);
212:       setConversations(prev => prev.map(c => (c.id === conv.id ? { ...c, ...conv, messages: undefined } : c)));
213:       setAtBottom(true);
214:     } catch {
215:       setError({ message: 'تعذر فتح المحادثة.', kind: 'transient', retry: () => void openConversation(id) });
216:     } finally {
217:       setBusy(false);
218:     }
219:   }, []);
220: 
221:   useEffect(() => { if (initialConversationId) void openConversation(initialConversationId); }, [initialConversationId, openConversation]);
222: 
223:   const createConversation = useCallback(async () => {
224:     if (currentId && messages.length === 0) { setDrawer(false); setTab('chat'); return; }
225:     setBusy(true);
226:     setError(null);
227:     try {
228:       const conv = await assistantApi.create();
229:       setConversations(prev => [conv, ...prev]);
230:       setCurrentId(conv.id);
231:       setMessages([]);
232:       setActionStatus({});
233:       setDrawer(false);
234:       setTab('chat');
235:     } catch {
236:       setError({ message: 'تعذر إنشاء محادثة.', kind: 'transient', retry: () => void createConversation() });
237:     } finally {
238:       setBusy(false);
239:     }
240:   }, [currentId, messages.length]);
241: 
242:   const deleteConversation = useCallback(async (id: number) => {
243:     setConfirmDelete(null);
244:     try {
245:       await assistantApi.remove(id);
246:       setConversations(prev => prev.filter(c => c.id !== id));
247:       if (currentId === id) { setCurrentId(null); setMessages([]); }
248:     } catch {
249:       setError({ message: 'تعذر حذف المحادثة.', kind: 'transient' });
250:     }
251:   }, [currentId]);

253:   const togglePin = useCallback(async (c: Conv) => {
254:     setConversations(prev => prev.map(x => (x.id === c.id ? { ...x, is_pinned: !c.is_pinned } : x)));
255:     try { await assistantApi.pin(c.id, !c.is_pinned); }
256:     catch {
257:       setConversations(prev => prev.map(x => (x.id === c.id ? { ...x, is_pinned: c.is_pinned } : x)));
258:       setError({ message: 'تعذر تثبيت المحادثة.', kind: 'transient' });
259:     }

262:   const send = useCallback(
263:     async (text: string, _selection?: undefined, mentions?: Mention[], files?: File[]): Promise<boolean> => {
264:       let id = currentId;
265:       if (!id) {
266:         try {
267:           const conv = await assistantApi.create();
268:           id = conv.id;
269:           setConversations(prev => [conv, ...prev]);
270:           setCurrentId(id);
271:         } catch {
272:           setError({ message: 'تعذر إنشاء محادثة.', kind: 'transient' });
273:           return false;
274:         }
275:       }
276:       setBusy(true);
277:       setStreaming(true);
278:       setStatus(files?.length ? 'برفع الصور…' : 'ببعت الطلب…');
279:       setSteps([]);
280:       setStartedAt(Date.now());
281:       setPendingText({ text, mentions: mentions ?? [] });
282:       setError(null);
283:       setAtBottom(true);
284:       try {
285:         let attachmentIds: string[] | undefined;
286:         if (files && files.length > 0) {
287:           const uploaded = await assistantApi.uploadAttachments(id, files);
288:           attachmentIds = uploaded.map(u => u.id);
289:           setStatus('ببعت الطلب…');
290:         }
291:         await assistantApi.stream(
292:           id,
293:           { text, mentions: mentions?.map(m => ({ entity: m.entity, id: m.id })), attachments: attachmentIds },
294:           message => {
295:             setStatus(prev => {
296:               if (prev !== message && prev !== 'جاهز') setSteps(s => (s.at(-1) === prev ? s : [...s, prev].slice(-4)));
297:               return message;
298:             });
299:           },
300:         );
301:         setStreaming(false);
302:         setPendingText(null);
303:         await openConversation(id);
304:         return true;
305:       } catch (e) {
306:         const convId = id;
307:         setError({
308:           message: apiErrorMessage(e, 'تعذر إتمام طلب المساعد. حاول مرة تانية.'),
309:           kind: apiErrorKind(e),
310:           retry: apiErrorKind(e) === 'budget' ? undefined : () => { setCurrentId(convId); void send(text, undefined, mentions, files); },
311:         });
312:         return false;
313:       } finally {
314:         setBusy(false);
315:         setStreaming(false);
316:         setPendingText(null);
317:         setStatus('جاهز');
318:       }
319:     },
320:     [currentId, openConversation],
321:   );

323:   const pick = useCallback(
324:     async (entity: string, id: string | number, label: string) => {
325:       if (!currentId) return;

327:     },

331:   const act = useCallback(
332:     async (kind: 'confirm' | 'cancel' | 'undo', id: string, typed?: string, selected?: string[]) => {
333:       setBusy(true);
334:       setError(null);
335:       try {
336:         if (kind === 'confirm') {
337:           const res = await assistantApi.confirm(id, typed, selected);
338:           const pw = (res.result as { generated_password?: unknown } | undefined)?.generated_password;
339:           if (typeof pw === 'string' && pw !== '') { setOncePassword(pw); setCopied(false); setRevealed(false); }
340:         } else if (kind === 'cancel') await assistantApi.cancel(id);
341:         else await assistantApi.undo(id);
342:         if (currentId) await openConversation(currentId);
343:       } catch (e) {
344:         setError({ message: apiErrorMessage(e, 'تعذر تنفيذ الإجراء.'), kind: apiErrorKind(e) });
345:       } finally {

'إلغاء التثبيت' : 'تثبيت المحادثة'} title={c.is_pinned ? 'إلغاء التثبيت' : 'تثبيت'} onClick={() => void togglePin(c)}><Icon name="pin" size={15} /></button>
417:                           <button type="button" className="as-iconbtn as-iconbtn--sm" disabled={busy} aria-label="حذف المحادثة" title="حذف" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(c.id)}><Icon name="trash" size={15} /></button>
418:                         </div>
419:                       </>
420:                     )}
421:                   </div>

423:               })}
424:             </div>

## File: frontend/apps/backoffice/src/pages/admin/assistant/RichText.tsx
````typescript
 1: import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
 2: import { Icon } from './icons';
 3: 
 4: // H6 (محفوظ): لا dangerouslySetInnerHTML نهائيًا. ده Markdown parser صغير بيبني
 5: // React elements مباشرة، فأي HTML جوه أسماء الفروع/الموظفين يتعرض كنص عادي.
 6: // بيدعم: فقرات، عناوين (#)، قوائم (- / 1.)، اقتباس (>)، كود (``` و `inline`)، **bold**.
 7: 
 8: function inline(text: string, key: string): ReactNode[] {
 9:   const out: ReactNode[] = [];
10:   const re = /(`[^`\n]+`|\*\*[^*\n]+\*\*)/g;
11:   let last = 0; let m: RegExpExecArray | null; let i = 0;
12:   while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
13:     if (m.index > last) out.push(text.slice(last, m.index));
14:     const tok = m[0];
15:     if (tok.startsWith('`')) out.push(<code key={`${key}-c${i++}`}>{tok.slice(1, -1)}</code>);
16:     else out.push(<strong key={`${key}-b${i++}`}>{tok.slice(2, -2)}</strong>);
17:     last = m.index + tok.length;
18:   }
19:   if (last < text.length) out.push(text.slice(last));
20:   return out;
21: }
22: 
23: function CodeBlock({ lang, code }: { lang: string; code: string }) {
24:   const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
25:   return (
26:     <figure className="as-code">
27:       <div className="as-code-head">
28:         <span>{lang || 'code'}</span>
29:         <button
30:           type="button"
31:           className="as-btn as-btn--ghost as-btn--sm"
32:           onClick={() => { void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(code).then(() => { setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500); }).catch(() => undefined); }}
33:         >
34:           <Icon name={copied ? 'check' : 'copy'} size={14} />{copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy'}
35:         </button>
36:       </div>
37:       <pre><code>{code}</code></pre>
38:     </figure>
39:   );
40: }
41: 
42: export function RichText({ text }: { text: string | null }) {
43:   if (!text) return null;
44:   const lines = text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
45:   const blocks: ReactNode[] = [];
46:   let i = 0; let k = 0;
47:   while (i < lines.length) {
48:     const line = lines[i];
49:     const fence = line.match(/^```\s*([\w-]*)\s*$/);
50:     if (fence) {
51:       const buf: string[] = []; i++;
52:       while (i < lines.length && !/^```\s*$/.test(lines[i])) buf.push(lines[i++]);
53:       i++;
54:       blocks.push(<CodeBlock key={k++} lang={fence[1]} code={buf.join('\n')} />);
55:       continue;
56:     }
57:     if (/^\s*$/.test(line)) { i++; continue; }
58:     const h = line.match(/^#{1,4}\s+(.*)$/);
59:     if (h) { blocks.push(<h4 key={k++}>{inline(h[1], `h${k}`)}</h4>); i++; continue; }
60:     if (/^\s*[-*•]\s+/.test(line)) {
61:       const items: string[] = [];
62:       while (i < lines.length && /^\s*[-*•]\s+/.test(lines[i])) items.push(lines[i++].replace(/^\s*[-*•]\s+/, ''));
63:       blocks.push(<ul key={k++}>{items.map((t, j) => <li key={j}>{inline(t, `u${k}-${j}`)}</li>)}</ul>);
64:       continue;
65:     }
66:     if (/^\s*\d+[.)]\s+/.test(line)) {
67:       const items: string[] = [];
68:       while (i < lines.length && /^\s*\d+[.)]\s+/.test(lines[i])) items.push(lines[i++].replace(/^\s*\d+[.)]\s+/, ''));
69:       blocks.push(<ol key={k++}>{items.map((t, j) => <li key={j}>{inline(t, `o${k}-${j}`)}</li>)}</ol>);
70:       continue;
71:     }
72:     if (/^>\s?/.test(line)) {
73:       const buf: string[] = [];
74:       while (i < lines.length && /^>\s?/.test(lines[i])) buf.push(lines[i++].replace(/^>\s?/, ''));
75:       blocks.push(<blockquote key={k++}>{inline(buf.join('\n'), `q${k}`)}</blockquote>);
76:       continue;
77:     }
78:     const buf: string[] = [];
79:     while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() !== '' && !/^(```|#{1,4}\s|\s*[-*•]\s+|\s*\d+[.)]\s+|>)/.test(lines[i])) buf.push(lines[i++]);
80:     if (!buf.length) { buf.push(lines[i++]); }
81:     blocks.push(<p key={k++}>{inline(buf.join('\n'), `p${k}`)}</p>);
82:   }
83:   return <div className="as-rich">{blocks}</div>;
84: }
````

## File: frontend/apps/backoffice/src/pages/admin/assistant/stream.ts
````typescript
 1: export interface AgentEvent { event: string; data: Record<string, unknown> }
 2: export function parseAgentEvents(text: string): AgentEvent[] {
 3:   const frames = text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n\n');
 4:   frames.pop(); // The final frame may still be arriving over the network.
 5:   return frames.flatMap(frame => {
 6:     const lines = frame.split('\n');
 7:     const event = lines.find(l => l.startsWith('event:'))?.slice(6).trim();
 8:     const data = lines.filter(l => l.startsWith('data:')).map(l => l.slice(5).trim()).join('\n');
 9:     if (!event || !data) return [];
10:     try { const parsed = JSON.parse(data); return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed) ? [{ event, data: parsed }] : []; }
11:     catch { return []; }
12:   });
13: }
14: 
15: /**
16:  * L6: incremental SSE parsing for onDownloadProgress. Each progress event
17:  * carries the FULL responseText, so re-parsing from scratch every chunk is
18:  * O(n^2) and freezes the UI on long replies. The parser remembers how many
19:  * bytes it already consumed and only parses newly completed frames,
20:  * buffering the trailing partial frame for the next chunk.
21:  */
22: export function createIncrementalSseParser(): { feed(responseText: string): AgentEvent[] } {
23:   let cursor = 0;
24:   let pending = '';
25:   return {
26:     feed(responseText: string): AgentEvent[] {
27:       if (responseText.length < cursor) { cursor = 0; pending = ''; }
28:       pending += responseText.slice(cursor).replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
29:       cursor = responseText.length;
30:       const frames = pending.split('\n\n');
31:       pending = frames.pop() ?? '';
32:       if (frames.length === 0) return [];
33:       return parseAgentEvents(frames.join('\n\n') + '\n\n');
34:     },
35:   };
36: }

  68:               <div className={cx('flex items-center justify-between text-[12.5px] font-medium', on ? 'text-white/90' : 't-2')}>{l}<span className={cx('w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center', on ? 'bg-white/15' : 'v-well')}><Icon name={ic} size={14} /></span></div>
  69:               <div className={cx('font-display text-[32px] font-bold mt-3 num', !on && 't-1')}>{n}</div>
  70:               <div className={cx('mt-2 h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden', on ? 'bg-white/20' : 'hatched-track')}><div className={cx('h-full rounded-full', on ? 'bg-white' : 'hatched-acc')} style={{ width: `${(counts.all ? n / counts.all : 0) * 100}%` }} /></div>
  71:             </button>
  72:           );
  73:         })}
  74:       </div>
  75: 
  76:       <ConfirmDialog open={!!deleting} onClose={()=>setDeleting(null)} title="حذف المنتج؟" message="سيتم حذف المنتج من الكتالوج." danger confirmLabel="حذف" onConfirm={async()=>{await productsApi.remove(deleting.id);query.reload();stats.reload();}}/>
  77:       <div className="stagger s3">
  78:         <DataTable error={query.error} state={phase} onRetry={retry} rows={res.data} meta={res.meta} filtered={activeFilters > 0}
  79:           onPage={(p) => setQ({ page: p })} onPerPage={(n) => setQ({ per_page: n, page: 1 })} onRowClick={(r) => nav('/products/' + r.id)}
  80:           empty={activeFilters > 0 ? <EmptyState icon="search" title="لا منتجات مطابقة" body="البحث بيشمل الاسم والكود وSKU والباركود. جرّب كلمات أقل أو امسح الفلاتر." action={<button className="btn btn-soft" onClick={() => setQ({ search: '', category: '', status: '', channel: '', featured: '', page: 1 })}>مسح كل الفلاتر</button>} />
  81:             : <EmptyState icon="box" title="لا توجد منتجات بعد" body="ابدأ بأول منتج كمسودة — تقدر تضيف الصور وتنشره بعدين." action={user.can('products.create') && <button className="btn btn-ink" onClick={() => nav('/products/new')}><Icon name="plus" size={15} />منتج جديد</button>} />}
  82:           toolbar={
  83:             <div className="space-y-3">
  84:               <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
  85:                 <SearchBox value={q.search} onChange={(v) => setQ({ search: v, page: 1 })} placeholder="الاسم، الكود، SKU أو الباركود…" width={320} />
  86:                 <div className="w-[230px]"><SearchSelect value={q.category ? +q.category : null} onChange={(v) => setQ({ category: v, page: 1 })} placeholder="كل الأقسام" options={flat.map((f) => ({ value: f.id, label: f.ar, depth: f.depth }))} /></div>
  87:                 {q.category && <label className="h-10 px-3.5 rounded-full v-subcard !rounded-full flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] font-medium t-1 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setQ({ sub: q.sub === '1' ? '0' : '1', page: 1 })}><Check on={q.sub === '1'} />تضمين الأقسام الفرعية</label>}
  88:                 <FilterMenu label="القناة" value={q.channel || null} onChange={(v) => setQ({ channel: v, page: 1 })} options={[{ value: 'retail', label: 'تجزئة' }, { value: 'wholesale', label: 'جملة' }, { value: 'both', label: 'تجزئة + جملة' }]} />
  89:                 <button onClick={() => setQ({ featured: q.featured ? '' : '1', page: 1 })} className={cx('h-10 px-3.5 rounded-full inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[12.5px] font-medium border transition', q.featured ? 'bg-ink border-transparent' : 'btn-outline')}><Icon name="star" size={14} />مميز</button>
  90:                 <div className="ms-auto flex items-center gap-2">
  91:                   <span className="text-[12px] t-3">ترتيب</span>
  92:                   <Seg value={q.sort} onChange={(v) => setQ({ sort: v, page: 1 })} options={[{ value: 'newest', label: 'الأحدث' }, { value: 'oldest', label: 'الأقدم' }, { value: 'name', label: 'الاسم (EN)' }]} />
  93:                 </div>
  94:               </div>
  95:               {activeFilters > 0 && (
  96:                 <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] pop">
  97:                   <span className="t-3"><span className="num font-semibold t-1">{res.meta?.total}</span> نتيجة ·</span>
  98:                   <button className="font-semibold t-acc" onClick={() => setQ({ search: '', category: '', status: '', channel: '', featured: '', page: 1 })}>مسح الفلاتر ({activeFilters})</button>
  99:                   <span className="t-3 ms-auto hidden md:flex items-center gap-1"><Icon name="link" size={12} />الفلاتر محفوظة في الرابط</span>
 100:                 </div>
 101:               )}
 102:             </div>
 103:           }
 104:           columns={[
 105:             { key: 'p', label: 'المنتج', render: (r) => (
 106:               <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-[240px]">
 107:                 <span className="w-12 h-12 rounded-[14px] shrink-0 relative" style={{ background: r.img }}>{r.featured && <span className="absolute -top-1 -end-1 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-acc flex items-center justify-center" style={{ boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px var(--bg-card)' }}><Icon name="star" size={10} sw={2.5} /></span>}</span>
 108:                 <div className="min-w-0"><div className="font-semibold t-1 truncate">{r.ar}</div><div className="text-[11px] t-3 ltr inline-block">{r.code}</div></div>
 109:               </div>), skel: () => <div className="flex items-center gap-3"><Skel w={48} h={48} r={14} /><div className="space-y-1.5 flex-1"><Skel w="70%" h={10} /><Skel w="40%" h={8} /></div></div> },
 110:             { key: 'cat', label: 'القسم', render: (r) => <div><div className="t-1 text-[12.5px]">{r.cat}</div></div> },
 111:             { key: 'status', label: 'الحالة', render: (r) => <StatusBadge s={r.status} /> },
 112:             { key: 'channel', label: 'القناة', render: (r) => <span className="text-[12px] t-2 whitespace-nowrap">{CHANNEL_LABEL[r.channel]}</span> },
 113:             { key: 'variants', label: 'المتغيرات', align: 'center', render: (r) => <span className="inline-flex w-7 h-7 rounded-full v-well items-center justify-center text-[11.5px] font-bold num t-1">{r.variants}</span> },
 114:             { key: 'price', label: 'سعر التجزئة', render: (r) => r.channel === 'wholesale' ? <span className="t-3 text-[12px]">جملة فقط</span> : r.min == null ? <span className="text-[11.5px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-amber-text)' }}>غير مكتمل</span> : <span className="num font-semibold t-1 whitespace-nowrap">{r.min === r.max ? fmtMoney(r.min) : `${fmtMoney(r.min)} – ${fmtMoney(r.max)}`} <span className="text-[10.5px] t-3 font-medium">ج.م</span></span> },
 115:             { key: 'a', label: '', render: (r) => <RowActions onEdit={() => nav('/products/' + r.id)} onDelete={user.can('products.delete') ? ()=>setDeleting(r) : undefined} /> },
 116:           ]} />
 117:       </div>
 118:     </div>
 119:   );
 120: }

 135: function flattenCats(nodes, depth = 0, path = []) {
 136:   return nodes.flatMap((n) => [{ ...n, depth, path: [...path, n.ar] }, ...flattenCats(n.children || [], depth + 1, [...path, n.ar])]);
 137: }

 212: function Icon({ name, size = 16, className = '', style, sw = 1.9 }) {
 213:   return (
 214:     <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
 215:       strokeWidth={sw} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" className={'shrink-0 ' + className} style={style} aria-hidden="true">
 216:       {ICON_PATHS[name] || ICON_PATHS.info}
 217:     </svg>
 218:   );
 219: }

 221: function blankProduct() {
 222:   return {
 223:     status: null, code: null,
 224:     basic: { ar: '', en: '', category: null, brand: null, channel: 'retail', slug: '', desc_ar: '', desc_en: '', mat_ar: '', mat_en: '', l: '', w: '', h: '', kg: '', warranty: '', warranty_details: '', origin: '', featured: false, supplier: null },
 225:     mode: 'single', axes: { colors: [], sizes: [], capacities: [] }, rows: [emptyVariant(null, '', '', 0)],
 226:     media: { general: [], byVariant: {}, video: null },
 227:   };
 228: }

 230: function ProductForm({ id, initial }) {
 231:   const { user, categories: CATEGORIES } = useApp();
 232:   const isNew = id === 'new';
 233:   const [p, setP] = useState(() => initial || blankProduct());
 234:   const [saved, setSaved] = useState(JSON.stringify(p));
 235:   const [tab, setTabQ] = useQueryState({ tab: 'basic' });
 236:   const [errs, setErrs] = useState({ basic: {}, variants: {} });
 237:   const [summary, setSummary] = useState(null);
 238:   const [flow, setFlow] = useState(null); // {steps:[{k,label,state}], done}
 239:   const [blockModal, setBlockModal] = useState(null);
 240:   const [leave, setLeave] = useState(false);

 254:   const inactiveAncestor = catChain.find((c) => c && c.status !== 'active');

 260:   const ready = [

 262:     { k: 'var', ok: activeRows.length > 0, label: 'متغير نشط واحد على الأقل', detail: `${activeRows.length} متغير نشط من ${p.rows.length}`, tab: 'variants' },

 278:     if((B.ar||'').length>255)e.ar='الحد الأقصى 255 حرف';if((B.en||'').length>255)e.en='الحد الأقصى 255 حرف';
 279:     if(B.warranty!=='' && (!Number.isInteger(Number(B.warranty)) || +B.warranty<0 || +B.warranty>120))e.warranty='الضمان من 0 إلى 120 شهراً';
 280:     for(const k of ['l','w','h','kg'])if(B[k]!=='' && (!Number.isFinite(Number(B[k])) || +B[k]<0))e[k]='القيمة يجب أن تكون رقماً موجباً';
 281:     if (!B.ar?.trim()) e.ar = 'الاسم العربي مطلوب';

 283:     if (!B.category) e.category = 'اختر القسم';

 288:     const run = async (publish) => {

 291:     // Drafts tolerate missing prices; only structural errors block

 294:     setErrs({ basic: be, variants: structural, variantsShown: true });
 295:     if (Object.keys(be).length || Object.keys(structural).length) {
 296:       const items = [
 297:         ...Object.values(be).map((t) => ({ text: t, tab: 'البيانات الأساسية', go: 'basic' })),
 298:         ...Object.entries(structural).flatMap(([rid, e]) => { const i = p.rows.findIndex((r) => r._id === rid); return Object.entries(e).map(([f, t]) => ({ text: `variants.${i}.${f === 'dup' ? 'combination' : f === 'retail' ? 'retail_price' : f === 'wholesale' ? 'wholesale_price' : f} — ${t}`, tab: 'المتغيرات', go: 'variants' })); }),
 299:       ];
 300:       setSummary({ title: 'تعذّر الحفظ — راجع الحقول التالية', subtitle: 'كل خطأ مربوط بالحقل بتاعه في التبويب.', items });
 301:       setTabQ({ tab: items[0].go });
 302:       return;
 303:     }
 304:     setSummary(null);
 305:     const steps = [
 306:       { k: 'save', label: p.status ? 'تحديث المسودة والمتغيرات' : 'حفظ المسودة والمتغيرات', state: 'run' },
 307:       { k: 'upload', label: `رفع الصور (${p.media.general.filter((f) => f.status !== 'done').length + Object.values(p.media.byVariant).flat().filter((f) => f.status !== 'done').length + (p.media.video && p.media.video.status !== 'done' ? 1 : 0)} ملف)`, state: 'wait' },
 308:       ...(publish ? [{ k: 'publish', label: 'تحديث الحالة إلى منشور', state: 'wait' }] : []),
 309:     ];
 310:     setFlow({ steps: [...steps], publish });
 311:     const mark = (k, state, extra) => setFlow((f) => ({ ...f, steps: f.steps.map((s) => s.k === k ? { ...s, state, ...extra } : s) }));
 312:     let saveCompleted=false;
 313:     try {
 314:       let next = await persistProduct(p, JSON.parse(saved), canCost, value => {setP({...value});},()=>{saveCompleted=true;mark('save','done');mark('upload','run');});
 315:       mark('save','done');mark('upload','done');
 316:       if(publish){mark('publish','run'); const published=await productsApi.update(next.id,{status:'published',...(next.lock_version !== undefined ? {expected_version:next.lock_version} : {})});next={...next,status:published.status,publishedAt:published.published_at,lock_version:published.lock_version,updated_at:published.updated_at};mark('publish','done'); }
 317:       setP(next);setSaved(JSON.stringify(next));setFlow(f=>({...f,done:'ok',code:next.code}));
 318:     } catch(e) {
 319:       const error=normalizeError(e);if(!saveCompleted)setFlow(null);else setFlow(f=>({...f,done:error.summary.length?'blocked':'upload_fail',reasons:error.summary.length?error.summary:[error.message],steps:f.steps.map(step=>({...step,state:step.state==='run'?'fail':step.state==='wait'?'skip':step.state}))}));
 320:       if(e.catalogProductId){try{const [product,media]=await Promise.all([productsApi.show(e.catalogProductId),productMediaApi.list(e.catalogProductId)]);const fresh={...productFromApi(product,media,{canViewCost:canCost}),id:product.id};setP(fresh);setSaved(JSON.stringify(fresh));}catch{vtoast('تعذّر تحديث البيانات بعد الحفظ الجزئي. أعد تحميل المنتج قبل التعديل.','error');}}
 321:       const basic={},variants={}; const map=BASIC_SERVER_KEY_TO_UI;
 322:       if(e.catalogRowKey)variants[e.catalogRowKey]=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(error.fields).map(([key,messages])=>[{retail_price:'retail',wholesale_price:'wholesale',cost_price:'cost',compare_at_price:'compare',color_name_en:'color_en'}[key]||key,messages[0]]));
 323:       for(const [key,messages] of Object.entries(error.fields)){const match=key.match(/^variants\.(\d+)\.(.+)$/);if(match){const row=p.rows[+match[1]];if(row){const k={retail_price:'retail',wholesale_price:'wholesale',cost_price:'cost',compare_at_price:'compare',color_name_en:'color_en'}[match[2]]||match[2];variants[row._id]={...(variants[row._id]||{}),[k]:messages[0]};}}else if(!e.catalogRowKey)basic[map[key]||key]=messages[0];}
 324:       setErrs({basic,variants,variantsShown:true});setTabQ({tab:e.catalogTab || (Object.keys(variants).length?'variants':'basic')});
 325:       setSummary({title:error.message || e.message,items:[...error.summary,...Object.values(error.fields).flat(),...(error.summary.length||Object.keys(error.fields).length?[]:[error.message])].map(text=>({text,go:e.catalogTab || (e.catalogRowKey?'variants':'basic'),tab:e.catalogTab==='media'?'الصور والفيديو':e.catalogRowKey?'المتغيرات':'البيانات الأساسية'}))});
 326:     }

 329:   const onDeactivateLast = () => {

 331:     return false;
 332:   };

 334:   const tabs = [
 335:     { value: 'basic', label: 'البيانات الأساسية', num: 1, state: tabState('basic') },
 336:     { value: 'variants', label: 'المتغيرات والأسعار', num: 2, state: tabState('variants') },
 337:     { value: 'media', label: 'الصور والفيديو', num: 3, state: tabState('media') },

 341:   return (
 342:     <div className="space-y-5">

 345:         title={isNew && !p.code ? 'منتج جديد' : B.ar || 'بدون اسم'}
 346:         badge={<>{p.status ? <StatusBadge s={p.status} /> : <Badge>لم يُحفظ بعد</Badge>}{p.code && <span className="ltr text-[12px] font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full v-pill t-2">{p.code}</span>}</>}
 347:         actions={<button className="btn btn-soft" onClick={() => dirty ? setLeave(true) : nav('/products')}><Icon name="arrowRight" size={14} />المنتجات</button>} />

 349:       <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 stagger s2">

 354:           <span className={cx('h-8 px-3 rounded-full text-[12px] font-bold num flex items-center', readyCount === ready.length ? 'b-green' : 'v-well t-1')}>{readyCount}/{ready.length}</span>
 355:         </div>
 356:       </div>

 358:       {summary && <ErrorSummary title={summary.title} subtitle={summary.subtitle} items={summary.items} onClose={() => setSummary(null)} onJump={(it) => setTabQ({ tab: it.go })} />}

 365:             axes={p.axes} setAxes={(a) => setP({ ...p, axes: a })} rows={p.rows}
