 382:         <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => run(false)} disabled={!writable || (!!flow && !flow.done)}><Icon name="edit" size={14} />{p.status === 'published'||p.status==='archived' ? 'حفظ التعديلات' : 'حفظ كمسودة'}</button>
 383:         {canPublish && p.id && (p.status==='published'?[['draft','إلغاء النشر'],['archived','أرشفة']]:p.status==='archived'?[['draft','استرجاع كمسودة']]:[]).map(([status,label])=><button key={status} disabled={!!flow&&!flow.done} className="btn btn-soft" onClick={async()=>{if(dirty&&!window.confirm('تغيير الحالة سيحفظ حالة المنتج فقط. ستبقى تعديلاتك غير المحفوظة؛ متابعة؟'))return;try{await productsApi.update(p.id,{status});setP({...p,status});setSaved(JSON.stringify({...JSON.parse(saved),status}));}catch(e){vtoast(normalizeError(e).message,'error');}}}>{label}</button>)}
 384:         {canPublish ? (

 386:             if (readyCount < ready.length) { setSummary({ title: 'المنتج غير جاهز للنشر', subtitle: 'أكمل البنود التالية، أو احفظه كمسودة لحين الانتهاء.', items: ready.filter((r) => !r.ok && r.tab).map((r) => ({ text: `${r.label} — ${r.detail}`, tab: tabs.find((t) => t.value === r.tab).label, go: r.tab })) }); return; }
 387:             run(true);
 388:           }} disabled={!!flow && !flow.done}><Icon name="send" size={14} />{p.status==='archived'?'إعادة النشر':'حفظ ونشر'}</button>
 389:         ) : <span className="h-10 px-4 rounded-full v-well text-[12px] font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5" title="يتطلب products.publish"><Icon name="lock" size={13} />النشر يتطلب صلاحية</span>}
 390:       </StickyBar>}
 391:

 393:         onGoto={(t) => { setFlow(null); setTabQ({ tab: t }); }} />
 394:       <Modal open={!!blockModal} onClose={() => setBlockModal(null)} icon="ban" iconTone="red"

 397:         <div className="v-subcard p-4 text-[12.5px] t-2 leading-relaxed">

 399:         </div>

 403:         </div>
 404:       </Modal>
 405:       <LeaveDialog open={leave} onStay={() => setLeave(false)} onLeave={() => { setLeave(false); nav('/products'); }} />
 406:     </div>
 407:   );

'يُفضّل كتابة الاسم بالإنجليزية لتوليد رابط مناسب' : null} id="en"><Input ltr dir="ltr" value={B.en} onChange={(e) => set('en', e.target.value)} error={errs.en} placeholder="Alfarid Travel Bag" /></Field>

 454:             <Field label="العرض"><Input ltr suffix="سم" value={B.w} onChange={(e) => set('w', e.target.value)} /></Field>
 455:             <Field label="الارتفاع"><Input ltr suffix="سم" value={B.h} onChange={(e) => set('h', e.target.value)} /></Field>
 456:             <Field label="الوزن"><Input ltr suffix="كجم" value={B.kg} onChange={(e) => set('kg', e.target.value)} /></Field>
 457:           </div>
 458:           <div className="grid md:grid-cols-[160px_1fr_200px] gap-3 mt-4">
 459:             <Field label="مدة الضمان"><Input ltr suffix="شهر" value={B.warranty} onChange={(e) => set('warranty', e.target.value)} /></Field>
 460:             <Field label="تفاصيل الضمان"><Input dir="auto" value={B.warranty_details} onChange={(e) => set('warranty_details', e.target.value)} /></Field>
 461:             <Field label="بلد المنشأ"><Input dir="auto" value={B.origin} onChange={(e) => set('origin', e.target.value)} /></Field>
 462:           </div>
 463:         </SectionCard>
 464:       </div>
 465: 
 466:       <div className="space-y-5 lg:sticky lg:top-5">
 467:         <div className="v-card p-5">
 468:           <Field label="كود المنتج" hint="بيتولد من الخادم بعد أول حفظ ولا يمكن تعديله.">
 469:             <div className="v-input is-readonly ltr flex items-center justify-between">{code || <span className="t-3">PRD-••••••</span>}<Icon name="lock" size={14} className="t-3" /></div>
 470:           </Field>
 471:           <div className="mt-4"><Field error={errs.slug} label="الرابط (slug)" hint="اختياري — بيتولد من الاسم الإنجليزي">
 472:             <Input ltr value={B.slug} placeholder={(B.en || '').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-') || 'auto'} onChange={(e) => set('slug', e.target.value)} />
 473:           </Field></div>
 474:         </div>
 475:         <div className={cx('rounded-[22px] p-5 transition cursor-pointer', B.featured ? 'v-orange' : 'v-card')} onClick={() => set('featured', !B.featured)}>
 476:           <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 477:             <span className={cx('w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center', B.featured ? 'bg-white/15' : 'v-well')}><Icon name="star" size={18} /></span>
 478:             <Toggle on={B.featured} onChange={(x) => set('featured', x)} />
 479:           </div>
 480:           <div className={cx('text-[14px] font-semibold mt-3', !B.featured && 't-1')}>منتج مميز</div>
 481:           <div className={cx('text-[12px] mt-0.5', B.featured ? 'text-white/80' : 't-3')}>يظهر في الواجهة الرئيسية للمتجر وأقسام «المختارات».</div>
 482:         </div>
 483: 
 484:       </div>
 485:     </div>
 486:   );

 489: /* ---------- Tab C: Media ---------- */
 490: function MediaTab({media,setMedia,axes,mode,saved,onRetry}) {
 491:  const [sizeErr,setSizeErr]=useState('');const setError=setSizeErr;
 492:  const inputRef=useRef(null),target=useRef('general');const [dragIdx,setDragIdx]=useState(null);
 493:  const addFiles=(count,color='general')=>{target.current=color;const el=inputRef.current;el.multiple=color!=='video';el.accept=color==='video'?'video/mp4,video/webm,video/quicktime':'image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp';el.click();};
 494:  const reorder=to=>{if(dragIdx==null||dragIdx===to)return;const items=[...media.general];items.splice(to,0,items.splice(dragIdx,1)[0]);setMedia({...media,general:items});setDragIdx(to);};
 495:  const pick=async(files,color='',video=false)=>{
 496:    const pending=[];
 497:    for(const file of files){
 498:      if(!((video?['video/mp4','video/webm','video/quicktime']:['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp']).includes(file.type)) || file.size>(video?50:5)*1024*1024){setError('صيغة أو حجم غير مسموح: الصور حتى 5MB والفيديو حتى 50MB');return;}
 499:      if(!video){try{const bitmap=await createImageBitmap(file);const valid=bitmap.width*bitmap.height<=16000000;bitmap.close();if(!valid)throw Error();}catch{setError('صورة غير صالحة أو تتجاوز 16 ميجابكسل');return;}}
 500:      pending.push({id:'pending-'+Math.random(),file,name:file.name,size:(file.size/1048576).toFixed(2)+'MB',status:'queued'});
 501:    }
 502:    setError('');
 503:    if(!pending.length)return;
 504:    if(video){if(media.video&&!window.confirm('استبدال الفيديو الحالي؟ سيتم حذفه عند الحفظ.'))return;setMedia({...media,video:pending[0]});}
 505:    else if(color)setMedia({...media,byVariant:{...media.byVariant,[color]:[...(media.byVariant[color]||[]),...pending]}});
 506:    else setMedia({...media,general:[...media.general,...pending]});
 507:  };
 508:   const failed = [...media.general,...Object.values(media.byVariant).flat(),...(media.video?[media.video]:[])].filter((f) => f.status === 'failed').length;
 509:   const queued = media.general.filter((f) => f.status === 'queued').length;
 510:   return (
 511:     <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_340px] gap-5 items-start">
 512:       <div className="space-y-5">
 513:         <input ref={inputRef} className="sr-only" type="file" multiple accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" onChange={e=>{void pick([...e.target.files],target.current==='general'||target.current==='video'?'':target.current,target.current==='video');e.target.value='';}}/>
 514:         {!saved && <Banner tone="blue" icon="info" title="الصور هتترفع بعد حفظ المسودة">تقدر تختار الملفات دلوقتي. الرفع الفعلي بيبدأ تلقائيًا بعد ما المنتج والمتغيرات يتحفظوا.</Banner>}
 515:         {failed > 0 && <Banner tone="red" icon="alertCircle" title={`${failed} صورة فشل رفعها`} action={<button className="btn btn-sm btn-ink" onClick={onRetry}><Icon name="refresh" size={13} />إعادة رفع الكل</button>}>المسودة محفوظة. أعد رفع الصور الفاشلة بدون إنشاء منتج جديد.</Banner>}
 516:         <SectionCard title="صور المنتج" subtitle="اسحب لتغيير الترتيب. الصورة الأولى هي الرئيسية في المتجر." aside={<span className="text-[12px] t-3 num">{media.general.length}</span>}>
 517:           {sizeErr && <Banner tone="red" icon="alertCircle" className="mb-4 pop" onClose={() => setSizeErr(null)}>{sizeErr}</Banner>}
 518:           <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
 519:             {media.general.map((f, i) => (
 520:               <FileTile key={f.id} file={f} index={i + 1} primary={i === 0 && f.status !== 'failed'} draggable
 521:                 onDragStart={() => setDragIdx(i)} onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); reorder(i); }} onDrop={() => setDragIdx(null)}
 522:                 onRemove={() => setMedia({ ...media, general: media.general.filter((x) => x.id !== f.id) })} onRetry={onRetry} />
 523:             ))}
 524:             {true && (
 525:               <button onClick={() => addFiles(2)} className="dropzone aspect-[4/3] sm:aspect-auto min-h-[150px] flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 t-2">
 526:                 <span className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full b-acc flex items-center justify-center"><Icon name="plus" size={18} /></span>
 527:                 <span className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold t-1">إضافة صور</span>
 528:               </button>
 529:             )}
 530:           </div>
 531:           {media.general.length === 0 && <div className="mt-3"><DropZone title="اسحب صور المنتج هنا" rules={['JPG · PNG · WebP', 'حتى 5MB للصورة', 'حتى 16 ميجابكسل', 'صورتان بالتوازي']} onPick={() => addFiles(3)} onFiles={files=>pick(files)} /></div>}
 532:           {media.general.length > 0 && <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-4">{['JPG · PNG · WebP', 'حتى 5MB للصورة', 'حتى 16 ميجابكسل', 'صورتان بالتوازي'].map((r) => <span key={r} className="text-[10.5px] font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full v-well">{r}</span>)}{queued > 0 && <Badge tone="amber" className="ms-auto">{queued} بانتظار الحفظ</Badge>}</div>}
 533:         </SectionCard>
 534: 
 535:         {mode === 'matrix' && axes.colors.length > 0 && (
 536:           <SectionCard title="صور حسب اللون" subtitle="بتظهر لما العميل يختار اللون ده. اختيارية.">
 537:             <div className="space-y-3">
 538:               {axes.colors.map((c) => {
 539:                 const list = media.byVariant[c.en] || [];
 540:                 return (
 541:                   <div key={c.en} className="v-subcard p-3.5 flex items-center gap-4">
 542:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 w-[150px] shrink-0"><Swatch c={c.hex} size={28} /><div><div className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold t-1">{c.ar}</div><div className="text-[10.5px] t-3 ltr">{c.en}</div></div></div>
 543:                     <div className="flex-1 flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto">
 544:                       {list.map((f) => <div key={f.id} className="w-16 shrink-0"><FileTile compact file={f} onRetry={onRetry} onRemove={() => setMedia({ ...media, byVariant: { ...media.byVariant, [c.en]: list.filter((x) => x.id !== f.id) } })} /></div>)}
 545:                       <button onClick={() => addFiles(1, c.en)} className="dropzone w-16 h-16 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center t-3"><Icon name="plus" size={16} /></button>
 546:                     </div>
 547:                   </div>
 548:                 );
 549:               })}
 550:             </div>
 551:           </SectionCard>
 552:         )}
 553: 
 554:         <SectionCard title="فيديو المنتج" subtitle="فيديو واحد للمنتج كله — مش مرتبط بمتغير.">
 555:           {media.video ? (
 556:             <div className="flex items-center gap-4 v-subcard p-3.5">
 557:               <div className="w-28 aspect-video rounded-[12px] flex items-center justify-center" style={{ background: IMG[6], color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.7)' }}><Icon name="video" size={22} /></div>
 558:               <div className="flex-1"><div className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold t-1 ltr text-end">{media.video.name}</div><div className="text-[11px] t-3 num">{media.video.size}</div>
 559:                 {media.video.status === 'queued' && <Badge tone="amber" className="mt-1.5">بانتظار الحفظ</Badge>}{media.video.status==='uploading'&&<span>{media.video.progress}%</span>}{media.video.status==='failed'&&<div className="t-acc">{media.video.message}<button className="btn btn-sm" onClick={onRetry}>إعادة المحاولة</button></div>}</div>
 560:               <button className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" onClick={()=>addFiles(1,'video')}>استبدال الفيديو</button>
 561:               <button className="icon-btn" onClick={() => setMedia({ ...media, video: null })}><Icon name="trash" size={15} /></button>
 562:             </div>
 563:           ) : <DropZone icon="video" title="اختر فيديو" rules={['MP4 · MOV', 'حتى 50MB', 'فيديو واحد فقط']} onPick={() => addFiles(1,'video')} onFiles={files=>pick(files,'',true)} />}
 564:         </SectionCard>
 565:       </div>
 566: 
 567:       <div className="v-card p-5 lg:sticky lg:top-5">
 568:         <div className="text-[13px] font-semibold t-1 mb-1">معاينة ترتيب العرض</div>
 569:         <div className="text-[11.5px] t-3 mb-4">كده هتظهر في صفحة المنتج.</div>
 570:         <div className="rounded-[18px] aspect-square relative overflow-hidden" style={{ background: (media.general[0]?.url ? 'url("'+media.general[0].url+'") center / cover' : media.general[0]?.bg) || 'var(--bg-subcard)' }}>
 571:           {!media.general[0] && <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center t-3"><Icon name="image" size={30} /></div>}
 572:           {media.video && <span className="absolute bottom-3 end-3 h-7 px-2.5 rounded-full bg-black/55 text-white text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"><Icon name="video" size={12} />فيديو</span>}
 573:         </div>
 574:         <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1.5 mt-2">
 575:           {media.general.slice(0, 5).map((f, i) => <div key={f.id} className={cx('aspect-square rounded-[10px] relative', i === 0 && 'ring-2 ring-[var(--accent)] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[var(--bg-card)]')} style={{ background: f.url ? 'url("'+f.url+'") center / cover' : f.bg, opacity: f.status === 'failed' ? .35 : 1 }} />)}
 576:           {Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, 5 - media.general.length) }).map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="aspect-square rounded-[10px] v-subcard" />)}
 577:         </div>
 578:       </div>
 579:     </div>
 580:   );
 581: }

 584: function ReviewTab({ p, ready, canCost, canPublish, goto, catNode }) {
 585:   const B = p.basic;
 586:   const prices = p.rows.map((r) => +r.retail).filter(Boolean);
 587:   const okCount = ready.filter((r) => r.ok).length;
 588:   return (
 589:     <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_380px] gap-5 items-start">
 590:       <div className="v-card p-6">
 591:         <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
 592:           <div><div className="font-display text-[17px] font-semibold t-1">قائمة الجاهزية للنشر</div><div className="text-[12.5px] t-2 mt-0.5">كل البنود لازم تكون مكتملة قبل النشر. الحفظ كمسودة متاح دائمًا.</div></div>
 593:           <div className="text-end"><div className="font-display text-[28px] font-bold t-1 num leading-none">{okCount}<span className="t-3 text-[16px]">/{ready.length}</span></div></div>
 594:         </div>
 595:         <div className="mt-5 space-y-2">
 596:           {ready.map((r) => (
 597:             <div key={r.k} className={cx('flex items-center gap-3.5 p-4 rounded-[16px]', r.ok ? 'v-subcard' : 'border border-dashed')} style={!r.ok ? { borderColor: 'var(--badge-red-text)', background: 'var(--badge-red-bg)' } : null}>
 598:               <span className={cx('w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0', r.ok ? 'b-green' : 'bg-[var(--bg-card)]')} style={!r.ok ? { color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' } : null}><Icon name={r.ok ? 'check' : r.k === 'perm' ? 'lock' : 'x'} size={16} sw={2.5} /></span>
 599:               <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"><div className="text-[13px] font-semibold t-1">{r.label}</div><div className="text-[11.5px] t-2 mt-0.5">{r.detail}</div></div>
 600:               {!r.ok && r.tab && <button className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" onClick={() => goto(r.tab)}>إصلاح<Icon name="chevLeft" size={13} /></button>}
 601:             </div>
 602:           ))}
 603:         </div>
 604:         <div className="mt-5 v-subcard p-4">
 605:           <div className="text-[12px] font-semibold t-2 mb-3">تسلسل التنفيذ عند النشر</div>
 606:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px]">
 607:             {['حفظ المسودة والمتغيرات', 'رفع الصور', 'تحديث الحالة إلى منشور'].map((s, i) => (
 608:               <React.Fragment key={s}>
 609:                 {i > 0 && <span className="flex-1 h-[2px] min-w-[16px] hatched-track rounded-full" />}
 610:                 <span className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0"><span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-ink text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center num">{i + 1}</span><span className="t-1 font-medium">{s}</span></span>
 611:               </React.Fragment>
 612:             ))}
 613:           </div>
 614:         </div>
 615:       </div>
 616: 
 617:       <div className="v-card overflow-hidden">
 618:         <div className="aspect-[4/3] relative" style={{ background: (p.media.general[0] && p.media.general[0].bg) || 'var(--bg-subcard)' }}>
 619:           {B.featured && <span className="absolute top-3 start-3 h-7 px-2.5 rounded-full bg-acc text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"><Icon name="star" size={11} sw={2.5} />مميز</span>}
 620:           <span className="absolute top-3 end-3">{p.status ? <StatusBadge s={p.status} /> : <Badge>جديد</Badge>}</span>
 621:         </div>
 622:         <div className="p-5">
 623:           <div className="text-[11.5px] t-3">{catNode ? catNode.path.join(' › ') : 'بدون قسم'}</div>
 624:           <div className="font-display text-[18px] font-semibold t-1 mt-1">{B.ar || 'بدون اسم'}</div>
 625:           <div className="text-[12px] t-3 ltr text-end">{B.en}</div>
 626:           <div className="font-display text-[22px] font-bold t-1 mt-3 num">{prices.length ? (Math.min(...prices) === Math.max(...prices) ? fmtMoney(prices[0]) : `${fmtMoney(Math.min(...prices))} – ${fmtMoney(Math.max(...prices))}`) : '—'} <span className="text-[12px] t-3 font-medium">ج.م</span></div>
 627:           {p.mode === 'matrix' && p.axes.colors.length > 0 && <div className="flex gap-1.5 mt-3">{p.axes.colors.map((c) => <Swatch key={c.en} c={c.hex} size={22} />)}</div>}
 628:           <div className="v-divide mt-4">
 629:             <KV k="قناة البيع" v={CHANNEL_LABEL[B.channel]} />
 630:             <KV k="المتغيرات" v={<span className="num">{p.rows.length}</span>} />
 631:             <KV k="الصور" v={<span className="num">{p.media.general.length}</span>} />
 632:             {canCost && prices.length > 0 && <KV k="متوسط الهامش" v={<span className="num" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-green-text)' }}>{Math.round(100 - (p.rows.reduce((a, r) => a + (+r.cost || 0), 0) / p.rows.reduce((a, r) => a + (+r.retail || 1), 0)) * 100)}%</span>} />}
 633:           </div>
 634:         </div>
 635:       </div>
 636:     </div>
 637:   );
 638: }

 640: /* ---------- Publish flow modal ---------- */
 641: function PublishFlow({ flow, onClose, onRetryUpload, onGoto }) {
 642:   if (!flow) return null;
 643:   const icon = (s) => s === 'done' ? <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full b-green flex items-center justify-center"><Icon name="check" size={15} sw={2.6} /></span>
 644:     : s === 'run' ? <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full b-acc flex items-center justify-center"><Spinner size={15} /></span>
 645:     : s === 'fail' ? <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full b-red flex items-center justify-center"><Icon name="x" size={15} sw={2.6} /></span>
 646:     : s === 'skip' ? <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full v-well flex items-center justify-center"><Icon name="minus" size={15} /></span>
 647:     : <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full v-well flex items-center justify-center"><span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-current opacity-40" /></span>;
 648:   const d = flow.done;
 649:   return (
 650:     <Modal open onClose={d ? onClose : null} width={500}
 651:       title={!d ? (flow.publish ? 'جارٍ النشر…' : 'جارٍ الحفظ…') : d === 'ok' ? (flow.publish ? 'تم نشر المنتج' : 'تم حفظ المسودة') : d === 'upload_fail' ? 'المسودة اتحفظت، لكن بعض الصور فشلت' : 'المسودة اتحفظت، لكن النشر اترفض'}
 652:       subtitle={d === 'ok' ? <>كود المنتج <span className="ltr inline-block font-semibold t-1">{flow.code}</span></> : d === 'upload_fail' ? 'ما اتعملش منتج جديد. أعد رفع الصور الفاشلة من تبويب الصور.' : d === 'blocked' ? 'الخادم رفض تحديث الحالة. صلّح البنود دي وجرّب تاني.' : 'ما تقفلش الصفحة لحد ما تخلص الخطوات.'}
 653:       icon={!d ? 'send' : d === 'ok' ? 'checkCircle' : 'alert'} iconTone={!d ? 'acc' : d === 'ok' ? 'green' : 'amber'}>
 654:       <div className="v-subcard p-2">
 655:         {flow.steps.map((s, i) => (
 656:           <div key={s.k} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5">
 657:             {icon(s.state)}
 658:             <div className="flex-1"><div className={cx('text-[13px] font-medium', s.state === 'wait' || s.state === 'skip' ? 't-3' : 't-1')}>{s.label}</div>{s.note && <div className="text-[11.5px] mt-0.5" style={{ color: s.state === 'fail' ? 'var(--badge-red-text)' : undefined }}>{s.note}</div>}</div>
 659:             <span className="text-[10.5px] t-3 num">{i + 1}/{flow.steps.length}</span>
 660:           </div>
 661:         ))}
 662:       </div>
 663:       {d === 'upload_fail' && <Banner tone="red" className="mt-4">{(flow.reasons || []).join(' — ')}</Banner>}
 664:       {d === 'blocked' && (
 665:         <div className="mt-4 pop">
 666:           <div className="text-[11.5px] t-3 mb-2 ltr text-end">422 · errors.status</div>
 667:           <div className="space-y-1.5">
 668:             {(flow.reasons || []).map(t=>({t,tab:/سعر|متغير/.test(t)?'variants':/صور|صورة/.test(t)?'media':'basic',tl:'اذهب'})).map((x) => (
 669:               <button key={x.t} onClick={() => onGoto(x.tab)} className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-[14px] b-red text-start hover:opacity-90"><Icon name="alertCircle" size={15} /><span className="flex-1 text-[12.5px] font-medium">{x.t}</span><span className="text-[11px] opacity-80 flex items-center gap-1">{x.tl}<Icon name="chevLeft" size={12} /></span></button>
 670:             ))}
 671:           </div>
 672:         </div>
 673:       )}
 674:       {d && (
 675:         <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-5">
 676:           {d === 'ok' ? <><button className="btn btn-soft" onClick={() => { onClose(); nav('/products'); }}>كل المنتجات</button><button className="btn btn-ink" onClick={onClose}>متابعة التعديل</button></>
 677:             : d === 'upload_fail' ? <><button className="btn btn-soft" onClick={onClose}>لاحقًا</button><button className="btn btn-ink" onClick={onRetryUpload}><Icon name="refresh" size={14} />إعادة رفع الصور الفاشلة</button></>
 678:             : <button className="btn btn-ink" onClick={onClose}>فهمت</button>}
 679:         </div>
 680:       )}
 681:     </Modal>
 682:   );
 683: }

 686: const AppCtx = createContext(null);

 689: /* ---------- Hash router with query (URL-persisted page/search/filters) ---------- */
 690: function parseHash() {
 691:   const h = location.hash.replace(/^#/, '') || (/^\/(products|dealers|production)(\/|$)/.test(location.pathname) ? location.pathname : '/products');
 692:   const [path, qs] = h.split('?');
 693:   const q = Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(qs || ''));
 694:   return { path, q, parts: path.split('/').filter(Boolean) };
 695: }
 696: function useRoute() {
 697:   const [r, setR] = useState(parseHash());
 698:   useEffect(() => { const h = () => setR(parseHash()); window.addEventListener('hashchange', h); return () => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', h); }, []);
 699:   return r;
 700: }
 701: function nav(path, q) {
 702:   const qs = q ? new URLSearchParams(Object.entries(q).filter(([, v]) => v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '' && v !== false)).toString() : '';
 703:   location.hash = path + (qs ? '?' + qs : '');
 704: }
 705: // Update query in place (replace), keeps URL as source of truth for list state
 706: function useQueryState(defaults) {
 707:   const [r,setR] = useState(parseHash);
 708:   useEffect(()=>{const changed=()=>setR(parseHash());window.addEventListener('hashchange',changed);return()=>window.removeEventListener('hashchange',changed);},[]);
 709:   const state = { ...defaults, ...r.q };
 710:   const set = (patch) => {
 711:     const next = { ...state, ...patch };
 712:     Object.keys(defaults).forEach((k) => { if (String(next[k]) === String(defaults[k])) delete next[k]; });
 713:     const qs = new URLSearchParams(Object.entries(next).filter(([, v]) => v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '')).toString();
 714:     history.replaceState(null, '', '#' + parseHash().path + (qs ? '?' + qs : ''));
 715:     setR(parseHash());
 716:   };
 717:   return [state, set];
 718: }

 855: function SearchSelect({ value, onChange, options = [], placeholder = 'اختر…', error, disabled, loading: forceLoading, emptyText, multi, clearable = true, renderOption, asyncSim = false, searchPlaceholder = 'ابحث…' }) {
 856:   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

 866:     return () => clearTimeout(t);
 867:   }, [q, open]);
 868:   const isLoading = forceLoading || loading;
 869:   const list = options.filter((o) => !q || (o.label + ' ' + (o.sub || '')).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()));
 870:   const selected = multi ? options.filter((o) => (value || []).includes(o.value)) : options.find((o) => o.value === value);
 871:   const pick = (o) => {
 872:     if (multi) {
 873:       const cur = value || [];
 874:       onChange(cur.includes(o.value) ? cur.filter((v) => v !== o.value) : [...cur, o.value]);
 875:     } else { onChange(o.value); setOpen(false); setQ(''); }
 876:   };
 877:   const onKey = (e) => {

 879:     if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); setHi((h) => Math.max(h - 1, 0)); }
 880:     if (e.key === 'Enter' && list[hi]) { e.preventDefault(); pick(list[hi]); }
 881:     if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
 882:   };

 884:     <div className="relative" ref={ref}>

 886:         className={cx('v-input flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-start', open && 'is-focus', error && 'is-error', disabled && 'is-disabled', multi && selected.length && '!h-auto min-h-[42px] py-1.5')}>
 887:         <span className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
 888:           {multi ? (selected.length ? selected.map((s) => (
 889:             <span key={s.value} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 ps-2.5 pe-1 h-7 rounded-full text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-card)', border: '1px solid var(--border-field)' }}>
 890:               {s.label}
 891:               <span role="button" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); pick(s); }} className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full inline-flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-[var(--bg-subcard-hover)] t-3"><Icon name="x" size={11} /></span>
 892:             </span>
 893:           )) : <span className="t-3">{placeholder}</span>)
 894:             : selected ? <span className="truncate flex items-center gap-2">{selected.icon}{selected.label}{selected.sub && <span className="t-3 text-[11.5px]">· {selected.sub}</span>}</span>
 895:             : <span className="t-3">{placeholder}</span>}
 896:         </span>
 897:         {!multi && clearable && selected && !disabled && (
 898:           <span role="button" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onChange(null); }} className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full inline-flex items-center justify-center t-3 hover:bg-[var(--bg-subcard-hover)]"><Icon name="x" size={12} /></span>
 899:         )}
 900:         <Icon name="chevDown" size={14} className={cx('t-3 transition-transform', open && 'rotate-180')} />
 901:       </button>
 902:       {open && (
 903:         <div className="pop absolute z-40 mt-2 w-full v-card p-2" style={{ boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-pop)', borderRadius: 18 }}>
 904:           <div className="relative mb-1.5">
 905:             <Icon name="search" size={14} className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 start-3 t-3" />
 906:             <input autoFocus value={q} onChange={(e) => { setQ(e.target.value); setHi(0); }} onKeyDown={onKey} placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
 907:               className="w-full h-9 rounded-xl ps-9 pe-8 text-[12.5px] outline-none" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-subcard)', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }} />
 908:             {isLoading && <Spinner size={14} className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 end-3 t-acc" />}
 909:           </div>
 910:           <div className="max-h-[248px] overflow-y-auto">
 911:             {isLoading ? (
 912:               <div className="p-2 space-y-3">{[0, 1, 2].map((i) => <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2.5"><Skel w={22} h={22} r={8} /><Skel w={`${70 - i * 15}%`} h={10} /></div>)}</div>
 913:             ) : list.length === 0 ? (
 914:               <div className="py-6 px-3 text-center">
 915:                 <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full v-well mx-auto flex items-center justify-center mb-2"><Icon name="search" size={16} /></div>
 916:                 <div className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold t-1">{emptyText || 'لا توجد نتائج'}</div>

 918:               </div>
 919:             ) : list.map((o, i) => {
 920:               const sel = multi ? (value || []).includes(o.value) : o.value === value;
 921:               return (
 922:                 <button type="button" key={o.value} onMouseEnter={() => setHi(i)} onClick={() => !o.disabled && pick(o)} disabled={o.disabled}
 923:                   className={cx('w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-start text-[12.5px] transition', hi === i && 'bg-[var(--bg-subcard)]', o.disabled && 'opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed')}

 933:                 </button>

 937:         </div>
 938:       )}
 939:     </div>
 940:   );

 971: // Confirm with server-rejection state
 972: function ConfirmDialog({ open, onClose, title, message, confirmLabel = 'تأكيد', danger, onConfirm, serverError, icon }) {
 973:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
 974:   const [err, setErr] = useState(null);
 975:   useEffect(() => { if (open) { setErr(null); setBusy(false); } }, [open]);
 976:   const go = async () => {
 977:     setBusy(true); setErr(null);
 978:     if (serverError) { setErr(serverError); setBusy(false); return; }
 979:     try { await onConfirm?.(); onClose(); }
 980:     catch(e){setErr({title:'تعذّر إتمام العملية',body:normalizeError(e).message});}
 981:     finally{setBusy(false);}
 982:   };
 983:   return (
 984:     <Modal open={open} onClose={busy ? null : onClose} title={title} subtitle={message} icon={icon || (danger ? 'trash' : 'alert')} iconTone={danger ? 'red' : 'amber'}>
 985:       {err && (
 986:         <div className="pop rounded-2xl p-3.5 mb-1 flex gap-3 b-red">
 987:           <Icon name="ban" size={17} className="mt-0.5" />
 988:           <div className="text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed">
 989:             <div className="font-semibold">{err.title}</div>
 990:             <div className="opacity-90 mt-0.5">{err.body}</div>
 991:             {err.items && <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1">{err.items.map((i) => <li key={i} className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-current" />{i}</li>)}</ul>}
 992:           </div>
 993:         </div>
 994:       )}
 995:       <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 mt-3">
 996:         <button className="btn btn-soft" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>{err ? 'إغلاق' : 'إلغاء'}</button>
 997:         {!err && <button className={cx('btn', danger ? 'btn-acc' : 'btn-ink')} style={danger ? { background: 'var(--badge-red-text)', boxShadow: 'none' } : null} onClick={go} disabled={busy}>
 998:           {busy && <Spinner size={14} />}{confirmLabel}
 999:         </button>}
1000:       </div>
1001:     </Modal>
1002:   );
1003: }

1075: /* ---------------- Pagination (server meta) ---------------- */
1076: function Pagination({ meta, onPage, onPerPage }) {
1077:   const { current_page: p, last_page: last, per_page, total, from, to } = meta;
1078:   const pages = [];
1079:   for (let i = 1; i <= last; i++) if (i === 1 || i === last || Math.abs(i - p) <= 1) pages.push(i); else if (pages[pages.length - 1] !== '…') pages.push('…');
1080:   return (
1081:     <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 px-5 py-3.5 v-border-t">
1082:       <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[12px] t-2">
1083:         <span>عرض <b className="t-1 num">{from}–{to}</b> من <b className="t-1 num">{total}</b></span>
1084:         <span className="w-px h-4" style={{ background: 'var(--divider-color)' }} />
1085:         <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">لكل صفحة
1086:           <select value={per_page} onChange={(e) => onPerPage(+e.target.value)} className="h-8 rounded-full px-2.5 text-[12px] font-semibold outline-none" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-subcard)', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
1087:             {[10, 15, 25, 50].map((n) => <option key={n} value={n}>{n}</option>)}
1088:           </select>
1089:         </span>
1090:       </div>
1091:       <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
1092:         <button className="icon-btn" disabled={p <= 1} onClick={() => onPage(p - 1)} style={{ opacity: p <= 1 ? .35 : 1 }}><Icon name="chevRight" size={15} /></button>
1093:         {pages.map((n, i) => n === '…' ? <span key={i} className="w-8 text-center t-3 text-[12px]">…</span> : (
1094:           <button key={i} onClick={() => onPage(n)} className={cx('min-w-[32px] h-8 px-2 rounded-full text-[12px] font-semibold num transition', n === p ? 'bg-ink' : 't-2 hover:bg-[var(--bg-subcard)]')}>{n}</button>
1095:         ))}
1096:         <button className="icon-btn" disabled={p >= last} onClick={() => onPage(p + 1)} style={{ opacity: p >= last ? .35 : 1 }}><Icon name="chevLeft" size={15} /></button>
1097:       </div>
1098:     </div>
1099:   );
1100: }

1102: /* ---------------- DataTable ---------------- */
1103: function DataTable({ error, columns, rows, state = 'ready', meta, onPage, onPerPage, onRetry, empty, toolbar, rowKey = 'id', onRowClick, skeletonRows = 6, filtered }) {
1104:   return (
1105:     <div className="v-card overflow-hidden">
1106:       {toolbar && <div className="p-4 v-border-b">{toolbar}</div>}
1107:       {state === 'error' ? <ErrorState onRetry={onRetry} title={error?.message} /> :
1108:        state === 'empty' || (state === 'ready' && rows.length === 0) ? (empty || <EmptyState title={filtered ? 'لا نتائج مطابقة للفلاتر' : 'لا توجد بيانات بعد'} body={filtered ? 'جرّب تعديل البحث أو إزالة بعض الفلاتر.' : null} />) : (
1109:         <div className="overflow-x-auto">
1110:           <table className="v-table">
1111:             <thead><tr>{columns.map((c) => <th key={c.key} style={{ width: c.width, textAlign: c.align }}>{c.label}</th>)}</tr></thead>
1112:             <tbody>
1113:               {state === 'loading' ? Array.from({ length: skeletonRows }).map((_, i) => (
1114:                 <tr key={i}>{columns.map((c, j) => <td key={c.key}>{c.skel ? c.skel(i) : <Skel w={j === 0 ? '70%' : `${40 + ((i * 7 + j * 13) % 40)}%`} h={10} />}</td>)}</tr>
1115:               )) : rows.map((r, i) => (
1116:                 <tr key={r[rowKey]} onClick={() => onRowClick && onRowClick(r)} className={cx(onRowClick && 'cursor-pointer')}>
1117:                   {columns.map((c) => <td key={c.key} style={{ textAlign: c.align }}>{c.render ? c.render(r, i) : r[c.key]}</td>)}
1118:                 </tr>
1119:               ))}
1120:             </tbody>
1121:           </table>
1122:         </div>
1123:       )}
1124:       {meta && state !== 'error' && state !== 'empty' && rows.length > 0 && <Pagination meta={meta} onPage={onPage} onPerPage={onPerPage} />}
1125:       {meta && state === 'loading' && (
1126:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3.5 v-border-t"><Skel w={140} h={10} /><Skel w={160} h={26} r={999} /></div>

1128:     </div>

1237: /* ---------------- File upload tile ---------------- */
1238: // status: queued | uploading | done | failed
1239: function FileTile({ file, onRemove, onRetry, draggable, onDragStart, onDragOver, onDrop, index, primary, compact, children }) {
1240:   const st = file.status;
1241:   const [preview,setPreview]=useState(null);
1242:   useEffect(()=>{if(!file.file)return;const url=URL.createObjectURL(file.file);setPreview(url);return ()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url);},[file.file]);
1243:   return (
1244:     <div draggable={draggable} onDragStart={onDragStart} onDragOver={onDragOver} onDrop={onDrop}
1245:       className={cx('group relative rounded-[16px] overflow-hidden transition', draggable && 'cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing', st === 'failed' && 'ring-2 ring-[var(--badge-red-text)]')}
1246:       style={{ background: 'var(--bg-subcard)' }}>
1247:       <div className={cx('relative', compact ? 'aspect-square' : 'aspect-[4/3]')}>
1248:         <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ background: (file.url || preview) ? 'url("'+(file.url || preview)+'") center / cover' : (file.bg || 'var(--bg-subcard)') }} />
1249:         <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center" style={{ color: 'rgba(24,21,28,.28)' }}><Icon name={file.kind === 'video' ? 'video' : 'image'} size={compact ? 20 : 26} /></div>
1250:         {st === 'uploading' && <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/25 flex items-center justify-center"><span className="text-white text-[13px] font-bold num">{file.progress}%</span></div>}
1251:         {st === 'failed' && <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center" style={{ background: 'rgba(225,29,72,.18)' }}><Icon name="alertCircle" size={24} style={{ color: '#e11d48' }} /></div>}
1252:         {st === 'queued' && <span className="absolute top-2 start-2 text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/90 text-[#78737e]">بانتظار الحفظ</span>}
1253:         {primary && <span className="absolute top-2 start-2 text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-acc">الرئيسية</span>}
1254:         {index != null && <span className="absolute bottom-2 start-2 w-6 h-6 rounded-full text-[10.5px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center bg-white/90 text-[#18151c] num">{index}</span>}
1255:         <div className="absolute top-2 end-2 flex gap-1 opacity-100 sm:opacity-0 sm:group-hover:opacity-100 focus-within:opacity-100 transition">
1256:           {draggable && <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-white/90 text-[#18151c] flex items-center justify-center"><Icon name="drag" size={13} /></span>}
1257:           {onRemove && <button onClick={onRemove} className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-white/90 text-[#e11d48] flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-white"><Icon name="trash" size={13} /></button>}
1258:         </div>
1259:       </div>
1260:       {!compact && (
1261:         <div className="px-3 py-2.5">
1262:           <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
1263:             <span className="text-[11.5px] font-medium t-1 truncate ltr">{file.name}</span>
1264:             <span className="text-[10.5px] t-3 num shrink-0">{file.size}</span>
1265:           </div>
1266:           {st === 'uploading' && <div className="mt-2 h-1.5 rounded-full hatched-track overflow-hidden"><div className="h-full rounded-full progress-live transition-all" style={{ width: file.progress + '%' }} /></div>}
1267:           {st === 'failed' && (
1268:             <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
1269:               <span className="text-[10.5px] font-medium truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }}>{file.message || file.error || 'فشل الرفع'}</span>
1270:               {onRetry && <button onClick={onRetry} className="text-[11px] font-semibold t-acc flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0"><Icon name="refresh" size={11} />إعادة</button>}
1271:             </div>
1272:           )}
1273:           {st === 'done' && <div className="mt-1 text-[10.5px] font-medium flex items-center gap-1" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-green-text)' }}><Icon name="checkCircle" size={11} />تم الرفع</div>}
1274:           {children}
1275:         </div>
1276:       )}
1277:     </div>
1278:   );
1279: }

1317: // Product form — Variants & pricing tab
1318: const PRESET_COLORS = [
1319:   { ar: 'رمادي فحمي', en: 'Charcoal', hex: '#3d3a40' }, { ar: 'بيج', en: 'Beige', hex: '#d8c6a8' },
1320:   { ar: 'أزرق نيلي', en: 'Navy', hex: '#24324f' }, { ar: 'أخضر زيتي', en: 'Olive', hex: '#6b6b3f' },
1321:   { ar: 'تيراكوتا', en: 'Terracotta', hex: '#c65f3c' }, { ar: 'أبيض عاجي', en: 'Ivory', hex: '#f3ede2' },
1322: ];
1323: const vKey = (c, s, cap) => [(c && c.en || '').trim().toLowerCase(), (s || '').trim().toLowerCase(), (cap || '').trim().toLowerCase()].join('|');
1324: const priceOk = (x, decimals = 2) => x === '' || x == null || new RegExp(`^\\d+(\\.\\d{1,${decimals}})?$`).test(String(x));
1325: 
1326: function emptyVariant(c, s, cap, i) {
1327:   return { _id: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2), color: c || null, size: s || '', capacity: cap || '', sku: '', barcode: '', retail: '', wholesale: '', cost: '', compare: '', weight: '', reorder: '', order: i + 1, status: 'active',  };
1328: }
1329: 
1330: function validateVariants(rows, channel, mode, requirePrices = true) {
1331:   const errs = {}; const seen = {}; const skus=new Set(),barcodes=new Set();
1332:   rows.forEach((r, i) => {
1333:     const e = {};
1334:     if (r.color && (r.color.ar || r.color.hex) && !r.color.en) e.color_en = 'الاسم الإنجليزي للون مطلوب';
1335:     ['retail', 'wholesale', 'cost', 'compare'].forEach((k) => { const decimals=k==='cost'?4:2; if (!priceOk(r[k],decimals) || Number(r[k])>9999999) e[k] = k==='cost'?'أربع خانات عشرية بحد أقصى':'منزلتين عشريتين بحد أقصى'; });
1336:     if (requirePrices && r.status === 'active') {
1337:       if ((channel === 'retail' || channel === 'both') && !r.retail) e.retail = 'سعر التجزئة مطلوب';
1338:       if ((channel === 'wholesale' || channel === 'both') && !r.wholesale) e.wholesale = 'سعر الجملة مطلوب';
1339:     }
1340:     if (r.compare && r.retail && +r.compare <= +r.retail) e.compare = 'لازم يكون أعلى من سعر التجزئة';
1341:     const k = vKey(r.color, r.size, r.capacity);

1352: function ChipInput({ values, onChange, placeholder, suggestions = [], ltr }) {
1353:   const [t, setT] = useState('');
1354:   const add = (x) => { x = x.trim(); if (x && !values.includes(x)) onChange([...values, x]); setT(''); };
1355:   return (
1356:     <div>
1357:       <div className="v-input !h-auto min-h-[42px] flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 py-1.5 !px-2">
1358:         {values.map((v) => (
1359:           <span key={v} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 ps-2.5 pe-1 h-7 rounded-full text-[12px] font-semibold" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-card)', border: '1px solid var(--border-field)' }}>
1360:             <span className={ltr ? 'ltr' : ''}>{v}</span>
1361:             <button onClick={() => onChange(values.filter((x) => x !== v))} className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full inline-flex items-center justify-center t-3 hover:bg-[var(--bg-subcard-hover)]"><Icon name="x" size={11} /></button>
1362:           </span>
1363:         ))}
1364:         <input value={t} onChange={(e) => setT(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ',') { e.preventDefault(); add(t); } if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !t && values.length) onChange(values.slice(0, -1)); }}
1365:           placeholder={values.length ? '' : placeholder} className={cx('flex-1 min-w-[90px] h-7 bg-transparent outline-none text-[12.5px] px-1.5', ltr && 'ltr')} style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }} />
1366:       </div>
1367:       {suggestions.filter((s) => !values.includes(s)).length > 0 && (
1368:         <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-2">{suggestions.filter((s) => !values.includes(s)).map((s) => <button key={s} onClick={() => add(s)} className="h-6 px-2 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium v-well hover:t-1 flex items-center gap-1"><Icon name="plus" size={10} /><span className={ltr ? 'ltr' : ''}>{s}</span></button>)}</div>
1369:       )}
1370:     </div>
1371:   );
1372: }

1374: function ColorAxis({ colors, onChange }) {

1379:     if (colors.some((x) => x.en.toLowerCase() === c.en.toLowerCase())) { setErr('اللون موجود بالفعل'); return; }

1387:             <Swatch c={c.hex} size={22} />{c.ar}<span className="t-3 font-medium ltr">{c.en}</span>
1388:             <button onClick={() => onChange(colors.filter((x) => x !== c))} className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full inline-flex items-center justify-center t-3 hover:bg-[var(--bg-subcard)]"><Icon name="x" size={11} /></button>
1389:           </span>
1390:         ))}
1391:       </div>

1397:         <input className={cx('v-input ltr flex-1', err && 'is-error')} placeholder="Color name (EN) *" value={draft.en} onChange={(e) => { setDraft({ ...draft, en: e.target.value }); setErr(null); }} onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && add(draft)} />
1398:         <button className="btn btn-soft !h-[42px] !rounded-[13px]" onClick={() => add(draft)}><Icon name="plus" size={14} /></button>

1401:       <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-2">{PRESET_COLORS.filter((p) => !colors.some((c) => c.en === p.en)).map((p) => (

1403:       ))}</div>
1404:     </div>
1405:   );

1423:

1427:     const ps = axes.capacities.length ? axes.capacities : [''];

1433:     })));

1633: function LoadedProduct({id,can}) {
1634:  const query=useApi(sig=>Promise.all([productsApi.show(Number(id),sig),productMediaApi.list(Number(id))]),[id]);
1635:  if(query.loading) return <Spinner />;
1636:  if(query.error?.status===404)return <EmptyState title="المنتج غير موجود" action={<button className="btn btn-ink" onClick={()=>nav('/products')}>العودة للمنتجات</button>}/>;
1637:  if(query.error?.status===403)return <Forbidden perm="products.view"/>;
1638:  if(query.error) return <ErrorState title={query.error.message} onRetry={query.reload} />;
1639:  const initial={...productFromApi(query.data[0],query.data[1],{canViewCost:can('products.view_cost')}),id:Number(id)};
1640:  return <ProductForm id={id} initial={initial}/>;
1641: }
1642: export function CatalogReference({can,page,isDark = false}) {
1643:  const route=useRoute();
1644:  const lookups=useApi(async sig=>{const categories=page==='products' && can('categories.view')?await categoriesApi.tree(sig):[];return {categories};},[can,page]);
1645:  const categories=(lookups.data?.categories||[]).map(function map(c){return {...c,ar:c.name_ar,en:c.name_en,status:c.is_active?'active':'inactive',children:(c.children||[]).map(map)};});
1646:  const permission=page==='dealers'?'customers.view':page==='production'?'inventory.view':'products.view';
1647:  return <AppCtx.Provider value={{user:{can},screenState:'ready',categories}}><div className={"catalog-surface " + (isDark ? "theme-dark" : "theme-light")} dir="rtl" lang="ar"><div className="p-4 sm:p-6">{!can(permission)?<Forbidden perm={permission}/>:lookups.error?<ErrorState onRetry={lookups.reload}/>:lookups.loading?<Spinner/>:page==='dealers'?<DealersPage/>:page==='production'?<ProductionPage/>:route.parts[1]==='new'?(can('products.create')?<ProductForm id="new"/>:<Forbidden perm="products.create"/>):route.parts[1]?<LoadedProduct id={route.parts[1]} can={can}/>:<ProductsPage/>}</div><ToastHost/></div></AppCtx.Provider>;
1648: }
1649: 
1650: export { useApp, useQueryState, PageHeader, DataTable, SearchBox, FilterMenu, EmptyState, Drawer, Field, Input, SectionCard, Banner, SearchSelect, ErrorState, Spinner, Badge, vtoast, ConfirmDialog };

17: export function parseApiError(err) {
18:   const status = err?.response?.status ?? 0;
19:   const data = err?.response?.data ?? {};
20:   const fieldErrors = {};
21:   Object.entries(data.errors ?? {}).forEach(([k, msgs]) => {
22:     const key = FIELD_MAP[k] ?? (k.startsWith('items') ? 'items' : k);
23:     fieldErrors[key] = Array.isArray(msgs) ? msgs[0] : String(msgs);
24:   });
25:   return {
26:     status,
27:     message: data.message || FALLBACK[status] || FALLBACK[500],
28:     fieldErrors,
29:     isValidation: status === 422 && Object.keys(fieldErrors).length > 0,
30:   };
31: }

40:   };

45: 
46: // Normalize positions only in sibling groups that actually moved. Existing sort
47: // values may be sparse; comparing indexes alone can insert a moved node first.
48: export function buildReorderItems(tree, savedTree) {
49:   const groups = (nodes, out = new Map(), parentId = null) => {
50:     out.set(parentId, nodes);
51:     nodes.forEach((n) => groups(n.children || [], out, n.id));
52:     return out;
53:   };
54:   const before = groups(savedTree);
55:   const original = new Map();
56:   before.forEach((nodes, parentId) => nodes.forEach((n) => original.set(n.id, { parentId, order: n.order })));
57:   const items = [];
58:   groups(tree).forEach((nodes, parentId) => {
59:     const previous = before.get(parentId) || [];
60:     if (nodes.length === previous.length && nodes.every((n, i) => n.id === previous[i].id)) return;
61:     nodes.forEach((n, index) => {
62:       const old = original.get(n.id);
63:       if (!old || old.parentId !== parentId || old.order !== index) {
64:         items.push({ id: n.id, parent_id: parentId, sort_order: index });
65:       }
66:     });
67:   });
68:   return items;
69: }

118:

129: /* Buttons */
130: .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; transition: opacity .15s, transform .1s, background-color .15s; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent; }
131: .btn:active { transform: scale(.98); }
132: .btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }
133: .btn-sm { height: 32px; padding: 0 13px; font-size: 12px; gap: 6px; }

136: .btn-ink:hover { opacity: .9; }

138: .btn-acc:hover { opacity: .92; }
139: .btn-soft { background: var(--bg-subcard); color: var(--text-primary); }
140: .btn-soft:hover { background: var(--bg-subcard-hover); }
141: .btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); }
142: .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bg-subcard); color: var(--text-primary); }
143: .btn-danger { background: var(--badge-red-bg); color: var(--badge-red-text); }
144: .btn-outline { background: var(--bg-card); border-color: var(--border-field); color: var(--text-primary); }
145: .btn-outline:hover { background: var(--bg-subcard); }
146: .icon-btn { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--text-secondary); transition: background .15s, color .15s; }
147: .icon-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-subcard); color: var(--text-primary); }
148: 
149: /* Segmented */
150: .seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-subcard); gap: 2px; }

152: .seg > button.on { background: var(--seg-active-bg); color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }
153:

155: .tgl { width: 42px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px; display: flex; align-items: center; background: var(--toggle-off-bg); transition: background .2s; flex-shrink: 0; }
156: .tgl > span { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.2); transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); }
157: .tgl.on { background: var(--accent); }

161:

163: .chk { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border-field); background: var(--bg-card); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; flex-shrink: 0; transition: all .15s; }
164: .chk.on { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }

171: .v-table tbody tr { transition: background .12s; }

174: 
175: /* Skeleton */

177: .skel { border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bg-subcard) 0%, var(--bg-subcard-hover) 50%, var(--bg-subcard) 100%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: shimmer 1.4s infinite linear; }

182: .s1 { animation-delay: .03s; } .s2 { animation-delay: .09s; } .s3 { animation-delay: .15s; } .s4 { animation-delay: .21s; } .s5 { animation-delay: .27s; }
183: @keyframes popIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px) scale(.98); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
184: .pop { animation: popIn .22s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both; }
185: @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
186: .fade { animation: fadeIn .2s ease both; }

188: .spin { animation: spin .8s linear infinite; }

190: .progress-live { background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--accent) 0, var(--accent) 5px, var(--accent-2) 5px, var(--accent-2) 10px); background-size: 20px 100%; animation: stripe .6s linear infinite; }
191:

193: .drawer { animation: drawerIn .32s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both; }

197: ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(150,145,160,.3); border-radius: 999px; }
198:

200: .dropzone:hover, .dropzone.over { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
201: 
202: .checker { background-color: var(--bg-subcard); background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--bg-subcard-hover) 25%, transparent 25%), linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--bg-subcard-hover) 25%, transparent 25%), linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 75%, var(--bg-subcard-hover) 75%), linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent 75%, var(--bg-subcard-hover) 75%); background-size: 14px 14px; background-position: 0 0, 0 7px, 7px -7px, -7px 0; }
203: 
204: .focus-ring:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-light); }
205: .text-pretty { text-wrap: pretty; }
206: kbd { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-field); border-bottom-width: 2px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
207: :host { all: initial; display: block; direction: rtl; min-width: 0; }
208: .categories-surface { direction: rtl; padding: 28px 32px 48px; min-height: calc(100vh - 58px); font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.5; }
209: .categories-surface > .space-y-5 > .grid > * { min-width: 0; }
210: .categories-surface[data-embedded] { padding: 0; min-height: 0; background: transparent; }

248: function ConfirmDialog({ open, onClose, title, message, confirmLabel = 'تأكيد', danger, onConfirm, serverError, icon, extra }) {
249:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
250:   const [err, setErr] = useState(null);
251:   useEffect(() => { if (open) { setErr(serverError || null); setBusy(false); } }, [open]);
252:   const go = async () => {
253:     setBusy(true); setErr(null);
254:     try {
255:       if (serverError) { setErr(serverError); return; }
256:       if (onConfirm) await onConfirm();
257:       onClose();
258:     } catch (e) {
259:       setErr(e?.title ? e : { title: 'تعذّر تنفيذ العملية', body: e?.message || String(e), items: e?.items || [] });
260:     } finally {
261:       setBusy(false);
262:     }
263:   };
264:   return (
265:     <Modal open={open} onClose={busy ? null : onClose} title={title} subtitle={message} icon={icon || (danger ? 'trash' : 'alert')} iconTone={danger ? 'red' : 'amber'}>
266:       {err && (
267:         <div className="pop rounded-2xl p-3.5 mb-1 flex gap-3 b-red">
268:           <Icon name="ban" size={17} className="mt-0.5" />
269:           <div className="text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed">
270:             <div className="font-semibold">{err.title}</div>
271:             <div className="opacity-90 mt-0.5">{err.body}</div>
272:             {err.items && <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1">{err.items.map((i) => <li key={i} className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-current" />{i}</li>)}</ul>}
273:           </div>
274:         </div>
275:       )}
276:       {extra}
277:       <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 mt-3">
278:         <button className="btn btn-soft" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>{err ? 'إغلاق' : 'إلغاء'}</button>
279:         {!err && <button className={cx('btn', danger ? 'btn-acc' : 'btn-ink')} style={danger ? { background: 'var(--badge-red-text)', boxShadow: 'none' } : null} onClick={go} disabled={busy}>
280:           {busy && <Spinner size={14} />}{confirmLabel}
281:         </button>}
282:       </div>
283:     </Modal>
284:   );
285: }

354: function ImageField({ value, onFile, onRemove, onChecking, progress, error, disabled, rules = ['JPG · PNG · WebP', 'حتى 4MB', 'حتى 16 ميجابكسل', 'SVG غير مقبول'], shape = 'square', label = 'رفع صورة' }) {
355:   const inputRef = useRef(null);
356:   const pendingUrl = useRef(null);
357:   const selection = useRef(0);
358:   const [localErr, setLocalErr] = useState(null);
359:   useEffect(() => () => {
360:     selection.current++;
361:     if (pendingUrl.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(pendingUrl.current);
362:     onChecking?.(false);
363:   }, [onChecking]);
364:   const uploading = typeof progress === 'number';
365:   const state = uploading ? 'uploading' : (value ? 'done' : 'empty');
366:   const pick = () => { if (!disabled) inputRef.current?.click(); };
367:   const onPick = (e) => {
368:     const file = e.target.files?.[0];
369:     e.target.value = '';
370:     if (!file) return;
371:     const current = ++selection.current;
372:     if (pendingUrl.current) { URL.revokeObjectURL(pendingUrl.current); pendingUrl.current = null; }
373:     onChecking?.(false);
374:     const okTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'];
375:     if (!okTypes.includes(file.type)) { setLocalErr('صيغة غير مدعومة'); return; }
376:     if (file.size > 4 * 1024 * 1024) { setLocalErr('الحجم أكبر من 4MB'); return; }
377:     const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
378:     onChecking?.(true);
379:     pendingUrl.current = url;
380:     const img = new window.Image();
381:     img.onload = () => {
382:       if (current !== selection.current) return;
383:       pendingUrl.current = null;
384:       onChecking?.(false);
385:       if (img.naturalWidth * img.naturalHeight > 16000000) {
386:         URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
387:         setLocalErr('الصورة تتجاوز 16 ميجابكسل');
388:         return;
389:       }
390:       setLocalErr(null);
391:       onFile && onFile(file, url);
392:     };
393:     img.onerror = () => {
394:       if (current !== selection.current) return;
395:       pendingUrl.current = null;
396:       onChecking?.(false);
397:       URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
398:       setLocalErr('تعذّر قراءة الصورة');
399:     };
400:     img.src = url;
401:   };
402:   const r = shape === 'circle' ? 999 : 18;
403:   return (
404:     <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
405:       <input ref={inputRef} type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" className="hidden" onChange={onPick} />
406:       <div className="relative w-[88px] h-[88px] shrink-0 overflow-hidden checker" style={{ borderRadius: r }}>
407:         {state === 'done' && <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ background: value }} />}
408:         {state === 'empty' && <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center t-3"><Icon name="image" size={22} /></div>}
409:         {state === 'uploading' && <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5"><Spinner size={18} className="t-acc" /><span className="text-[10.5px] font-bold num t-2">{progress}%</span></div>}
410:       </div>
411:       <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
412:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
413:           <button type="button" className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" onClick={pick} disabled={disabled}><Icon name="upload" size={13} />{state === 'done' ? 'تغيير' : label}</button>
414:           {state === 'done' && <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" disabled={disabled} style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }} onClick={() => { onRemove && onRemove(); }}><Icon name="trash" size={13} />إزالة</button>}
415:         </div>
416:         <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-2.5">{rules.map((x) => <span key={x} className="text-[10.5px] font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full v-well">{x}</span>)}</div>
417:         {(localErr || error) && <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-[11.5px] font-medium mt-1.5" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }}><Icon name="alertCircle" size={13} className="mt-[1px]" /><span>{localErr || error}</span></div>}
418:       </div>
419:     </div>
420:   );
421: }

437: const MAX_DEPTH = 3;
438: 
439: function treeDepth(n) { return 1 + Math.max(0, ...(n.children || []).map(treeDepth)); }
440: 
441: function findNode(nodes, id, parent = null, depth = 1) {
442:   for (const n of nodes) {
443:     if (n.id === id) return { node: n, parent, depth };
444:     const r = findNode(n.children || [], id, n, depth + 1); if (r) return r;
445:   }
446:   return null;
447: }
448: 
449: function isDescendant(node, id) { return (node.children || []).some((c) => c.id === id || isDescendant(c, id)); }
450: 
451: function removeNode(nodes, id) { return nodes.filter((n) => n.id !== id).map((n) => ({ ...n, children: removeNode(n.children || [], id) })); }
452: 
453: function insertInto(nodes, parentId, node) {
454:   if (parentId == null) return [...nodes, node];
455:   return nodes.map((n) => n.id === parentId ? { ...n, children: [...(n.children || []), node] } : { ...n, children: insertInto(n.children || [], parentId, node) });
456: }
457: 
458: function sumProducts(n) { return (n.products || 0) + (n.children || []).reduce((a, c) => a + sumProducts(c), 0); }

460: export function CategoriesReferencePage() {
461:   const { perms } = useApp();
462:   const { phase, tree, setTree, saved, setSaved, error, reload } = useCategoriesTree(perms.view);
463:   const initialized = useRef(false);
464:   const [open, setOpen] = useState({});
465:   const [sel, setSel] = useState(null);
466:   const [drag, setDrag] = useState(null);
467:   const [over, setOver] = useState(null);
468:   const [invalid, setInvalid] = useState(null);
469:   const [form, setForm] = useState(null);
470:   const [del, setDel] = useState(null);
471:   const [disable, setDisable] = useState(null);
472:   const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
473:   const [savingOrder, setSavingOrder] = useState(false);
474:   useEffect(() => {
475:     if (phase !== 'ready' || !tree.length) return;
476:     if (!initialized.current) {
477:       initialized.current = true;
478:       const ids = {};
479:       const walk = (nodes) => nodes.forEach((n) => { ids[n.id] = true; walk(n.children || []); });
480:       walk(tree);
481:       setOpen(ids);
482:     }
483:   }, [phase, tree]);
484:   useEffect(() => {
485:     if (sel && !findNode(tree, sel)) setSel(null);
486:   }, [tree, sel]);
487:   if (!perms.view) return <Forbidden perm="categories.view" />;
488:   const dirty = JSON.stringify(tree) !== JSON.stringify(saved);
489:   const lockMsg = 'احفظ الترتيب أو ألغيه الأول';
490:   const canCreate = perms.create && !dirty && !savingOrder;
491:   const canUpdate = perms.update && !dirty && !savingOrder;
492:   const canDelete = perms.delete && !dirty && !savingOrder;
493: 
494:   const canDropInto = (dragId, targetId) => {
495:     if (dragId === targetId) return { ok: false, why: 'لا يمكن نقل القسم داخل نفسه' };
496:     const d = findNode(tree, dragId); if (!d) return { ok: false };
497:     if (targetId != null) {
498:       if (isDescendant(d.node, targetId)) return { ok: false, why: 'لا يمكن نقل القسم داخل أحد أقسامه الفرعية' };
499:       const t = findNode(tree, targetId);
500:       if (t.depth + treeDepth(d.node) > MAX_DEPTH) return { ok: false, why: `النقل هنا يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${MAX_DEPTH} مستويات)` };
501:     }
502:     return { ok: true };
503:   };
504:   const doMove = (dragId, targetId) => {
505:     if (!perms.update || savingOrder) return;
506:     const current = findNode(tree, dragId);
507:     if (!current || (current.parent?.id ?? null) === targetId) return;
508:     const chk = canDropInto(dragId, targetId);
509:     if (!chk.ok) { vtoast(chk.why, 'error'); return; }
510:     const d = findNode(tree, dragId);
511:     setTree(insertInto(removeNode(tree, dragId), targetId, d.node));
512:     if (targetId) setOpen({ ...open, [targetId]: true });
513:   };
514: 
515:   const selected = sel && findNode(tree, sel);
516:   const flat = flattenCats(tree);
517:   const matches = (n) => {
518:     if (!search) return true;
519:     const q = normalizeSearch(search);
520:     return normalizeSearch(n.ar).includes(q) || normalizeSearch(n.en).includes(q) || (n.children || []).some(matches);
521:   };
522:   const saveOrder = async () => {
523:     const items = buildReorderItems(tree, saved);
524:     if (!items.length) { setSaved(tree); return; }
525:     if (items.length > 500) { vtoast('تغييرات كتير مرة واحدة، احفظ على دفعات'); return; }
526:     setSavingOrder(true);
527:     try {
528:       await categoriesApi.reorder(items);
529:       vtoast('تم حفظ الترتيب');
530:       await reload({ silent: true });
531:     } catch (e) {
532:       const p = parseApiError(e);
533:       vtoast(p.message);
534:     } finally {
535:       setSavingOrder(false);
536:     }
537:   };
538: 
539:   const renderNode = (n, depth) => {
540:     const has = (n.children || []).length > 0;
541:     const isOpen = open[n.id] || !!search;
542:     const chk = drag != null && over === n.id ? canDropInto(drag, n.id) : null;
543:     if (!matches(n)) return null;
544:     return (
545:       <div key={n.id}>
546:         <div data-category-id={n.id} draggable={perms.update && !savingOrder} onDragStart={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move'; e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(n.id)); setDrag(n.id); }} onDragEnd={() => { setDrag(null); setOver(null); setInvalid(null); }}
547:           onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); if (over !== n.id) { setOver(n.id); const c = canDropInto(drag, n.id); setInvalid(c.ok ? null : c.why); } }}
548:           onDrop={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); doMove(drag, n.id); setDrag(null); setOver(null); setInvalid(null); }}
549:           onClick={() => setSel(n.id)}
550:           className={cx('group flex items-center gap-2 h-12 pe-2 rounded-[14px] cursor-pointer transition relative',
551:             sel === n.id ? 'bg-[var(--bg-subcard)]' : 'hover:bg-[var(--bg-subcard)]',
552:             drag === n.id && 'opacity-40',
553:             chk && (chk.ok ? 'ring-2 ring-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent-soft)]' : 'ring-2 ring-[var(--badge-red-text)] bg-[var(--badge-red-bg)]'))}
554:           style={{ paddingInlineStart: 8 + (depth - 1) * 26 }}>
555:           {depth > 1 && <span className="absolute top-0 bottom-1/2 w-3 border-b border-s rounded-es-lg" style={{ insetInlineStart: (depth - 1) * 26 - 10, borderColor: 'var(--border-field)' }} />}
556:           {perms.update && <span className="t-3 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 cursor-grab"><Icon name="drag" size={14} /></span>}
557:           <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setOpen({ ...open, [n.id]: !isOpen }); }} className={cx('w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center t-3 hover:bg-[var(--bg-card)]', !has && 'invisible')}>
558:             <Icon name="chevLeft" size={13} className={cx('transition', isOpen && '-rotate-90')} />
559:           </button>
560:           <span className={cx('w-8 h-8 rounded-[10px] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0', depth === 1 ? '' : 'v-well')} style={depth === 1 ? { background: n.img || IMG[0] } : null}>
561:             {depth > 1 && <Icon name={has ? (isOpen ? 'folderOpen' : 'folder') : 'tag'} size={14} />}
562:           </span>
563:           <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
564:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><span className={cx('text-[13px] truncate', depth === 1 ? 'font-semibold t-1' : 'font-medium t-1', n.status === 'inactive' && 'opacity-50')}><bdi>{displayName(n, 'ar')}</bdi></span>{n.status === 'inactive' && <Badge className="!py-0 !text-[10px]">غير نشط</Badge>}</div>
565:             <div className="text-[11px] t-3 ltr text-end inline-block" dir="ltr">{n.en}</div>
566:           </div>
567:           <span className="text-[11px] t-3 num hidden sm:inline">{sumProducts(n)} منتج</span>
568:           <span className="text-[10px] font-bold w-5 h-5 rounded-full v-well flex items-center justify-center num">{depth}</span>
569:           {(perms.create || perms.update || perms.delete) && (
570:             <div className="flex items-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
571:               {perms.create && (depth < MAX_DEPTH
572:                 ? <button title={dirty ? lockMsg : 'إضافة قسم فرعي'} disabled={dirty} className={cx('icon-btn !w-8 !h-8', dirty && 'opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed')} onClick={() => canCreate && setForm({ parentId: n.id })}><Icon name="plus" size={14} /></button>
573:                 : <span title="الحد الأقصى ٣ مستويات" className="icon-btn !w-8 !h-8 opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed"><Icon name="plus" size={14} /></span>)}
574:               {perms.update && <button title={dirty ? lockMsg : 'تعديل'} disabled={dirty} className={cx('icon-btn !w-8 !h-8', dirty && 'opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed')} onClick={() => canUpdate && setForm(n)}><Icon name="edit" size={14} /></button>}
575:               {perms.delete && <button title={dirty ? lockMsg : 'حذف'} disabled={dirty} className={cx('icon-btn !w-8 !h-8', dirty && 'opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed')} onClick={() => canDelete && setDel(n)}><Icon name="trash" size={14} /></button>}
576:             </div>
577:           )}
578:         </div>
579:         {chk && !chk.ok && <div className="pop text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 my-1" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)', paddingInlineStart: 40 + (depth - 1) * 26 }}><Icon name="ban" size={12} />{chk.why}</div>}
580:         {has && isOpen && <div className="mt-0.5 space-y-0.5">{n.children.map((c) => renderNode(c, depth + 1))}</div>}
581:       </div>
582:     );
583:   };
584: 
585:   return (
586:     <div className="space-y-5">

588:         actions={perms.create && <button className="btn btn-ink" title={dirty ? lockMsg : undefined} disabled={dirty} onClick={() => canCreate && setForm({ parentId: null })}><Icon name="plus" size={15} />قسم رئيسي</button>} />
589:       <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_340px] gap-5 items-start">

593:             <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">

595:               <button className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={() => setOpen({})}>طي الكل</button>

599:             : phase === 'error' ? <ErrorState onRetry={() => reload()} body={error?.message} />
600:             : phase === 'empty' ? <EmptyState icon="tree" title="لا توجد أقسام بعد" body="ابدأ بقسم رئيسي، وبعدها أضف أقسام فرعية لحد ٣ مستويات." action={perms.create && <button className="btn btn-ink" title={dirty ? lockMsg : undefined} disabled={dirty} onClick={() => canCreate && setForm({ parentId: null })}><Icon name="plus" size={15} />قسم رئيسي</button>} />
601:             : (

604:                 {drag != null && (

606:                     className={cx('pop mt-2 h-12 rounded-[14px] border-2 border-dashed flex items-center justify-center text-[12px] font-semibold', over === 'root' ? 'border-[var(--accent)] t-acc bg-[var(--accent-soft)]' : 'border-[var(--border-field)] t-3')}>
607:                     أفلت هنا لجعله قسمًا رئيسيًا
608:                   </div>
609:                 )}
610:               </div>
611:             )}
612:           <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mt-4 pt-3 px-1 v-border-t text-[11px] t-3">
613:             <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="w-3 h-3 rounded ring-2 ring-[var(--accent)]" />إفلات مسموح</span>
614:             <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="w-3 h-3 rounded ring-2 ring-[var(--badge-red-text)]" />إفلات غير مسموح</span>
615:             <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full v-well text-[9px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center">2</span>رقم المستوى</span>
616:           </div>

619:         {/* Detail / move-to panel */}

621:           {selected ? (

624:                 <span className="absolute bottom-3 start-4 text-[10.5px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/90 text-[#18151c]">المستوى {selected.depth}</span>

't-1 font-semibold' : ''}>{p}</span>{i < a.length - 1 && <Icon name="chevLeft" size={11} />}</React.Fragment>)}</div>
632:                 <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 mt-4">
633:                   <div className="v-subcard p-3"><div className="text-[11px] t-3">أقسام فرعية</div><div className="font-display text-[20px] font-bold t-1 num">{(selected.node.children || []).length}</div></div>
634:                   <div className="v-subcard p-3"><div className="text-[11px] t-3">منتجات</div><div className="font-display text-[20px] font-bold t-1 num">{sumProducts(selected.node)}</div></div>
635:                 </div>
636:                 {selected.node.createdAt && <div className="text-[11.5px] t-3 mt-2">{new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-EG', { dateStyle: 'medium' }).format(new Date(selected.node.createdAt))}</div>}
637:                 {perms.update && <>
638:                   <div className="mt-5"><Field label="نقل إلى" hint="بديل للسحب — الأقسام اللي تتجاوز الحد أو تقع داخل نفس الفرع غير متاحة.">
639:                     <SearchSelect value={selected.parent ? selected.parent.id : '__root'} clearable={false} asyncSim={false} disabled={savingOrder}
640:                       onChange={(pid) => doMove(sel, pid === '__root' ? null : pid)}
641:                       options={[{ value: '__root', label: 'بدون أب (قسم رئيسي)', depth: 0 }, ...flat.filter((f) => f.depth < MAX_DEPTH - 1 + 1).map((f) => {
642:                         const c = canDropInto(sel, f.id);
643:                         return { value: f.id, label: f.ar, depth: f.depth, disabled: !c.ok, note: !c.ok ? (f.id === sel ? 'نفسه' : c.why.includes('الحد') ? 'يتجاوز الحد' : 'فرعي منه') : null };
644:                       })]} />
645:                   </Field></div>
646:                   <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-4">
647:                     <button className="btn btn-soft flex-1" title={dirty ? lockMsg : undefined} disabled={dirty} onClick={() => canUpdate && setForm(selected.node)}><Icon name="edit" size={14} />تعديل</button>
648:                     <button className="btn btn-outline flex-1" title={dirty ? lockMsg : undefined} disabled={dirty} onClick={() => canUpdate && setDisable(selected.node)}>{selected.node.status === 'active' ? 'تعطيل' : 'تفعيل'}</button>
649:                   </div>
650:                 </>}
651:               </div>
652:             </div>
653:           ) : <div className="v-card"><EmptyState compact icon="tree" title="اختر قسمًا" body="لعرض تفاصيله ونقله." /></div>}
654:         </div>
655:       </div>
656: 
657:       {perms.update && dirty && <StickyBar dirty note="ترتيب الأقسام اتغيّر — التغييرات مش هتتبعت قبل الحفظ">
658:         <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={() => setTree(saved)} disabled={savingOrder}>إلغاء التغييرات</button>
659:         <button className="btn btn-ink" onClick={saveOrder} disabled={savingOrder}>{savingOrder && <Spinner size={14} />}حفظ الترتيب</button>
660:       </StickyBar>}

662:       <CategoryForm open={!!form} value={form} tree={tree} onClose={() => setForm(null)} onSaved={() => reload({ silent: true })} />
663:       <ConfirmDialog open={!!del} onClose={() => setDel(null)} danger title={<>حذف قسم «<bdi>{del && del.ar}</bdi>»؟</>} message="سيتم حذف القسم نهائيًا." confirmLabel="حذف القسم"
664:         serverError={del && ((del.children || []).length || sumProducts(del)) ? { title: 'لا يمكن حذف هذا القسم', body: 'القسم مرتبط بيانات لازم تتنقل الأول:', items: [(del.children || []).length && `${del.children.length} أقسام فرعية`, sumProducts(del) && `${sumProducts(del)} منتج مرتبط`].filter(Boolean) } : null}
665:         onConfirm={async () => {

676:       <ConfirmDialog open={!!disable} onClose={() => setDisable(null)} title={disable && disable.status === 'active' ? <>تعطيل «<bdi>{disable.ar}</bdi>»؟</> : <>تفعيل «<bdi>{disable && disable.ar}</bdi>»؟</>}
677:         message={disable && disable.status === 'active' ? 'القسم المعطل وأقسامه الفرعية مش هيظهروا في المتجر.' : 'سيظهر القسم في المتجر.'} icon="ban" confirmLabel={disable && disable.status === 'active' ? 'تعطيل' : 'تفعيل'}
678:         extra={disable && disable.status !== 'active' && findNode(tree, disable.id)?.parent?.status === 'inactive' ? <div className="text-[12px] t-2 mb-2">القسم مش هيظهر في المتجر طول ما القسم الأب معطّل</div> : null}
679:         onConfirm={async () => {

682:             vtoast(disable.status === 'active' ? 'تم تعطيل القسم' : 'تم تفعيل القسم');
683:             await reload({ silent: true });

688:         }} />
689:     </div>
