````javascript
693: const FORM_KEYS = ['ar', 'en', 'slug', 'desc_ar', 'desc_en', 'order', 'parentId', 'status', 'img'];
694: 
695: function CategoryForm({ open, value, tree, onClose, onSaved }) {
696:   const [v, setV] = useState({});
697:   const isEdit = Boolean(v.id);
698:   const [slugTouched, setSlugTouched] = useState(false);
699:   const [errs, setErrs] = useState({});
700:   const [lang, setLang] = useState('ar');
701:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
702:   const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(null);
703:   const [fileChecking, setFileChecking] = useState(false);
704:   const previewUrlRef = useRef(null);
705:   useEffect(() => {
706:     if (!open) {
707:       if (previewUrlRef.current) { URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrlRef.current); previewUrlRef.current = null; }
708:       return;
709:     }
710:     setBusy(false);
711:     setFileChecking(false);
712:     setUploadProgress(null);
713:     setErrs({});
714:     setLang('ar');
715:     if (previewUrlRef.current) { URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrlRef.current); previewUrlRef.current = null; }
716:     if (value && value.id) {
717:       const found = findNode(tree, value.id);
718:       setV({
719:         id: value.id,
720:         ar: value.ar || '',
721:         en: value.en || '',
722:         slug: value.slug || '',
723:         desc_ar: value.desc_ar || '',
724:         desc_en: value.desc_en || '',
725:         order: value.order ?? 0,
726:         status: value.status || 'active',
727:         parentId: value.parentId ?? found?.parent?.id ?? null,
728:         imageUrl: value.imageUrl,
729:         img: value.img,
730:         imageFile: null,
731:         imageRemoved: false,
732:         previewUrl: null,
733:       });
734:       setSlugTouched(true);
735:     } else {
736:       const parentId = value.parentId ?? value.parent ?? null;
737:       const siblings = parentId == null ? tree : (findNode(tree, parentId)?.node.children || []);
738:       setV({
739:         status: 'active',
740:         parentId,
741:         order: Math.max(-1, ...siblings.map((n) => Number(n.order) || 0)) + 1,
742:         ar: '', en: '', slug: '', desc_ar: '', desc_en: '',
743:         imageFile: null, imageRemoved: false, previewUrl: null, img: undefined, imageUrl: null,
744:       });
745:       setSlugTouched(false);
746:     }
747:   }, [open]);
748:   useEffect(() => () => { if (previewUrlRef.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrlRef.current); }, []);
749:   const generatedSlug = autoSlug(v.en);
750:   const flat = flattenCats(tree);
751:   const height = isEdit ? treeDepth(value) : 1;
752:   const parentName = v.parentId != null ? flat.find((f) => f.id === v.parentId)?.ar : null;
753:   const preview = v.previewUrl
754:     ? `url("${v.previewUrl}") center / cover no-repeat`
755:     : (v.imageRemoved ? null : (v.imageUrl ? `url("${v.imageUrl}") center / cover no-repeat` : v.img));
756:   const save = async () => {
757:     const e = {};
758:     if (!(v.ar || '').trim()) e.ar = 'الاسم العربي مطلوب';
759:     if (!(v.en || '').trim()) e.en = 'الاسم الإنجليزي مطلوب';
760:     if ((v.ar || '').length > 150) e.ar = 'الحد الأقصى 150 حرف';
761:     if ((v.en || '').length > 150) e.en = 'الحد الأقصى 150 حرف';
762:     const order = toLatinDigits(v.order ?? 0).trim();
763:     if (!/^\d+$/.test(order) || Number(order) > 2147483647) e.order = 'الترتيب يجب أن يكون عددًا صحيحًا من 0 إلى 2147483647';
764:     const slugVal = slugTouched ? v.slug : generatedSlug;
765:     if (v.slug && !/^[a-z0-9_-]+$/i.test(v.slug)) e.slug = 'حروف إنجليزي وأرقام و - فقط';
766:     setErrs(e);
767:     if (Object.keys(e).length) return;
768: 
769:     setBusy(true);
770:     setUploadProgress(v.imageFile ? 0 : null);
771:     try {
772:       const payload = toPayload({ ...v, slug: slugVal }, { isEdit });
773:       const onProgress = v.imageFile ? (pct) => setUploadProgress(pct) : undefined;
774:       if (isEdit) await categoriesApi.update(v.id, payload, onProgress);
775:       else await categoriesApi.create(payload, onProgress);
776:       vtoast(isEdit ? 'تم تحديث القسم' : 'تم إنشاء القسم');
777:       onSaved && onSaved();
778:       onClose();
779:     } catch (err) {
780:       const savedId = Number(err?.response?.data?.errors?.category_id?.[0]);
781:       if (err?.response?.data?.code === 'category_image_failed' && Number.isSafeInteger(savedId) && savedId > 0) {
782:         setV(current => ({ ...current, id: savedId, slug: slugVal }));
783:         setSlugTouched(true);
784:         onSaved && onSaved();
785:       }
786:       const p = parseApiError(err);
787:       if (p.isValidation) {
788:         const formErrs = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(p.fieldErrors).filter(([k]) => FORM_KEYS.includes(k)));
789:         if (Object.keys(formErrs).length) setErrs(formErrs);
790:         else vtoast(p.message);
791:       } else vtoast(p.message);
792:     } finally {
793:       setBusy(false);
794:       setUploadProgress(null);
795:     }
796:   };
797:   const close = () => { if (!busy) onClose(); };
798:   return (
799:     <Drawer open={open} onClose={close} title={isEdit ? 'تعديل القسم' : (v.parentId ? 'قسم فرعي جديد' : 'قسم رئيسي جديد')} subtitle={v.parentId && !isEdit && parentName ? <>تحت <b className="t-1"><bdi>{parentName}</bdi></b></> : null} width={540}
800:       footer={<><button className="btn btn-soft" onClick={close} disabled={busy}>إلغاء</button><button className="btn btn-ink" onClick={save} disabled={busy || fileChecking}>{(busy || fileChecking) && <Spinner size={14} />}{isEdit ? 'حفظ' : 'إنشاء القسم'}</button></>}>
801:       <fieldset disabled={busy} className="space-y-4">
802:         <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
803:           <Field label="الاسم بالعربي" required error={errs.ar}><Input dir="rtl" value={v.ar || ''} onChange={(e) => setV({ ...v, ar: e.target.value })} error={errs.ar} /></Field>
804:           <Field label="الاسم بالإنجليزي" required error={errs.en}><Input ltr dir="ltr" value={v.en || ''} onChange={(e) => setV({ ...v, en: e.target.value })} error={errs.en} /></Field>
805:         </div>
806:         <Field label="القسم الأب" hint="اختياري — اتركه فارغًا لقسم رئيسي" error={errs.parentId}>
807:           <SearchSelect value={v.parentId || null} onChange={(p) => setV({ ...v, parentId: p })} placeholder="بدون أب (قسم رئيسي)"
808:             options={flat.map((f) => {
809:               const exceeds = (f.depth + 1) + height > MAX_DEPTH;
810:               const selfOrChild = isEdit && (f.id === value.id || isDescendant(value, f.id));
811:               return { value: f.id, label: f.ar, depth: f.depth, disabled: exceeds || selfOrChild, note: exceeds ? 'النقل هنا يتجاوز الحد الأقصى' : (selfOrChild ? (f.id === value.id ? 'نفسه' : 'فرعي منه') : null) };
812:             })} />
813:         </Field>
814:         <Field label="الرابط (slug)" error={errs.slug} hint={!slugTouched ? <>هيتولد تلقائيًا من الاسم الإنجليزي</> : null} aside={slugTouched && <button type="button" className="text-[11px] font-semibold t-acc" onClick={() => { setSlugTouched(false); setV({ ...v, slug: '' }); }}>استخدام التلقائي</button>}>
815:           <div className="relative"><span className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 left-3.5 text-[12.5px] t-3 ltr" dir="ltr">/categories/</span>
816:             <input className="v-input ltr" dir="ltr" style={{ paddingLeft: 98 }} value={slugTouched ? v.slug || '' : generatedSlug} placeholder="auto-generated" onChange={(e) => { setSlugTouched(true); setV({ ...v, slug: e.target.value }); }} />
817:           </div>
818:         </Field>
819:         <Field label="الوصف" error={lang === 'ar' ? errs.desc_ar : errs.desc_en} aside={<Seg value={lang} onChange={setLang} options={[{ value: 'ar', label: 'عربي' }, { value: 'en', label: 'EN' }]} />}>
820:           {lang === 'ar' ? <Textarea dir="rtl" value={v.desc_ar || ''} onChange={(e) => setV({ ...v, desc_ar: e.target.value })} /> : <Textarea className="ltr" dir="ltr" value={v.desc_en || ''} onChange={(e) => setV({ ...v, desc_en: e.target.value })} />}
821:         </Field>
822:         <Field label="صورة القسم" error={errs.img}>
823:           <ImageField value={preview} progress={uploadProgress} disabled={busy} onChecking={setFileChecking}
824:             onFile={(file, url) => {
825:               if (previewUrlRef.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrlRef.current);
826:               previewUrlRef.current = url;
827:               setV({ ...v, imageFile: file, imageRemoved: false, previewUrl: url });
828:             }}
829:             onRemove={() => {
830:               if (previewUrlRef.current) { URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrlRef.current); previewUrlRef.current = null; }
831:               setV({ ...v, imageFile: null, imageRemoved: true, previewUrl: null, img: undefined });
832:             }} />
833:         </Field>
834:         <div className="grid grid-cols-[120px_1fr] gap-3">
835:           <Field label="الترتيب" error={errs.order}><Input ltr dir="ltr" type="text" inputMode="numeric" value={v.order ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setV({ ...v, order: e.target.value })} /></Field>
836:           <div className="v-subcard p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between self-end h-[42px] !rounded-[13px]"><span className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold t-1">نشط</span><Toggle on={v.status === 'active'} onChange={(on) => setV({ ...v, status: on ? 'active' : 'inactive' })} /></div>
837:         </div>
838:       </fieldset>
839:     </Drawer>
840:   );
841: }

843: function Drawer({ open, onClose, title, subtitle, children, footer, width = 520 }) {
844:   const titleId = useId();
845:   useEffect(() => {
846:     if (!open) return;
847:     const h = (e) => e.key === 'Escape' && onClose();
848:     window.addEventListener('keydown', h); return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', h);
849:   }, [open, onClose]);
850:   if (!open) return null;
851:   return (
852:     <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] fade" style={{ background: 'var(--overlay)', backdropFilter: 'blur(2px)' }} onMouseDown={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
853:       <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby={titleId} className="drawer absolute top-3 bottom-3 start-3 v-card flex flex-col overflow-hidden" style={{ width, maxWidth: 'calc(100vw - 24px)', boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-pop)', borderRadius: 26 }}>
854:         <div className="px-6 pt-6 pb-4 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 v-border-b">
855:           <div>
856:             <h3 id={titleId} className="font-display text-[19px] font-semibold t-1">{title}</h3>
857:             {subtitle && <p className="text-[12.5px] t-2 mt-0.5">{subtitle}</p>}
858:           </div>
859:           <button className="icon-btn" onClick={onClose}><Icon name="x" size={16} /></button>
860:         </div>
861:         <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 py-5">{children}</div>
862:         {footer && <div className="px-6 py-4 v-border-t flex items-center justify-end gap-2">{footer}</div>}
863:       </div>
864:     </div>
865:   );
866: }

869:   grid: <><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/></>,

941: function Icon({ name, size = 16, className = '', style, sw = 1.9 }) {
942:   return (
943:     <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
944:       strokeWidth={sw} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" className={'shrink-0 ' + className} style={style} aria-hidden="true">
945:       {ICON_PATHS[name] || ICON_PATHS.info}
946:     </svg>
947:   );
948: }
949: 
950: function useCategoriesTree(enabled) {
951:   const [phase, setPhase] = useState('loading'); // loading | error | empty | ready
952:   const [tree, setTree] = useState([]);
953:   const [saved, setSaved] = useState([]);
954:   const [error, setError] = useState(null);
955:   const request = useRef(null);
956:   const generation = useRef(0);
957: 
958:   const load = useCallback(async ({ silent = false } = {}) => {
959:     if (!enabled) return;
960:     request.current?.abort();
961:     const controller = new AbortController();
962:     request.current = controller;
963:     const current = ++generation.current;
964:     if (!silent) setPhase('loading');
965:     try {
966:       const data = toUiTree(await categoriesApi.tree(controller.signal));
967:       if (controller.signal.aborted || current !== generation.current) return;
968:       setTree(data); setSaved(data); setError(null);
969:       setPhase(data.length ? 'ready' : 'empty');
970:     } catch (e) {
971:       if (controller.signal.aborted || current !== generation.current) return;
972:       const err = parseApiError(e);
973:       setError(err);
974:       if (!silent) setPhase('error'); else vtoast(err.message);
975:     }
976:   }, [enabled]);
977: 
978:   useEffect(() => {
979:     load();
980:     return () => { generation.current++; request.current?.abort(); };
981:   }, [load]);
982:   return { phase, tree, setTree, saved, setSaved, error, reload: load };
983: }
984: 
985: function flattenCats(nodes, depth = 0, path = []) {
986:   return nodes.flatMap((n) => [{ ...n, depth, path: [...path, n.ar] }, ...flattenCats(n.children || [], depth + 1, [...path, n.ar])]);
987: }
````

## File: frontend/apps/backoffice/src/pages/admin/categories-mock/CategoriesMockPage.jsx
````javascript
 1: import React, { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
 2: import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
 3: import { CategoriesReferencePage, ToastHost } from './categories-reference';
 4: import styles from './categories-reference.css?inline';
 5: import { CategoriesContext } from './categories-context';
 6: 
 7: // Keep the reference's tokens, Tailwind reset and component styles inside this page.
 8: // Vortix owns navigation; only the supplied categories design is rendered here.
 9: export default function CategoriesMockPage({ can, forceState = null, embedded = false, darkMode = undefined, theme = undefined }) {
10:   const host = useRef(null);
11:   const [root, setRoot] = useState(null);
12:   const [detectedDark, setDetectedDark] = useState(() => {
13:     if (typeof darkMode === 'boolean') return darkMode;
14:     if (typeof theme === 'string') return theme === 'dark';
15:     try {
16:       return localStorage.getItem('vortix_theme') === 'dark';
17:     } catch {
18:       return false;
19:     }
20:   });
21: 
22:   const isDark = typeof darkMode === 'boolean' ? darkMode : (theme ? theme === 'dark' : detectedDark);
23: 
24:   const perms = useMemo(() => ({
25:     view:   can('categories.view'),
26:     create: can('categories.create'),
27:     update: can('categories.update'),   // يشمل الترتيب والتفعيل والتعطيل
28:     delete: can('categories.delete'),
29:   }), [can]);
30:   const context = useMemo(() => ({
31:     user: { can },
32:     perms,
33:     screenState: forceState || 'ready',
34:   }), [can, perms, forceState]);
35: 
36:   useLayoutEffect(() => {
37:     setRoot(host.current.shadowRoot || host.current.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' }));
38:     const fonts = document.createElement('link');
39:     fonts.rel = 'stylesheet';
40:     fonts.href = 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Readex+Pro:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap';
41:     document.head.append(fonts);
42:     return () => fonts.remove();
43:   }, []);
44: 
45:   useEffect(() => {
46:     if (host.current) {
47:       host.current.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
48:     }
49:   }, [isDark]);
50: 
51:   useEffect(() => {
52:     const handleCustom = (e) => {
53:       if (typeof e.detail?.darkMode === 'boolean') {
54:         setDetectedDark(e.detail.darkMode);
55:       }
56:     };
57:     window.addEventListener('vortix:theme-change', handleCustom);
58: 
59:     const checkParent = () => {
60:       const rootNode = host.current?.getRootNode();
61:       const parentViewport = host.current?.closest('#app-viewport');
62:       const target = parentViewport || (rootNode?.host?.querySelector?.('#app-viewport') || rootNode?.host) || document.querySelector('#app-viewport') || document.querySelector('[data-vortix-host]');
63:       if (!target) return null;
64:       const dark = target.classList?.contains('theme-dark') || target.getAttribute?.('data-theme') === 'dark';
65:       setDetectedDark(dark);
66:       return target;
67:     };
68: 
69:     const target = checkParent();
70:     let observer;
71:     if (target) {
72:       observer = new MutationObserver(() => checkParent());
73:       observer.observe(target, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class', 'data-theme'] });
74:     }
75: 
76:     return () => {
77:       window.removeEventListener('vortix:theme-change', handleCustom);
78:       observer?.disconnect();
79:     };
80:   }, []);
81: 
82:   return (
83:     <div ref={host} data-categories-mock="" data-theme={isDark ? 'dark' : 'light'} dir="rtl">
84:       {root && createPortal(
85:         <CategoriesContext.Provider value={context}>
86:           <style>{styles}</style>
87:           <div className={`categories-surface ${isDark ? 'theme-dark' : 'theme-light'}`} data-embedded={embedded || undefined} dir="rtl" lang="ar">
88:             <CategoriesReferencePage />
89:             <ToastHost />
90:           </div>
91:         </CategoriesContext.Provider>,
92:         root,
93:       )}
94:     </div>
95:   );
96: }
````

````javascript
 1: // أرقام عربية/فارسية → لاتيني (لما المستخدم يكتب ٣ في خانة الترتيب)
 2: export const toLatinDigits = (s) =>
 3:   String(s ?? '')
 4:     .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d))
 5:     .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d));
 6: 
 7: // تطبيع للبحث: يشيل التشكيل والتطويل ويوحّد الألف والياء والتاء المربوطة
 8: export const normalizeSearch = (s) =>
 9:   String(s ?? '')
10:     .toLowerCase()
11:     .replace(/[\u064B-\u0652\u0640]/g, '')
12:     .replace(/[أإآ]/g, 'ا')
13:     .replace(/ى/g, 'ي')
14:     .replace(/ة/g, 'ه')
15:     .trim();
16: 
17: // الاسم المعروض مع fallback لو لغة فاضية
18: export const displayName = (n, lang = 'ar') =>
19:   (lang === 'ar' ? n.ar || n.en : n.en || n.ar) || '—';
20: 
21: // slug تلقائي من الإنجليزي فقط (لو الناتج فاضي → نسيبه null والباك يولّد)
22: export const autoSlug = (en) =>
23:   String(en ?? '').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
````
